games.name: Football Story
games.shortDescription: Football Story is a cozy football RPG and life sim about growing up, friendship, and a dream. Develop your skills, explore the town of Lumen Bay, help its residents, and build your own street football team. Rise from your first neighborhood matches to victory over the pros!
games.aboutText:
MAKE A TEENAGE DREAM COME TRUE

The journey to the top of street football begins with a simple passion. Guide an ambitious teenager through daily training and backyard games, helping them turn their everyday hobby into a true success story and become a local legend.

GATHER YOUR STREET TEAM

A captain is only as good as their teammates. Finding unique neighborhood kids and building great chemistry turns a group of everyday teens into a highly coordinated and winning squad on the football pitch.

COZY AND CHARMING HOMETOWN

Lumen Bay is a beautifully detailed and welcoming place waiting to be discovered. Its nostalgic streets are packed with vibrant art, visual humor, and hidden spots for the curious explorer.

FRIENDSHIPS BEYOND THE FIELD

Life outside the game is filled with quirky residents and their daily routines. Lending a hand to locals with their everyday troubles builds strong community bonds and unlocks helpful rewards.

TRAIN, PLAY, AND TRIUMPH

Regular exercises and fun mini-games keep your character's stats sharp and ready for action. During thrilling street matches, smart tactics and quick decisions are the true keys to outsmarting rivals and claiming victory.

games.name: Tennis Elbow 4
games.shortDescription: Created by and for tennis fans, Tennis Elbow 4 is a true tennis simulation built around anticipation, positioning and risk management. Easy to start, demanding to master, it delivers exceptional gameplay depth and long-term progression.
games.aboutText:
Tennis Elbow 4 is the successor to Tennis Elbow 2013, acclaimed by many Steam reviewers as one of the most realistic tennis simulations ever made.

TE4 pushes the realism of tennis rallies even further with fully reworked ball, strike and player physics. The game is built around anticipation, positioning, player inertia, shot selection and risk management, while still letting you start playing quickly with the right assists and difficulty settings.

Created by and for tennis fans, Tennis Elbow 4 is a deep tennis simulation that can be enjoyed at many levels. You can play casually with helpers such as Auto-Positioning, Footwork Boost and Aiming Preview, or progressively turn them down to experience a more demanding and precise game.

Like real tennis, TE4 rewards players who learn to read the ball, prepare early, position themselves properly and choose the right shot under pressure. The basics can click quickly, but mastering the rallies, timing and movement gives the game its long-term depth.

To beat your opponent, you can use all the main shots available on a real court: safe strikes, accelerations, topspin shots, slices, drop shots, lobs, volleys and smashes. Cross-court rallies, changes of rhythm, defensive play and risky winners all emerge naturally from the physics and the tactical situation.

With many difficulty levels and sublevels, Tennis Elbow 4 lets you tune the challenge very precisely. Lower levels and assists are ideal to learn the controls and enjoy the career at your own rhythm, while higher levels bring the pace, pressure and consistency closer to professional tennis.

Tennis Elbow 4 features one of the most complete World Tours ever made in a tennis game. With over 3500 players evolving across several decades and more than 400 tournaments each year, from low-rank Junior events to top-level Pro finals, in both singles and doubles, you can experience the long-term progression of a real tennis career.

The Tennis Elbow engine is also very open to modding, with many Mods directly downloadable from within the game. Mods can add or improve players, outfits, courts, sounds and many other elements, letting the community push the game even further.

Tennis Elbow 4 is made for players who want deep rallies, realistic ball physics, meaningful positioning and a true learning curve.

Features:

- 9 different court surfaces : clay, green clay, grass, hard, blue-green hard, classic synthetic, NewLine synthetic, indoor hard and indoor synthetic; each with a specific rebound

- 21 Stadiums around the world

- 400+ tournaments, with 3500+ players evolving over 70 years, from 1973 for men & 1983 for women, to 2042

- Commentaries by Tennis TV commentator Darren Kilfara

- The Country Cup

- Singles & doubles competitions

- Junior & Pro Tours

- 6 difficulty levels, each split into 10 sublevels

- Full ranking system

- 3D male & female players, fully customizable

- Singles, 3, and doubles games

- Split screen

- Network : LAN and online games

- 1 to 6 games per set, in best of 1, 3 or 5 sets

- 7 camera modes

- Moving sun and Night session

- The game is very Modding-friendly

Warnings for the Online mode :

- You can play doubles with 4 human players on 1 computer, or on 2 computers with 2 players on each, via LAN or Internet — but not on four separate computers.

- Online play uses peer-to-peer (P2P) connections with no relay server. This means that if you're behind CGNAT, or if you cannot forward a UDP port or use UPnP on your Internet router, you won’t be able to host a match. You should still be able to join a host, though.

games.name: Rhythm Doctor
games.shortDescription: Save patients with your rhythm mastery! Rhythm Doctor is a rhythm game where you heal patients by defibrillating in time to their heartbeats. Learn each patient's unique heartbeat and defeat boss viruses trying to sabotage your rhythm, all set to heart-pumping, soul-soothing music.
games.aboutText:
Save lives with your spacebar!

Rhythm Doctor is a rhythm game in a world where defibrillating patients' hearts in sync with their heartbeats has healing properties. Slam your spacebar in perfect time on the 7th beat, and they might just come out okay. But beware - every patient has unique illnesses based on complex music theory: polyrhythms, hemiolas, irregular time signatures...if you don't know what they mean, don't worry. Rhythm Doctor is designed to make you learn music and rhythm theory without even realising it!

- 20+ handmade levels, each with their own story.

- Every level introduces a different concept of rhythm theory in an accessible way

- A large cast of doctors and patients feature in an overarching, character-centric storyline

- Play the story solo or grab a friend for drop-in drop-out local multiplayer throughout the whole campaign!

- Robust level editor to make, share, and play community levels! Use your own music, place notes snapped to the beat, and use 50+ different visual effects and backgrounds

- Challenging "Night Shift" versions of each level for the brave

(Note: 2P mode only works locally. Online 2P via Remote Play is enabled for this game, but it does not work that well right now due to varying latency)

Rhythm Doctor features flashing lights and colors. Please use caution if you have experience with epilepsy or any of its symptoms.

games.name: Unsung Warriors
games.shortDescription: Unsung Warriors is a 2D action-adventure game. The game can be played solo or in couch co-op mode. Enjoy beautiful handcrafted levels. Fight against ferocious enemies and discover the many secrets of this ancient world.
games.aboutText:
Unsung Warriors is a 2D action-adventure game. The world of Unsung Warriors is set in Iron-Age inspired Europe, among various Celtic tribes. It mixes fantasy elements with European folk tales and mythology. The game can be played solo or in couch co-op mode. Enjoy beautiful handcrafted levels. Fight against ferocious enemies and discover the many secrets of this ancient world.

What to expect?

- Single player & couch co-op mode

- Explore a vast world with interesting locations

- Battle against ferocious enemies and bosses

- Solve puzzles and overcome platforming challenges

- Immersive main story and engaging side quests

- Meet interesting characters. Some of them can even become your friend

- Equip a wide variety of weapons, spells and other items

- Buy or sell equipment at a shop (no in-app purchases)

- Learn powerful new abilities

- An adventure filled with small jokes and surprises

- Set in a universe inspired by barbarian tribes in Europe

- Multiple endings depending on the choices you make

- Keyboard, touchscreen & controller support (rumble included)

- A team dedicated to giving you a great gaming experience!

games.name: CUCKOLD SIMULATOR: Life as a Beta Male Cuck
games.shortDescription: CUCKOLD SIMULATOR, the exciting new game where you play as Cuckold (that is his name) in his day-to-day life. Work hard, give all your money to the bull, and be verbally abused by your fat wife.
games.aboutText:
CUCKOLD SIMULATOR, the exciting new game where you play as Cuckold (that is his name) in his day-to-day life.

Features

- Work your job at GloboCorp to make money

- You can give all your hard-earned money to the bull

- Browse your favorite websites, such as Reddit™

- Your fat wife will verbally abuse you

- Become emotionally attached to children that are not biologically yours

- Collect 'Funky Pop' collectibles that are hidden across the world

- Play actual games on your 'Wintendo Snitch' gaming console, such as 'Cuck Souls'

- And more!

One Happy Family

- Cuckold - Husband and beta male provider of the family. Only good for providing income.

- Wife - Fat and mean. Only has eyes for Tyrone - and Cuckold's wallet.

- Tyrone - Transient alpha male of the household. Has outstanding warrants for theft.

- DeShawn - Wife's ten year old child from a previous relationship. Does not respect Cuckold.

- Tyrone Jr. - The newest addition to the family. Named after his father. Too young to not respect Cuckold.

Wintendo Snitch

The Wintendo Snitch is a fully functional game console that you can purchase inside of the game. Play exciting games such as CUCK SOULS, Anime Girl Genocide, Crossy Border, and Grand Chores Bitch... With incredible features such auto save. 6 games available, with more releasing eventually.

games.name: Hades II
games.shortDescription: Battle beyond the Underworld using dark sorcery to take on the Titan of Time in this bewitching sequel to the award-winning rogue-like dungeon crawler.
games.aboutText:
The first-ever sequel from Supergiant Games builds on the best aspects of the original god-like rogue-like dungeon crawler in an all-new, action-packed, endlessly replayable experience rooted in the Underworld of Greek myth and its deep connections to the dawn of witchcraft.

BATTLE BEYOND THE UNDERWORLD

As the immortal Princess of the Underworld, you'll explore a bigger, deeper mythic world, vanquishing the forces of the Titan of Time with the full might of Olympus behind you, in a sweeping story that continually unfolds through your every setback and accomplishment.

MASTER WITCHCRAFT AND DARK SORCERY

Infuse your legendary weapons of Night with ancient magick, so that none may stand in your way. Become stronger still with powerful Boons from more than a dozen Olympian gods, from Apollo to Zeus. There are nearly limitless ways to build your abilities.

MINGLE WITH (MORE) GODS, GHOSTS, AND MONSTERS

Meet a cast of dozens of fully-voiced, larger-than-life characters, including plenty of new faces and some old friends. Grow closer to them through a variety of new interactions, and experience countless unique story events based on how your journey unfolds.

EVERY RUN IS ITS OWN ADVENTURE

New locations, challenges, upgrade systems, and surprises await as you delve into the ever-shifting Underworld again and again. Reveal the mysteries of the Altar of Ashes, tame witchy familiars, and gather reagents using Tools of the Unseen to get closer to your goal.

THE PERKS OF IMMORTALITY

Thanks to a variety of permanent upgrades and the return of God Mode, you don't have to be a god yourself to experience what Hades II has to offer. But if you happen to be one, you can brave escalating challenges for greater rewards, and prove just how divine you really are.

SIGNATURE SUPERGIANT STYLE

Rich, atmospheric presentation and storytelling fused with responsive action is the hallmark of Supergiant's titles. Vivid new hand-painted environments, even smoother real-time 3D characters, and an electrifying original score make this mythic world burst with life.

games.name: Iron Meat
games.shortDescription: Iron Meat is a run-and-gun arcade shooter that immerses players in an apocalyptic future overrun by "The Meat," an iron-ravenous mass mutating everything in its path. Blast your way through retro-inspired stages and bosses to uncover the shocking horrors behind secret experiments on the Moon.
games.aboutText:
Iron Meat is a fast-paced, run-and-gun shooter that immerses players in a world overrun by The Meat--an all-consuming interdimensional biomass. With a mix of classic arcade and console mechanics, players will battle against mutated victims and machines, dodge bullet barrages, and crush bosses in nine levels of gore-ific brutality. As Vadim, fight back against The Meat and stop the terrors spawned from scientist Yuri Markov's experiments on the Moon.

MULTI-PHASE BOSS FIGHTS

Iron Meat pays homage to classic run-and-gun titles from the past, with intense boss fights fixed into multiple phases. With three difficulty settings to choose from, players can put their skills to the test, where a higher difficulty is rewarded with an even more challenging boss battle.

MULTIPLAYER COUCH CO-OP

Who says you have to take on The Meat invasion alone? With 2-player couch co-op, you can grab a buddy to leave a trail of bloody, Meat-infected corpses together! It's double the firepower, double the carnage, and double the MEAT!

OVER 30 UNLOCKABLE SKINS

You don't have to be a soldier to fight against The Meat. Hell, you don't even have to be a HUMAN to do so! With over 30 unlockable skins to choose from, players can customize their character the way they want. Each skin comes with interchangeable parts, allowing for greater customization with mixing and matching. Want a shark head on a robot body with dinosaur feet? DONE. Maybe a half human, half doggo? YOU BET! Or how about a cowboy with a tail and demon wings? Hmm...YEP!

You and your audience will be able to play with you in real time receiving the individual relevance they deserve, growing your channel day by day.

Kukoro: Stream chat games is a mini-game compilation that will bring you closer to your Twitch community than ever before.
We are proud to consider ourselves the best chat game to interact with your audience , improving the engage of your viewers day by day due to the high chat participation.
Also it includes a lot of features and customization for all those viewers who decide to buy it. Unlock exclusive skins, pets, emotes and dances to use in any stream!

Play alone or with friends
