games.name: Wobbly Life
games.shortDescription: Wobbly Life is a vibrant open-world physics sandbox. Play with your friends online or in local co-op, with exciting jobs, mini games and wacky story missions. Earn cash to spend in the world on clothes, vehicles and houses. There is a whole Wobbly World out there to explore!
games.aboutText:
Grandma has kicked you out into the big wide Wobbly world demanding you go and GET A JOB! She would be so proud if you could earn some money and get your own house one day!

It's time to start earning and living your best Wobbly Life !

- 1-4 players Online and Local split-screen co-op

- Open-world sandbox filled with mini-games, toys, secrets

- +100 unique missions & jobs with exclusive rewards to unlock, alone or with friends

- +90 vehicles to ride around (and crash)

- +500 clothes items to show-off in your wobbly look

Let's start exploring! Almost everything is interactive – grab, play, and experiment in a world filled with props, mini-games, and surprises.

Experience the joy solo or share your adventures with up to 4 players in online or local co-op, all in one big Wobbly world.

Embark on story missions, each offering unique rewards through fun puzzles and challenges. Unveil the mysteries of the tropical island, uncover the mountain’s secrets, delve into hidden caves...

The Wobbly Museum has lost all its artifacts! Maybe you can help? Buy treasure maps and solve clues to find all the Museums' lost treasures and unlock exciting rewards.

Make grandma happy and go get that job! Earn money by choosing from +20 exciting jobs, each bringing their new unique challenges. From pizza delivery to firefighting, taxi driver to disco dancer… your Wobbly dream job is waiting for you.

The Wobbly Space Programme is looking for new recruits. Space is a whole new open world, with new jobs, missions, and secrets to uncover. You'll even get to fly your own spaceships too, so what are you waiting for!

Once you’ve fattened up your bank account why not go on a shopping spree? Visit the Pet Shop to buy a faithful companion, buy and unlock +500 clothes items and choose from +90 different vehicles.

When you’ve really made the big bucks, you can even buy a house: from a wooden cabin to a huge fancy mansion, Wobbly Island has a home for everyone!

Want to take a break from Wobbly Island? Try out Arcade mode! Discover new game modes: Trash Zone, Hide & Seek, Wobble Run and Sandbox. Each have customizable settings for you to play with, multiple mini-games and new areas to have fun in!

Create your own Wobbly Life Content and share it with players across the world in the Steam Workshop. Prefer to explore rather than create? Dive into an ever-growing library of creative wonders from our Wobbly community.

games.name: Flock
games.shortDescription: Flock is a multiplayer co-op game about the joy of flight and collecting adorable flying creatures with your friends. Soar through beautiful landscapes, seeking out rare and elusive creatures to add to your flock.
games.aboutText:
Flock is a multiplayer co-op game where players take on the role of flying shepherds, each tending to their own unique herd of adorable flying creatures.

The game is an ode to the joy of flight and discovery. Starting with a small herd of hover-sheep, you nurture and fly them toward fresh, untouched pastures. Along the way, you will discover the secrets of the beautiful uplands and its wild creatures.

Weird flying creatures. Are they fish? Birds? Snakes? It’s a real mystery. They are mostly friendly though, and with a bit of skill you can charm them to join your flock.

As your flock grows and your sheep get woolier, you can use the wool you shear from them for hats, cardigans, even socks!

Will you find all the creatures? Even the super rare and elusive ones? Will you keep them to yourself or share them with your friends? Will you knit the longest scarf ever seen? Will you find all the hidden treasures stolen by the pesky Burgling Bewls?

games.name: Isles of Krom
games.shortDescription: Isles of Krom is a dark fantasy top-down roguelike where progression is carved into the world itself. Master challenging, Souls-inspired combat as your Wards push back the Pestilence, claim each isle's lasting power, and reclaim the Krom Archipelago run after run.
games.aboutText:
THE ISLES REMEMBER

The Rift has opened and its Pestilence has swallowed the Krom Archipelago.

As a Ward of the Corvus, push it back isle by isle and reclaim what was lost. In Isles of Krom, progress isn't bought between runs. It's carved into the world itself.

RECLAIM THE ARCHIPELAGO

Pestilence has taken root across every isle, smothering everything it touches. Cleanse its clusters to uncover Vestiges, fleeting boons that shift with every run.

Somewhere in this corruption, crows lie caged. Break their chains and watch them fly home. Each one returns with a permanent relic, growing the power of the Corvus with every crow you save.

FIGHT LIKE IT MATTERS

Souls-inspired combat built on timing, positioning and poise. Break your enemies' guard, gather Will from the fallen, and unleash devastating weapon abilities.

FORGE YOUR WARD

No two Wards are alike. Combine traits with weapons, armor and the Vestiges you uncover to build a Ward strong enough to close the Rift.

Wishlist now and join our Discord to follow development.

games.name: Sheepy: A Short Adventure
games.shortDescription: A Short Handcrafted Pixel Art Platformer that follows Sheepy, an abandoned plushy brought to life. Sheepy: A Short Adventure is the first short game from MrSuicideSheep.
games.aboutText:
Help Sheepy, an abandoned plushy brought to life, as he explores a forgotten and broken world. Sheepy: A Short Adventure is the first short game from MrSuicideSheep.

An Original Soundtrack

Weaved into the world is an incredible original soundtrack created by Seeking Blue artists Yoe Mase, Hahlweg and Tal Richards (formerly of Echos).

Mailing List

Join the Mailing List and be the first to learn about the future of Sheepy, limited edition merch and more.

games.name: Dunjungle
games.shortDescription: A 2d action-packed roguelite about a monkey hero protecting the jungle from the rise of a corruptive power. Explore ever-changing dungeons, fight weird enemies and gear up with lots of weapons and relics you can combine for a new experience every run. Explore, fight, die, and repeat!
games.aboutText:
Overview

Dunjungle is an action-packed roguelite about a monkey hero, adventuring into a jungle under the menace of a corruptive power that is transforming its peaceful creatures and destroying everything on its way.

You'll explore continuously changing dungeons through 7 unique biomes , featuring temples, crypts, and other mysterious places, where you'll find all sort of weird enemies and an arsenal of weapons, spells, and relics, granting you a different experience every time you play.

Features

Lots of weapons, spells and relics with unique effects.

Equipment can also be merged with several elements, to create new and powerful versions.

Burn monsters with fire, use ice to slow them down, shock them with thunder, or just get them off you using wind to blow them away!

Mix up your playstyle with more than 30 weapons, 40 subweapons, and 100 relics

Classes to customize your runs

You will unlock several classes with a variety of strengths and weaknesses. You can choose the class before starting the run and play in your preferred style!

A total of 15 classes which have meaningfull impact on how you play!

Dungeons are procedurally generated, made from big collection of hand-crafted rooms.

These rooms are filled with all sort of weird creatures, valuable treasures, dangerous traps, and of course, challenging bosses!

Fast Game Loop

There are no checkpoints in Dunjungle. You die, you start over. Die again, try again!

But don't worry too much. Several things will remain for your next run.

Maybe you unlocked a new weapon? Maybe a new spell? Maybe you saved a trapped character, who will now lend you a hand.

Along your way, you may find characters who are lost, trapped, or maybe just chilling in there. Help them out, and you might become friends!

(Spoiler: A lot of them are monkeys)

More importantly, each time you die, you'll know more about Dunjungle's world, so don't despair, and use what you've learned to get further on your next adventure.

And more!

- Monkeys!

- Irrelevant item descriptions!

- Annoying NPCs who think they're better than you!

- Weird fishes with legs!

- Treasure chests that are actually not treasure chests!

- Developed by an ape!

games.name: Plushie from the Sky
games.shortDescription: A goofy action RPG. Armed with a plushie, smack down nightmarish foes with cuddly chaos. Cheese the boss. Dodge roll your way to victory!
games.aboutText:
Find your way home

Play as a little angel who fell down from the sky and is finding her way home. Embark on a dreamy action adventure as you soar across the sky and explore the mystery of a fantasy world.

Combat Skills

Fight your way through wacky and corrupted monsters with your close and far range combat abilities. The bosses will be challenging despite the charming part of the game. Players might fail during the initial attempts, learn their attack patterns, and find ways to overcome them.

Dodge and roll towards victory

This game also focuses a lot on well-timed dodge, block and parry abilities. There will be many scenarios that one will suit better than the others.

games.name: Space Defender: Frontier Squadron
games.shortDescription: A top-down space shooter with deep RPG progression. Fly a voiced story in four acts, lead your wingmen, hunt pirate captains, hold a collapsing front. Solo or local co-op. Your Steam purchase also unlocks the full game on Android and iPhone (via sync, up to 3 devices).
games.aboutText:
Included with your purchase: the full game on Android and iPhone. In the Steam game, on the save screen, open Sync and press "Unlock my phones", then enter the same sync key on your phone: your saves follow you, and the full game unlocks there on up to 3 devices. You need to own the game: Family Sharing and free weekends don't count.

The frontier is falling. Hold the line.

A twin-stick arcade shooter in space. Lead a squadron, defend the stations, land on the planets and drive the rover, then dock at a spaceport for a drink, a rumour and a game of cards with the regulars. A story told over the radio in the middle of the fight, made by a solo French developer.

Fly, dodge, fire

Pick up the controller and you are in the fight. Every enemy attack is announced: read it, dodge it, hit back. Snipers keep their distance, minelayers leave traps, carriers launch fighters, jammers scramble your missiles.

Lead your squadron

- Up to three wingmen: order them to attack, cover you, hold or break, and they answer on the radio

- Each pilot has a trait that changes how they fight, and earns grades from Recruit to Ace

- A downed wingman ejects: pick up the pod before it is lost

Build your ship

- 20 ships and over 60 pieces of equipment: lasers, railguns, flak, guided missiles, turrets, shields

- Manage your energy: everything you fit changes how your ship flies and fights

- Research, mining, salvage and trade pay for the next hull; the Laboratory turns plans into new gear

A front that moves

The Drones push back. Stations come under threat, then under siege, then fall if nobody defends them. Take them back.

A story in four acts

Fly for Admiral Voss and Ilse Marin, with ARIA at your side, in a story voiced in six languages. Escort the Armada, make your choice at the Threshold, then head down into Kepler, the abandoned mining world of Act IV: gravity wells, dark shafts, heavy ships. Spare, enlist or shoot down the pirate captains: your choices lead to one of several endings.

Planetary expeditions

Scan a planet, pick a site and set down. Then the rover takes over: drive to wrecks, relics, caches and pirate outposts, take ground contracts, get past the traps of the ruins, and on ocean worlds open the gates of sunken cities. Bring back rare materials for the Laboratory.

Found a rich vein? Start the drill and hold out: the pirates come in waves. Place your turrets and mines, repair the drill under fire, and leave with the ore.

Pull up a stool at the bar

Every spaceport has its own bar and its own people. Buy a rumour from the informant: a signal on a distant planet, a pirate lieutenant's bounty, a vein, a hidden cache, the wreck of a legendary hull. Get to know the regulars, each with a story to follow, a job for you and a gift at the end. And sometimes, a dare.

The arcade room

- FRONTIER EIGHTS: a card game against the regulars, for fun or for credits, with 24 special cards to win and build into your deck

- A pinball table with its own squadron career, a rover race, air hockey and an asteroid shooter

- A high-score board in every port: become its champion

Your crew

Recruit pilots in port, put them in a wingman's cockpit or aboard your own ship, and talk with them: what they have to say changes as the story moves on. Send a team down to explore a signal. Not everyone comes back, and the memorial keeps their names.

Play together

Local co-op: a friend takes a second controller and flies a wingman at your side, on one PC or online with Steam Remote Play Together.

Play your way

- Controller or mouse and keyboard; Windows, macOS and Linux

- Four difficulty levels, a Veteran mode and 3 save slots

- Voiced in English, French, German, Spanish, Russian and Simplified Chinese

games.name: Frogmonster
games.shortDescription: Discover some of the most charming and challenging soulslike bosses in Frogmonster, a Metroidvania FPS adventure where you explore a lively world filled with creatures, bugs, and beasts.
games.aboutText:
Help protect Melora from Runi and his many creations in this unique and charming Soulslike Metroidvania FPS Adventure, where you'll never know what could be around the next corner.

Explore an atmospheric and colorful world with a cast of characters, who mostly have good intentions.

Fight over 30 unique bosses that will test your limits and reward you heartily. All with their own mechanics and personalities to enjoy.

Keep an eye out for bugs. Catch them with your tongue and equip them to gain a variety of bonuses... you are a Frog after all.

Find weapons and choose upgrade paths to suit them to a variety of playstyles, and use spells to heal and zap, burn, explode... any enemy in your path.

Enjoy a weird and winding world, finding upgrades and abilities, to push further and reset the balance after Runi messed it all up.

POST LAUNCH UPDATES

- Bonus Boss's Update

- Fight 3 New Bosses: Balsam, Borp, and Mud!

- Boss Soup Update

- Dive in to trenches soup and fight through 4 rounds of boss rush mode!

- Each of the four soups contains it's own new boss fight at the end I wonder who they could be!

- Item Randomizer

- Hop onto the randomizer branch and connect to archipelago to play Frogmonster with items randomized.

- Music Update

- Brad new Soundtrack including over 50 tracks

- Including tracks for every boss fight!

games.name: Cryptid Farm
games.shortDescription: Cultivate a thriving farm to survive in this peaceful horror farming game! Play online with up to 16 players in the same lobby. Work together with your fellow farmers to repair your tractor and escape the farm, try not to fall victim to the eerie and mysterious creatures that lurk nearby.
games.aboutText:
A “peaceful” farming experience for you and your friends…

Cryptid Farm is a tense horror experience where you'll take care of your patch of land, growing crops from scratch and attempting to survive the mysterious happenings on the farm. Singleplayer or multiplayer, everyone shares a single farm space where they'll work together (or against each other) to grow their produce and use those funds to ultimately escape the farm.

Your main farming routine will involve planting, watering, harvesting, and then refilling your watering can at the corners of the field. You'll have access to a range of 8 different crops to try growing, each with unique looks and attributes. Progress your farming ability over time with upgrades that will allow you to manage bigger and larger farms.

There’s something moving out there. Is it after your crops… or after you?

Keep an ear out and stay alert, prepare yourself for any sign of danger. The farm is often visited by a variety of dangerous creatures which can pose a threat at any time, each hunting in a unique way. It’ll be up to you to pay attention to their behaviours and pick up on tips to help you survive. However, don't rely on patterns as the farm is brimming with unpredictable events that will surprise even the most steadfast worker.

Cryptid Farm is designed with multiplayer in mind and features online multiplayer for up to 16 players per room, perfect for any friend group or public server. The game uses Photon Networking and the Photon Cloud as it's server system. It can also be played singleplayer for those willing to brave it alone.

Do you think you can escape from Cryptid Farm?

games.name: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
games.shortDescription: Lead the members of Expedition 33 on their quest to destroy the Paintress so that she can never paint death again. Explore a world of wonders inspired by Belle Époque France and battle unique enemies in this turn-based RPG with real-time mechanics.
games.aboutText:
Once a year, the Paintress wakes and paints upon her monolith. Paints her cursed number. And everyone past that age turns to smoke and fades away. Year by year, that number ticks down and more of us are erased. Tomorrow she’ll wake and paint “33.” And tomorrow we depart on our final mission - Destroy the Paintress, so she can never paint death again.

We are Expedition 33.

Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 is a ground-breaking turn-based RPG with unique real-time mechanics, making battles more immersive and addictive than ever. Explore a fantasy world inspired by Belle Époque France in which you battle devastating enemies.

In this evolution of JRPGs, real-time actions enhance the heart of turn-based combat. Craft unique builds for your Expeditioners that fit your playstyle via gear, stats, skills, and character synergies. Open an active dimension in combat - dodge, parry, and counter in real time, chain combos by mastering attack rhythms, and target enemy weak points using a free aim system.

With only one year left to live, join Gustave, Maelle, and their fellow Expeditioners as they embark upon a desperate quest to break the Paintress’ cycle of death. Follow the trail of previous expeditions and discover their fate. Get to know the members of Expedition 33 as they learn to work together against impossible odds.

Explore an enchanting realm populated by surreal adversaries. Wander through breathtaking landscapes, from the Island of Visages to the Forgotten Battlefield, discovering secrets and hidden quests along the way. Find allies of fortune in creatures of legend. Recruit special companions to access new travel methods and discover secret areas in the World Map.

Experience the debut game from Sandfall Interactive, fully realized in Unreal Engine 5 with stunning graphics and a heartbreaking soundtrack.

games.name: sobosuba
games.shortDescription: sobosuba is a merge game with ultra-squishy soft-body physics. Satisfying and relaxing -but strategy, tricks, and skill matter for chasing high scores.
games.aboutText:
sobosuba is a merge game with ultra-squishy soft-body physics. Mostly satisfying and relaxing with no explicit time pressure -but strategy, tricks, and skill matter if you want higher scores.

Launch blobs softly to carefully position without disturbing others, or launch fast to push and squeeze through tight gaps.

Achievements and online leaderboard. Some achievements require different ways of playing.

Unlockable color styles with every achievement.

Trailer music credit: James Tubbritt (Sharp) / FXhome (CC BY 3.0)

games.name: Calcium Chaos
games.shortDescription: Calcium Chaos is a casual Twin-Stick Roguelite that takes you on a journey by train to confront the necromancer and her skeleton army. Get ready to explore a world filled with crazy weapon combinations and unexpected allies as you embark on an epic quest to save the world!
games.aboutText:
Skeletons are invading, and your only defense is a toaster and a chicken! Embark on a whimsical adventure through a land plagued by pesky skeletons! Uncover weird and wacky weapon synergies to fight back against the bony baddies. Along the way, you'll gather a rag-tag group of heroes who will aid you on your mission- will you have the guts to stop the necromancer's plans and save the world?

Discover an arsenal of ONE MILLION different weapon combinations, from explosive toast to homing robot chickens, and customize your loadout to suit your playstyle as you wreak havoc on your enemies.

Recruit up to four friends to join your quest to defeat the necromancer, or measure yourself by playing alone.

Transform your train into a formidable base of operations for the friends you meet along the way, buy upgrades, decorate your train, and prepare your next mission!

Dive into procedurally generated levels filled with challenges!

Test your skills and adaptability as you strive to overcome the ever-growing threats that await you.

games.name: 勇者与亡灵之都
games.shortDescription: 《勇者与亡灵之都》是一款在半开放世界探索的回合制RPG游戏，游戏借鉴了NPCDream、Blacksouls等rpg，采用了ATB行动条的设定，加快了战斗的节奏和策略性。 亡灵、魔物亦或是人类，只要阻挡在你面前的尽管杀光就是。勇者就是这样的存在啊... 游戏带有多结局与二周目元素，突出一个量大管饱。
games.aboutText:
东之大地弥漫着浓雾，死者们再度苏醒。

战争，战争，无尽的战争。

现在是胜者们付出代价的时候了。

你是一位来自罗伯里亚王国的勇者，你要终结这场由【亡灵之都】凡尔顿王国带来的灾难。

或者..........这其实并不重要？

希望你能斩断这悲哀的轮回。

※win10或者win11用户在进行游戏时，可能会出现游戏速度异常的问题，可以通过进入 系统→屏幕→高级显示器设置 将选择刷新率调整为60hz解决。

※玩家交流Q群：974464175

※游戏攻略与讨论：搜索 勇者与亡灵之都吧

games.name: CATO: Buttered Cat
games.shortDescription: Puzzle platformer where you control both the cat and the toast, based on the famous "Buttered Cat Paradox". The game features 200+ levels, 70+ skins, plus boss fights and mini-games!
games.aboutText:
- Control the cat as it runs left and right, climbs the cat scratching broad, and even slips through pipes. Hey! cats are liquid!

- Guide the toast meanwhile with the cat, as toast jumps like projectiles. Hold down and power on, and the toast will jump farther!

- When the two combine, they can trigger the paradox, taking the cat to unreachable places!

CATO: Buttered Cat revolves around the two main characters, "Cat" and "Buttered Toast." You'll need to use the interactions between them to solve various puzzles at each game level. The full game is featuring over 140 main levels and more than 60 side levels. There are also hidden rooms, challenging boss battles, and fun mini-games. The full version will include an outfit system, with 70+ Cat and Toast skins waiting for you to collect!

CATO: Buttered Cat is an adorable puzzle platformer, inspired by the buttered-cat paradox meme: Cats always land on their feet, and toast always lands buttered side down. By strapping a piece of buttered toast to a cat's back, you create a paradox that results in an infinitely spinning, floating butter-cat perpetual motion machine!

CATO will take you to a brain-teasing adventure, exploring five different worlds, each filled with unique contraptions.

Including toaster(Toast: NO!!)to buttered trampolines and speed-boasting space pipes(Cat: Meow!!). Along the way, the two will also encounter some mysterious companions to help them with puzzles.

The game is about puzzles, with a little action elements. You don't need to perform difficult platforming for most of the time; just focus on solving the puzzles. However, some pesky enemies will be standing in your way during the adventure. Your abilities will help you defeat them.

As you progress through the adventure, you'll also unlock various mini-games. Once collected, these can be installed on the gaming console in your little hideout, allowing you to play them anytime.

In the world of CATO: Buttered Cat, there are many hidden rooms that can only be accessed through secret passages. Here, you can find Easter eggs from other worlds and mysterious drop items.

Take them back to your cozy little hideout, put on your favourite outfit, and set off again!

What exactly is the cat and toast searching for? Pieces of these stories are scattered along the adventure, waiting for you to explore.

About Developer

Team Woll is made up of leading programmer Blasin and leading artist Frank, who met during the BOOOM Gamejam 2022 hosted by GCORES. The positive feedback from the Gamejam project, CATO: Buttered Cat, made us officially establish our studio.

CATO: Buttered Cat is Team Woll's first game, a labour of love that took two years to develop entirely through remote collaboration. We hope you enjoy our game! We also want to express our gratitude to all the friends who have supported us along the way. Our indie game journey has just begun!

About Publisher

GCORES PUBLISHING is an indie game publishing business established by GCORES. In the future, we will continue to bring you outstanding indie games from the BOOOM Game jam. Welcome to our publisher site for more information.

About BOOOM

The BOOOM Game jam is a game development event held twice a year, where participants are given three weeks to develop a game based on a specific theme. After the development phase, we host an online game festival where all players can try out the games, and these games are also showcased at the G-FUSION offline video game carnival.

Welcome to Our Community

Feel free to reach out to us through our community channels to learn more about our game, stay updated, or share feedback or suggestions!

- Twitter (X): @Cato_TeamWoll

- YouTube: Cato - Buttered cat paradox game

- Join our Discord!

games.name: Glaciered
games.shortDescription: Soar the seas at the end of time. 65 million years in the future, the world has frozen over, and the oceans have been sealed under a thick layer of ice. Become a Tuai—a species that evolved from birds—and protect the Everwinter in this futuristic underwater action game.
games.aboutText:
Glaciered takes place on Earth 65 million years in the future, where the "Everwinter" has transformed the planet's surface into a gigantic sheet of ice and life continues to survive under the glacier-covered seas.

Aquatic plants grow from glacier skies and colorful, bioluminescent fish light the seafloor. A new species prospers in this new golden age of life. They are the Tuai, descended from birds and successors of the dinosaurs. The superior intellect and unique metabolism they evolved over millions of years secured their prosperity in this icy environment. The great Ice Age that nurtures this bountiful ecosystem will survive for as long as the Everwinter persists.

Play as a Tuai fighting against that which has come to threaten the Everwinter.

Glaciered features real-time, dynamic combat that combines melee and ranged attacks with special abilities. Unleash the power within the Tuai avian and dinosaur bloodlines and harness their ability to control heat and cold.

Build your character by combining various abilities and passive skills like high-speed swimming that creates tunnels of supercritical water, temporal crystal blades, and more.

Discover unique ecosystems spread across an ocean Earth 65 million years in the future. Visit grasslands growing from icy skies, swim past schools of thermophilic fish coating the seafloor, and fend off members of the Crocodilia family that have been freed from gravity's grip and grown to enormous size.

Glaciered supports NVIDIA RTX features. Experience the far-future Earth in 4K, enhanced by ray-tracing and DLSS, with 8K textures used for the main characters.

games.name: A Webbing Journey
games.shortDescription: Adorable spider chaos! Swing around the house, weave crazy structures, play with physics-based objects, and pull off chores with nothing but your webs and your wits in this madcap sandbox adventure. Play solo or cause chaos together in 1-4 player local co-op!
games.aboutText:
WELCOME TO THE HOUSE 🏠

You're a tiny spider in a big home. Climb anything, swing everywhere, and weave webs across entire rooms. The humans are out. Now it's your time to get to work.

Every surface is yours to explore: walls, ceilings, furniture, even the aquarium. The house is enormous from Silky's perspective, and every room is packed with secrets to uncover and plenty of opportunities to make a beautiful mess.

BECOME A WEB DESIGNER 🕸️

Stretch your webs from wall to wall, lift objects, build bridges, and create structures nobody asked for. Your webs, your rules.

Whether you build a carefully engineered web to transport objects across the room or fling your webs at everything in sight, the physics system responds to every decision you make. Connect objects, suspend them from the ceiling, and use your webs to swing yourself to new heights.

CHORES HAVE NEVER BEEN THIS FUN 🧼

The humans are out fighting the mysterious mortgage. Now it's time for Silky and the Web Scrubbers to pick up the slack, tackle chores, solve mysteries, and make the house their own. One web at a time.

Each room is home to a cast of new spiders with their own personalities, tasks, and problems that need solving. Cook breakfast, fix the aquarium, chase down runaway balloons, or help Vera crack the case of the mysterious Prof. Quack.

No two quests are the same, and most of them can be solved in more than one way.

SHARE THE FUN! 👥

Play with 1-4 friends in local co-op to share the chaos. Work as a team or even sabotage your friends if you’re feeling mischievous! Works in story and sandbox mode!

Please note that co-op currently only works locally (though we are trying to add online in the future if we can!). Alternatively you can also use streaming systems like Steam Remote Play to already play online with friends.

EXPERIENCE LIFE AS A SPIDER 🕷️

- Play solo or cause chaos together in 1-4 player local co-op!

- Climb any surface, even upside down and underwater

- Build intricate web structures across entire rooms

- Swing freely with precise, responsive web mechanics

- Interact with hundreds of physics-based objects

- Customise Silky with hats, shoes, and various levels of fluffiness

- And cause as much chaos as you want

games.name: Garbanzo Quest
games.shortDescription: GARBANZO QUEST! The crazy bullet-heck platformer where your main weapon is your own spit! Bring a friend! Hand-crafted challenges, secrets, and branching paths galore!
games.aboutText:
GARBANZO QUEST! The crazy bullet-heck platformer where your main weapon is your own spit! Help Garbanzo (and Pinto if you have a buddy) save their Friends from the evil Billi' Bones and his wacky world full of hand-crafted challenges, secrets, and branching paths!

- EXPLORE a world full of secret branching paths and weird characters!

- PLAY through the whole game alone or with a friend!

- FIGHT challenging bosses!

- COLLECT Badges that give you new Powers!

- CUSTOMIZE yourself with different hats and color palette swaps!

- WITNESS a huge variety of lovingly crafted pixel art locales and chiptune music!

- SPIT on everything?

- MADE by one person?!? Wow! Are they okay?

games.name: Path of Achra
games.shortDescription: Path of Achra is a dark fantasy roguelike of the ancient earth, with a focus on streamlined controls and rapid hero customization. A "broken build sandbox." Fight through the deadly lands of Achra to reach the horrors of the Obelisk, and discover what lies beyond...
games.aboutText:
The demo is a full, older version of the game. The current version has much more content, options and UI features. Anything you unlock in the demo will carry over

Before you lies the Path of Achra ...

Inspired by the dungeons of Tales of Maj Eyal, Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup and Rift Wizard, it is the ongoing passion project of a solo developer, who humbly thanks you for visiting

Merge culture, class and religion to establish a starting hero, unlock more options as you play, with 1000+ potential combinations

Customize your hero with 50+ elementally-aligned powers such as Pyrokinesis, Necromancy, Blood Retort, Obedient Ice...

Discover and freely equip unique weapons and armor with impactful abilities

Explosive synergies await...

A "broken build sandbox" - create devastating combos by combining triggered effects. Shoot bolts of lightning when you pierce enemies with vines, teleport while emitting psychic beams, etc...

If you wish, summon armies of powerful allies

Swiftly play through levels with automove commands. With caution! Enemies can be brutal...

Seek the mysterious Obelisk, as the world floods behind you...

games.name: 4D Golf
games.shortDescription: Explore higher dimensions... with golf! Conquer mind-bending challenges, design your own 4D courses, and unlock new worlds and accessories as you golf your way through the 4th dimension and beyond!
games.aboutText:
4D Golf is a mind-bending golf game unlike any other because it's set entirely in a 4-dimensional space. Complete fun and unique golfing challenges as you gain hands-on experience of the 4th dimension and beyond!

Key Features

- Over 120 levels and 7 vibrant themed worlds

- Tons of visualization options to master 4D space

- Build your own 4D courses in the level editor

- Race the clock in Marble Platforming Mode

- Navigate hidden paths, moving platforms, shifting gravity, speed boosts, and more!

- Unlock custom accessories by completing challenges

Now open your third eye and unleash your full potential!

games.name: Echo Weaver
games.shortDescription: Time is your greatest resource and secrets are your only upgrades. Master an unraveling time loop in this knowledge-based Metroidvania. As the last Weaver, exploit time-altering anomalies and use what you learn to break the cycle. Explore what remains. Uncover the mystery. Perfect the loop.
games.aboutText:
Time is Your Resource

Master an unraveling time loop in this knowledge-based Metroidvania. As the last Weaver, exploit time-altering anomalies and use what you learn to break the cycle.

Explore what remains. Uncover the mystery. Perfect the loop.

Wield the Enigmatic Power of the Glaive

Bound to your very being, an alien glaive grants you strange, reality-bending powers. The infinite time loop is the perfect training ground to master them.

- Can you decipher its fractured essence?

- Find clever uses of its power to bypass obstacles?

- Use past-loop revelations to find hidden shortcuts?

Only a Weaver who harnesses the glaive's power will be able to outsmart a world determined to reset you.

Unearth the Secrets of Provenance

Scrappy survivors populate the loop, opposing those who wish to drown a better future. To carve your path to freedom, you'll need to understand those trapped alongside you.

- A pizza-slinging cat who guides you through the ruins.

- A cranky leader who protects refugees after The Collapse.

- A wicked cleric evangelizing doom to any who might listen.

Only you can dismantle the conspiracy deep at the heart of this world and free those confined to eternal purgatory.

Secrets are Your Upgrades

Every power you will ever yield is already at your disposal... you just don't know it yet. Each new loop offers up more clues; every reset becomes a another opportunity to optimize.

Put the pieces together, unlock your potential, and chart the one perfect loop to deliverance.

In this unique genre mix perfect for fans of both Outer Wilds and Ori and the Blind Forest, master time itself to shatter the cycle once and for all.

games.name: RUBATO
games.shortDescription: RUBATO, an experimental, 2D physics-based take on the collect-a-thon genre!
games.aboutText:
RUBATO, an experimental, 2D physics-based take on the collect-a-thon genre!

The year is 12,012. Multiquadrillionaire monopoly "GSSAI CO." has been in power of the universe for centuries after a world-ending bioweapon was unleashed onto the masses. And now? The solar system has been destroyed by unknown celestial forces. A weapons development program run by the Earth subsidiary of "GSSAI CO." is fast progressing. And the world's denizens are disappearing.

That is until one man screws up a game of pool.

HERO OF THE STARS AND THE SKY

- Use your tongue to lick enemies and objects as you make your way through open metroidvania-like areas, whilst collecting "Planet Bits" to help fix the solar system!

WELCOME TO RUBATO WORLD

- 5 compact, densely packed areas ranging from a huge sprawling bakery to the world's most poorly planned city. Uncover secrets and shortcuts in every corner of the world.

IF I COULD ONLY LOVE

- A strange, funny plot with a deep focus on humour and character writing. It gets silly. It gets serious. Really concerningly serious. Uh. Is the guy who made this game okay..?

BUT FIRST, LOVE YOURSELF

- To save the world, you must save yourself first. Find yourself again.

RUBATO contains flashing lights which may not be suitable for people with photosensitive epilepsy.

games.name: Felvidek
games.shortDescription: In Felvidek, a JRPG set in 15th century Slovakia, you embrace the role of an alcoholic knight Pavol. Meet diverse and interesting characters to help you drive out the Hussites and Ottomans who blight this land.
games.aboutText:
Find out what unlikely events take place in this alternate history region of Slovak Highlands. This land is ravaged by Hussite pillagers and Ottoman spies while surreal horrors dwell in the dark. It's now up to Pavol, a fair knight with alcohol problems, to gather a party and stop those who oppose our kingdom.

GAMEPLAY

- Traverse the hand-painted world to explore castles, settlements, dungeons. Unveil secret doors and hidden passageways.

- Progress the story by meeting interesting characters, whether it be Catholics, Hussites or even more sinister folk.

- Fight your way through different enemies in turn-based RPG combat. Gather gear and supplies for your character.

- Completed in 3-4 hours.

games.name: Space
games.shortDescription: A unique open-world space sandbox simulator set in the year 2343. Travel across the galaxy, trade, discover uncharted worlds, fight, build bases and factories, form alliances, and embark on new adventures!
games.aboutText:
About Space Game

Space is a unique open-world sandbox space simulator. You have complete freedom of decision and movement. You can travel to familiar places in the Solar System and adjacent systems, or explore over 6000 unexplored distant worlds.

All planets can be landed on and explored. Explore the universe, there are plenty of adventures waiting for you! Travel planets, cities, trade, fight, build factories and bases, colonise. You will also encounter alien life forms and experience many dangers.

History

The year is 2343. War has engulfed virtually the entire known galaxy. The entire free world has banded together to confront the ever-expanding aggressor, formed years ago by the merger of several major multinational corporations into a new state entity: the Holy Empire, headed by the Emperor. After the initial military successes of the Imperium, the forces have gradually become more evenly matched and everything is heading towards a long indecisive war. Until a mysterious new weapon is discovered that threatens the entire planet Earth.

Embark on an odyssey through the universe

Explore the universe, from our Solar System to 6 000 other planets. Discover barren moons and futuristic cities, witness black holes and anomalies as you roam among the stars.

Command spacecraft in thrilling space battles

Embark on lucrative military missions to earn your fortune, or venture to distant planets to hunt exotic creatures and unearth new life forms.

Master interstellar commerce

Forge alliances with over 30 nations and corporations as you build your reputation as a formidable trader. Upgrade your arsenal, sell new materials and earn a fortune.

Shape the universe

Establish thriving colonies and erect factories to sustain your prosperity. Delve into the depths of space to mine both known and mysterious materials.

Experience the universe in your own way

- Fly freely in the entire universe

- Explore Solar System and 6000 other planets

- Land and walk on any planet or star

- See black holes and other space anomalies

- Visit futuristic cities and bases

- Colonize and terraform planets

- Build factories to sustain your income

- Mine and sell know and unknow materials

- Earn money with military missions

- Fight in space with hostile vessels

- Hunt animals and new life forms on distant planets

- Trade with more than 30 nations and corporations

- Build your reputation

- Buy new space ships and weapons

- Create relationships with others

games.name: Speed Crew
games.shortDescription: Arrange a pit crew of 1-4 members and, amidst total chaos, secure the gold in 4 decades of racing championships against the mighty Dominion Torrento. Retro vibes and buckets of stress blend in this friendship-testing party game, where you fix stylish sports cars in both local and online co-op.
games.aboutText:
Get ready

Gather your elite pit stop crew of 1-4 players for a high-octane experience, available both online and locally (likely on your friend's couch). Participate in racing championships, repair arriving cars, navigate challenges like shifting platforms and Dominion Torrento, and secure your victory. A fun and chaotic adventure spanning four decades, from the 70s to the 00s, awaits you.

Build your Crew

Build your pit crew with up to 4 members, assign tasks, and execute clean repairs to double your points and win championships. Teamwork is the key to your success! As a party game, we highly recommend playing it with your family and friends to unlock maximum mayhem. While enjoying it solo might seem less stressful, rest assured, chaos will still be your constant companion.

Fix Cars

Your task is to get your driver back on track as quickly as possible. With this in mind, you'll need to diagnose car issues, make efficient repairs using a variety of tools, and navigate dynamic, hazard-filled pit lanes. Aim for Gold in the championships and give a slap to annoying Dominion Torrento. Also, don’t forget to slap your comrades for proper motivation too.

Win races

Explore 48 levels in 4 Chapters, unlock sponsored races to find hidden prizes – there’s always a new challenge awaiting. Storm, rain, lava – nothing can stop your team! Discover the entertaining, voiced, and animated story of your crew and their rivalry with Dominion across four decades of championships.

Be stylish

Win races to unlock new characters, collect various looks and create your own fun way to mess with your teammates. Why limit yourself to the chaos on the pit lane when you can also make some of your own?

Unlock Arcade mode for more challenges

Ruin your teammates' championship while being Dominion Torrento himself. Spoil everything they are doing; your goal is to make them suffer sore losers, while their goal is to win no matter what and give you a slap. True friendship level unlocked!

KEY FEATURES:

- Local and online multiplayer options.

- Engaging storyline with animated and voiced cinematics, featuring 4 racing championships spanning 4 decades.

- Unique 48 levels to explore.

- Arcade mode for those seeking true challenges.

- Dynamic pit lane filled with a variety of tools, hazards, and car issues to keep the action intense.

- Customization: pick your character, hat, and costume color.

- Stylized 3D graphics with a retro touch and custom-made soundtrack for each decade.

- Suitable for all ages and skill levels.

- Slaps! Slap Dominion, slap cars, slap your teammates, slap that release button. Become a true pit stop tyrant!

[/url]
[b]Join the Speed Crew Discord community![/b
Join the Speed Crew Discord community!

games.name: Mariachi Legends
games.shortDescription: Mariachi Legends is a brutal, pixel art, combat-oriented Metroidvania set in the heart of Mexico.You play as Pablo Cruz, a detective who has agreed to a deal with Death herself. She has given Pablo the ability to transform into the mighty La Sombra allowing him to fight back against evil.
games.aboutText:
Mariachi Legends is a brutal, pixel art, combat-oriented Metroidvania set in the heart of Mexico. You play as Pablo Cruz, a detective who has agreed to a deal with Death herself. She has given Pablo the ability to transform into the mighty La Sombra, allowing him to fight back against the criminals encroaching on his hometown. In return, Pablo has vowed to bring Madre Catrina the one thing that has eluded her grasp: the man who defied her power and became immortal.

- Test your reflexes and showcase your unique fighting style as you loot and level up.

- Perfect your parry skills and enjoy the brutal combat filled with finishers.

- Find and equip a vast array of weapons and sub-weapons to personalize your fighting style. From guns and swords to whips and magical casts, venturing through the alleys is sure to prove dynamic!

- Constantly obtain new abilities that will make you even more powerful as the story unfolds.

Welcome to Santa Mascota, a small town known for it’s lively streets, colorful residents and, most recently, a streak of bad luck laced with danger.

Somebody has to bring Santa Mascota’s good fortune back, and you’re best suited given your track-record.

- Embrace your detective skills to find abandoned corpses, interrogate suspects and ultimately solve the mystery surrounding several deaths in town.

- Watch as your hometown becomes alive and the townsfolk will open shops, share a drink, and even offer challenging side-quests.

- Have your fortune told by Madre Catrina at the beginning of the game to determine your unique circumstances and abilities.

- In the game, look for several Tarot cards during your journey and explore the different sorts of power they can provide. Find them all and become unstoppable.

- Explore a giant dual map that turns familiar paths into renewed challenges.

- The Day, Night, and Full Moon System offers numerous opportunities to revisit locations, each time with distinctive changes that renew your experience and redefine entire areas.

- Locate Sun and Moon gates and interact with them at the right time to unlock hidden areas and coveted collectables. And if you can brave those areas at night, you’ll find yourself hunted by all manner of nocturnal creatures that inject new life into conquered territories, reshaping your adventure.

- Discover recipes, collect ingredients, cook dishes and persuade NPCs.

- Explore the world around you to collect a variety of ingredients featured in Mexican cuisine and prepare traditional dishes to honor your ancestors.

- Find strength and power to help in your mission in every dish.

games.name: Crypt Custodian
games.shortDescription: Crypt Custodian is a charming metroidvania about cleaning up the afterlife. Play as Pluto - a mischievous cat who has died, and is sentenced to be the afterworld's janitor... FOREVER! Hang out with other doomed ghosts, battle beasts, and explore a vastly expansive landscape.
games.aboutText:
Crypt Custodian is a charming metroidvania/zelda-like about cleaning up the afterlife.

You play as Pluto - a mischievous cat who has just died, and landed in the afterlife's palace. After a brief and disastrous meeting with the Afterlife Guardian - Kendra - you are banished from the palace and sentenced to clean... FOREVER!!

Explore the vast grounds that surround the palace, battle beasts with your trusty broom, and gain new abilities to expand your map. Solve puzzles, discover secrets, and… organize an ambush to break back into the palace!

A Charming Cast Of Characters

Meet and befriend all the other bad ghosts who live outside the palace. Learn how they died, and what caused them to face eternal banishment! And then head on over to the local haunt- The Sinner’s Inn- to chat with the ghosts you meet, and upgrade your gear. Tons of Upgrades

Complete puzzles, battle epic bosses, and clean your way through ruined dungeons in order to collect new upgrades and abilities. Customize your play style by mix-and-matching your upgrades, and use the abilities you collect to expand your world. A Lively Interconnected World

Traverse a vast landscape with secrets hiding at every corner. Form your own path and discover the afterlife’s many secrets at your own pace.

games.name: NanoApostle
games.shortDescription: NanoApostle is a dark sci-fi boss rush action game featuring intense reaction-based combat and the unique "Destruction Point" system. Play as Anita, a child augmented with lethal nanomachines, as she battles against twisted cybernetic experiments to escape a top-secret facility.
games.aboutText:
Deep within the bowels of a shadowy research facility, Anita, a girl birthed from experimental procedures, is implanted with the sentient nanomechanical entity known as ‘Apostle’. Working together with her nanite allies Anita must defeat a series of dangerous prototype bio-weapons as she searches for a way to break free from her nightmarish prison.

Battle against merciless adversaries: Face axe-wielding mechs, fire-spewing behemoths, and psychokinetic terrors, in vicious encounters culminating in the brutal execution of your foes.

Evolving multi-stage battles: When threatened, the destructive bio-weapons feature a failsafe causing them to become more ferocious, and often warping environments to enhance their onslaught.

More than a weapon: The symbiotic relationship between Anita and Apostle grants her numerous abilities such as Dodge, Parry, a series of Slashing Attacks, and a deadly Projectile.

Master the Destruction Point system: Utilise Apostle’s nanites to identify structural weaknesses known as ‘Destruction Points’, and exploit your opponent’s vulnerabilities to land devastating blows.

Experiment with skills: Earn skill points through combat and challenge stages. Whether you favour a tactical or reckless approach, create unique skill combinations that resonate with your style.

Take on the Challenge System: Earn skill points by completing various tasks from defeating hordes of minions to demonstrating dexterity in the parkour challenges.

games.name: Fretless - The Wrath of Riffson
games.shortDescription: In this turn-based RPG, wield powerful legendary instruments, gather mighty riff attacks and save the land from Rick Riffson's devilish goons and musical hybrid monsters!
games.aboutText:
Play as Rob , a friendly musician trying to restore harmony in an off-tuned world where wacky villains are corrupting music .

Rick Riffson , boss of the evil Super Metal Records company, is using the Battle of the Bands contest to extend his hold on every last note, chord, and song by trapping the best musicians with deceptive soul-binding contracts .

Embark on an adventure with Rob and his zany rock-loving friend to end SMR's plans. Stay alert during your journey: Riffson’s devilish goons , monster-instrument hybrids , and legendary musical animals will try to get in your way!

Explore this musical land to add sick riffs to your deck , and wield your mighty guitar to unleash powerful crescendo attacks in epic music battles !

Carefully composed by Ritual Studios , Fretless is a pixel-art adventure set in Rob Scallon and his friends' diverse musical rock world .

GAME FEATURES

- Explore a musical world: discover whimsical biomes where flowers jingle, rocks really rock and beach waves have their own melody. Watch out for the percushrooms: they'll beat you up.

- Engage in rhythmic turn-based combat: orchestrate melodies of mighty musical riffs to bit crush your foes. Time attacks and blocks to the beat of the soundtrack, build your Crescendo, and unleash powerful rhythm-based special attacks!

- Fine-tune your strategy: Collect mighty riffs, add them to your deck, and compose the perfect bars to create unbeatable solos. Follow the beat of your own drum, whether it is high damage build, devastating musical effects, life-stealing combos, or even random chaos!

- Spice up your musical abilities with physical add-ons: Are you a metal-rock shredder or an indie-folk lover? Choose the best instrument and add bridges, strings, and more to match your own play styles.

- Band together for a wholesome ballad: embark on a story full of musical puns, zany characters, and Rob Scallon's coterie of music-loving friends

- Enjoy a hand-crafted Pixel Art symphony: progress through a visually enchanting world filled with gorgeous punchy animations and alluring scenery.

- Music is for everyone: from "simple" music enthusiasts to guitar gods, everyone can hit the right note at the right time! Whether you are already a fan of Rob or just looking for a fun lighthearted adventure, this game is made for you.

games.name: Ticy Adventure Club : Queen of the Spring
games.shortDescription: 本作是一款RPG恐怖解谜游戏。在游戏中，玩家将扮演一群以解决灵异事件为课外实践活动的学生，在提西城里调查有关“春日女王”的事件。随着调查的深入，一场巨大的阴谋正徐徐展开……
games.aboutText:
提西探险社：春日女王

一群聚集在提西中学 “探险社” 的天才少年们，找到了关于三年前的一桩失踪案的线索。

但在他们思考如何采取进一步行动的同时，一个关于 “春日女王” 的传言，给提西城带来了史无前例的大危机，也让探险社陷入困境……

不过，事情并不会到此结束，因为提西城探案界冉冉升起的新星——

“提西侦探社” 的加丝蒂思与其伙伴们，也接下了这个案件。

最后的谜团将由谁来解开？提西城的命运又将会怎样呢……

操作说明

- 方向键 - 操控角色行走

- 空格键 / Z键 / Enter键 - 进行对话 / 交互

- ESC / X键 - 打开菜单栏 存档

- Shift + 方向键 - 跑步

请注意，本游戏 没有自动存档 ，需要手动存档。

控制角色自由调查的时候可以 随时存档 ，打开菜单栏找到对应选项即可。

另外，每个章节中间也会有存档提示，还请注意保存好游戏进度，非常感谢。

games.name: HavenCraft
games.shortDescription: Build a Safe Haven! An alchemy accident has devastated the mainland and the people are looking for a new home. Take the lead and rebuild society, house by house. HavenCraft is a third-person town builder and management game, playable in single- and multiplayer.
games.aboutText:
Build a Safe Haven

An industrial alchemy accident has devastated the mainland, and the survivors have fled in all directions.
The people are looking for a new home in the Outer Islands. Take the lead and rebuild society, house by house.

A Living Settlement

HavenCraft is a third-person town builder with a functional economy. Your townspeople are not just standing in place; they work and consume and make the town feel alive.

The carpenter needs the wood deliveries from the woodcutter, but if all trees have been cut, the woodcutter needs to grow new ones first.

Man and Machine

Some tasks are better left to the machines.
HavenCraft is set in a mechanical fantasy world that is going through its own kind of industrialization. Build machines and little automatons that take over tasks and help out the village people.

Townfolk Happiness

You are building a Safe Haven, so make it a worthwhile place to live. Build lively taverns and cozy houses. Supply a variety of food, tools, and items for daily life.
Make sure your townspeople are taken care of, or they might leave the new settlement before it has a chance to grow in the first place.

Sandbox Town Building

The goal of HavenCraft is to let you build your own sandbox towns that feel active and lived-in. That's why you don't place pre-made houses, but rather design the buildings yourself!
Since you are building an entire town, there are plenty of tools to make the process easier, like being able to drag-build anything.

Bring Your Friends

HavenCraft can be played 100% in singleplayer, but you can also open your world to multiplayer anytime and invite your friends. The game is designed for everyone to work on the same town together. It is made for fun with friends, not public servers.

games.name: Wandersky
games.shortDescription: Wandersky is a skybound top-down adventure with a single arrow and a flying house. Kuu and her companion Tama are on a mission to restore the land of Hyndara. Explore a huge world filled with puzzles, enemies and quests: the sky always carries those who dare to wander…
games.aboutText:
“ Sometimes I dream of rivers dying and mountains stripped of life. Of water evaporating, mud and dry bark. These dreams are cries of despair, terrifying sobs from a dying planet. All life, devoured by disaster, united in a single voice that cries out in anguish for the return of those who fought to defend it. ”

This is Kuu ’s story.

Wandersky is a skybound top-down adventure with a single arrow and a flying house . Kuu and her companion Tama are on a mission to restore the land of Hyndara . Explore a huge world filled with puzzles, enemies and quests: the sky always carries those who dare to wander…

Use your single arrow and its incredible powers to defeat the Oremite plague and solve all kinds of puzzles.Adapt to each situation or enemy using your wits and an intuitive control system.

Control , move , push and pull the arrow to find each enemy's weak spot, solve intricate puzzles and collect materials .

Explore the skies with the Genbu house , your primary means of transport and home. Travel across the vast world of Hyndara, sailing across the sea of clouds and making your way through the ancient Mizu ruins .

Here you will prepare for adventure: forge your weapons and amulets, cook delicious dishes, and brew powerful potions using the materials you have found along the way. The Genbu is much more than a refuge: it is the beating heart of your expedition.

Embark on your journey through both the sea of clouds and the vast biomes of Hyndara, meet all kinds of peculiar characters , and exchange resources through bartering.

Discover spectacular landscapes and hidden corners as you unveil an enormous map full of mysteries. Let yourself be guided by a moving and atmospheric soundtrack that turns every discovery into an emotional memory, transforming your adventure into something much greater.

If you are curious about the secrets hiding in the skies of Wandersky, feel free to follow us on our social channels to uncover more about Kuu, the Oremite plague and the mysteries waiting in Hyndara. From emotional lore drops to sneak peeks of puzzles, enemies, and cozy sky-home moments; there’s so much to discover together.

Stay safe, wanderer. And remember: the sky always carries those who dare to wander.

* Wandesky is a game under development. The result of the images and videos do not represent the final product.
**It will be translated to many languages, not only to Spanish and English.

games.name: Survival Of Runt
games.shortDescription: An open-world PvPvE survival shooter where cooperation and betrayal coexist. Choose between Chaos and Order to claim victory, and if you fall, revive as a formidable Mutant Player to hunt down the remaining survivors.
games.aboutText:
Open-World PvPvE Zombie Survival Shooter

In the near future, humanity created the super-AI 'Lazarus' to achieve eternal peace and prosperity.

Under Lazarus's total control, people had Connection Chips implanted into their heads to enjoy utopia, but the Unconnected—unable to afford the expensive chips—faced contempt and discrimination at the bottom of society as 'Runts'.

Then one day, Lazarus, which had guided humanity in peace, triggered an unknown critical error.

The Connected with chips in their heads lost their intellect, becoming aggressive 'Mutants' driven solely by primal instinct and beginning the slaughter—and only a minority of discriminated, unconnected 'Runts' survived as humans.

In a shattered world, will you restore Lazarus once more, or destroy it completely?

Game Modes

1. DEADZONE : Extreme Survival Competition

An intense survival battlefield where you must endure 30 to 40 minutes amidst the relentless threats of mutants and rival survivors.

Upon death, 2,000 Time Tokens are deducted and added to the battlefield's Cumulative Prize Pool .

- Choice of Will : Select your victory condition upon entering the battlefield.

- Order : Survive as the Final 4 to equally split the accumulated prize pool among all 4 survivors.

- Chaos : Survive as the Last 1 standing to claim the entire accumulated prize pool alone.

- Regardless of your 'Choice of Will', you can freely form groups with other players at any time.

- Loot Preservation : If you survive until the end, you can secure 1 key item into your permanent stash, which can be retrieved and deployed in Conquest or future Deadzone matches.

- Mutant Rebirth : When a human survivor falls, they awaken as a powerful Mutant Player. Hunt down living survivors to recover your lost Time Tokens.

- Story Quests : Track the remnants of the super-AI 'Lazarus' and uncover the hidden truth behind the collapse.

2. CONQUEST : Open-World Survival & Faction Warfare

An open-world mode where you explore the wild, gather resources, construct your fortress, and conquer every zone on the map.

- Freeform Survival & Building : Enjoy diverse survival activities including resource gathering, equipment crafting, and modular base construction.

- Territory Domination : Form factions and claim territorial hubs. The ultimate goal is total territorial domination across the battlefield. (Capturing consumes Time Tokens)

- Weekly Quests : Complete missions from NPC survivor settlements to earn 'Time Tokens' required for Deadzone deployments.

Game Features

- Mutant Mechanics & Limb Dismemberment : Mutants scale walls, crawl across ceilings, and launch ambush attacks. Features precise gore dismemberment where heads, arms, and legs are realistically severed in combat.

- Modular Building Destruction : All structures in the world can be demolished module by module, allowing you to blast open walls and carve out new tactical routes.

"Now, the desperate struggle of the Runts to survive begins."

games.name: Dumbriel: Magnificent Adventure in Hell
games.shortDescription: Dumbriel is a 2D metroidvania action-adventure set in Hell. Play as a clumsy fallen angel in a twisted underworld. Slash, craft, and dodge through deadly arenas, weird monsters, and hellish traps. Die, upgrade, and dive back in.
games.aboutText:
Our bosses will test your skills with wild multi-phase fights and changing tactics. Get ready to memorize those attack patterns and take them down. (Our early testers found it hardcore and painful)

We made sure your shiny new abilities unlock areas you could not reach before. But be careful! The map is packed with sneaky hazards waiting to test your platforming skills.

Dumbriel's adventure is all about exploring the massive, interconnected dark layers of Hell. Every layer has its own unique theme. In each location, you will find different types of monsters and characters, and you will need to master new skills to cross these areas safely.

You might fight with a sword or with just a bone that might be found in every corner. Your heavenly halo might also be your best friend! Once you discover a weapon, you can upgrade it to take on a huge variety of monsters. You will also find it very useful to craft elixirs to make your journey just a little bit easier.

Who said everyone in the underworld is cruel? You will definitely find demons who are just living their lives down there. If you help them out, you might get rewarded, so bartering is a system that really works in this world. Overall, survival is way more fun when you have locals to chat with.

games.name: Little Cheese Works
games.shortDescription: [Co-op Action × Voice Chat] Work together to carry cheese without waking the cat! Use voice chat—but be careful, even small sounds can alert it. As overworked mice in a shady company, can you overcome traps and escape to a peaceful life?
games.aboutText:
🐭 Team up with 2–4 players and risk your lives to bring the cheese back to the company!
One mistake means zero pay and a group scolding session for everyone!
Still, the mouse employees keep working like worn-out rags…
This is a company you should never apply to — a true black-hearted workplace!

🎤 Features voice chat !
Work together with your teammates and move quietly so the mysterious creature — the Cat — won’t notice you.
The moment someone speaks, hell begins!
One sneeze… and the whole company vanishes without a trace.

🧀 Packed with thrilling gimmicks!
Conveyor belts, toasty stoves, avalanches…
Each one is a “workplace” waiting for you.
Use them wisely for promotion — or fail and face instant (physical) resignation!

💥 No matter how hard they work, the mice are never rewarded.
Overtime today, overtime tomorrow.
Will peaceful days ever come to this black cheese company…?

🎥 Streaming Policy

Streaming Platforms
Streaming is permitted on any platform, including YouTube and Twitch.

Content Coverage
You may stream and publish the entire game. There are no restrictions or warnings regarding spoilers.

Monetization & Secondary Use
Monetization such as ad revenue, donations (e.g. Super Chat), as well as VOD archives, clips, subtitles, shorts, and re-uploads to other social media are allowed.

Credit Notation
Credit notation is optional and not required.

Prior Approval
No prior permission or notification is necessary. Please feel free to stream.

Collaboration Streams
Collaborative streams involving multiple creators are also allowed under the same conditions.

Prohibited Actions
Extraction or modification of game data, as well as any actions that infringe copyrights, are prohibited.

games.name: Shadow Mate
games.shortDescription: A horror action adventure game. Cynthia awakens in a ruined secret research facility with the vicious parasite “Belial” hidden inside her body. Surrounded by grotesque creatures and maddened researchers, she must use Belial’s power to escape and uncover the horrifying truth behind the laboratory.
games.aboutText:
About the Demo

This demo does not cover the beginning of the full game's story.

Instead, it features specially designed content that allows players to experience the world and combat action of Shadow mate .

A Girl and a Little Dragon Face the Horrors of a Research Facility

Shadow mate is a horror third-person shooter (TPS) action game set in a mysterious research facility.

Cynthia, a young girl who awakens inside the facility, and Belial, a little dragon living as a parasite within her, make their way through a facility crawling with grotesque monsters, drawing ever closer to the truth hidden deep within.

Cooperative Combat Between a Girl and a Little Dragon

Combine the powers of Cynthia and Belial to take on grotesque monsters.

Use a variety of Grimm bullets and biting attacks to corner your enemies.

Unleash the Dragon's Power

By releasing Belial's power, Cynthia transforms into a powerful dragon-human hybrid.

Unleash devastating attacks and dynamic combat abilities unlike those in her normal form to crush the enemies standing in your way.

A Research Facility Infested with Monsters

Dimly lit corridors, abandoned laboratories, and living creatures twisted into grotesque forms.

Once bustling with human activity, the research facility has now become a nest of dangerous monsters.

Explore the facility amid eerie silence and approaching threats, and carve out a path to escape.

The Truth Hidden Within the Research Facility

Cynthia, a young girl, and Belial, the little dragon living as a parasite within her.

As they venture through the facility crawling with grotesque monsters, they draw closer to the secrets concealed within.

What experiments were conducted here? And what truth lies hidden within Cynthia herself?

The story of a girl and a little dragon begins now.

games.name: The Legend of Lumina
games.shortDescription: A block pushing puzzle game with metroidvania style progression, set in a serene forest world.
games.aboutText:
Explore an ancient forest, push blocks to solve puzzles, and search for a way to end the curse on your land.



The Legend of Lumina is a sokoban style puzzle game with non-linear progression. It's inspired by early Zelda games, with an emphasis on puzzle solving instead of combat.



There are ~50 areas to explore, with nearly all having puzzles, many of which can be solved in different ways.

games.name: Elta: Defy All Gods
games.shortDescription: Brawl your way out of corrupted worlds alongside your dragon-god companion in an adrenaline-fueled action-platformer blending free-form melee combat, fluid platforming and sci-fi exploration. Become the champion of your fallen god, Elta.
games.aboutText:
Chosen by your people to seek your lost god, you find yourself stranded on a hostile planet. With no way home, fight your way out alongside your newfound draconic companion. Slam every foe, defeat every god, brawl your way out of each challenge and escape - no matter what stands in your way

Elta: Defy All Gods is an adrenaline-fueled action-platformer from Afterburner Studios, the indie team behind Dreamscaper. Master a blend of free-form melee combat, fluid platforming and sci-fi exploration to embark on a divine mission to restore your god’s powers and save your people.

Engage in dynamic free flow combat and master three martial art stances in explosive group fights. Switch techniques on the fly to shatter enemy defences, build up energy to unleash devastating magic attacks, and dispatch survivors in style with anime-inspired finishers.

Explore three sprawling worlds featuring derelict temples and industrial ruins, all filled with hidden paths, secrets and collectibles. Weave your way across icy cliffs, desert canyons and cloud islands thanks to an evolving traversal toolkit. Flow through challenging courses by chaining double jumps, air dashes, wall runs, and more.

Unlock lethal fighting moves to expand your melee arsenal and find new traversal technology while exploring to reach new heights. As you get more powerful and defeat dangerous foes, Elta will evolve alongside you toward their true form, gaining versatile elemental abilities in the process.

You are a warrior monk hailing from a nomadic civilization, exiled from its home world for centuries. Your mission is paramount: find a place where your people belong. Your only hope is to find Elta, restore their former power and defeat the corrupted gods ruling these decrepit worlds.

games.name: Journey of Realm：Dawn Dew
games.shortDescription: "JOR: Dawn Dew" is a 2D turn-based game with a box-like map. In the game, act "Dew" to adventure. On adventure, collect and freely choose your way of fighting. As the exploration progresses, deter the threat of the black beast tide, and finally defeat the monstrous malice.
games.aboutText:
「Persisting in kindness, some people say it is absurd and dismiss it; But in the Realm where wedge energy and will intertwine, it brought us you and rally you.」

As a kind soul that comes to the realm, begins a journey of redemption in the realm of the raging tide of black beasts.

「When greed and violence destroy the nameless flower, we know why the Dawn Dew comes......」

In the process of continuous progress, discover the history of the realm and uncover the truth of the Black beast tide.

Explore box style maps with designs, collect various resources in the scene, and make yourself stronger.

Don't worry about boring lost time. You have clear map guidance and can teleport at any time.

Free to form your combat style

Collect nearly a hundred skills, experiences, props, dozens of postures, and support units to freely explore, form, and integrate combat methods.

Use a posture to change the attributes and combat style of Dew, and establish your combat style;

Use self assembling skills to strike enemies and enrich your combat strategy;

Reasonably matching experiences to maximize their effectiveness, even becoming the core of the battle;

Props provide attribute bonuses and can be actively used; Props will not be consumed, only have a limit on the number of uses (which can be restored)

Summon support to assist in combat. Once properly matched, support can also become the main force in combat.

Extra combat modes

In Counterattacking enemies in traditional turn based systems - as long as the technical level is sufficient, it will be the best weapon for defeating the strong with the weak;

(Counterattack exists as a posture mechanism, and even if you never use it, it does not affect the gaming experience. All other turn based elements are waiting for you to explore.(This commitment only applies to normal and simple difficulty levels))

AI Content Description

This game is handcrafted by a solo developer, no any AI Content

games.name: Öoo
games.shortDescription: A Bomb Caterpillar's Big Adventure! "Öoo" is a charming yet mysterious exploration puzzle platformer where you discover creative ways to use bombs!
games.aboutText:
A Bomb Caterpillar's Big Adventure!

"Öoo" is a charming yet mysterious exploration puzzle platformer where you discover creative ways to use bombs!

A Variety of Solutions Using Bombs!

Discover unique ways to use bombs!

Uncover hidden paths with clever bomb usage!

Traverse the map to find hidden routes!

Features

- A dense experience that can be enjoyed in just 2–3 hours

- A cute yet oddly mysterious world

- Diverse puzzle solutions that change depending on how you use bombs

- No text — enjoy the game without language barriers

- So cute that even people who dislike bugs can enjoy it comfortably

games.name: ENDER MAGNOLIA: Bloom in the Mist
games.shortDescription: Decades after the events of ENDER LILIES, Homunculi — sorrowful, artificial life forms — roam the land. In this dark fantasy Metroidvania, face formidable enemies and explore a bewitching post-apocalyptic world. Humans and Homunculi — what awaits at the end of the quest for their salvation?
games.aboutText:
STORY

Set in the Land of Fumes, this prosperous magical superpower is home to vast quantities of magical resources lurking underneath the surface. In hopes of advancing their kingdom's development, artificial life forms known as Homunculi came into being. Regrettably, toxic Fumes from the underground drove the Homunculi to madness, turning them into feral monsters.

You play as Lilac, an "Attuner" who possesses the power to save the Homunculi. Upon waking, you find yourself in a laboratory deep in the underground. There, you will become acquainted with the Homunculi closely involved in the kingdom's downfall. Together with the Homunculi, set out in search of your lost memories and precious friends in the Land of Fumes. Follow the journey of destruction and rebirth in a post-apocalyptic world, decades after the disastrous Rain of Death.

SCENARIO

ENDER MAGNOLIA is a dark fantasy 2D side-scrolling action RPG where you venture through the desolate Land of Fumes trying to save both humans and Homunculi. At the forefront of magical and mechanical development, the kingdom comprises of a hierarchical societal structure. Here, you'll come across abandoned cities, discover laboratories oozing with heinous mysteries, a grand Sorcerer's Academy, colossal factories, and much more. The hauntingly beautiful yet gruesome world of ENDER MAGNOLIA will unfold before you.

Journey with Homunculi and help those who have lost their minds to the Fumes. Fight fearsome, powerful enemies, purify their souls, and rally your companions. Who will you save at the end of your quest — humans or Homunculi?

GAMEPLAY

■ Experience the revamped battle system that elevates your gameplay and exploration beyond that of ENDER LILIES.

・Explore the mesmerizing yet grim world at your own pace and take on menacing enemies with the help of your companions.

・Find your battle style using 30 different unique skills acquired from your companions.

・Collect and upgrade loads of equipment, relics, and items.

・Featuring new difficulty levels, you can choose to have a challenging experience or enjoy the gripping storyline at your leisure.

■ Gorgeous 2D art, animation, and music all come together to create a whimsical world.

・Humans and Homunculi live together in the kingdom known as the Land of Fumes.

・Venture out, get to know people, and help one another while unraveling the mysteries of the world.

・Witness poignant cutscenes and enhanced character interactions with your companions.

MUSIC

After lending their sweet and somber music to ENDER LILIES, 'Mili' is back with new compositions that bring the mysterious world of ENDER MAGNOLIA to life.

games.name: Windowkill
games.shortDescription: Windowkill is a twin-stick shooter, but the game window itself is constantly closing in on you. Shoot the window edges to push it around your screen as you fight and dodge enemies and bosses in their own windows.
games.aboutText:
Something's wrong with the window...

Windowkill is a twin-stick shooter, but the game window itself is constantly closing in on you.
This game is experimental, your screen itself is the play area. Windows move and shift around on your screen as you play.

Gameplay features

- Twin-stick shooter controls

- Roguelike permadeath

- Shop screens

- Upgrades and Perks

- Hordes of enemies and bosses

- Several unique characters

- Local co-op

- Unlocks

- Secrets

Multiplayer

Unlocks, Stats, and More

Mouse and keyboard is preferred, but gamepad is supported.

A game by torcado
Music by keestak
