games.name: Parking Garage Rally Circuit
games.shortDescription: Retro Arcade Rally Racing... in Parking Garages?!? Precision driving with tight simple controls and arcade physics, all in a Sega Saturn style presentation
games.aboutText:
Retro Arcade-style Rally Racing in repurposed Parking Garages in big cities across the USA

You said "Parking Garage"?

The “Parking Garage Rally Circuit” tour comes into a city, selects a parking garage, and temporarily turns it into an exciting rally course for a week-long competition. Each track in the game is styled as a unique parking garage that has been turned into a race course.

Rally... Circuit?!?

This is a hybrid of Rally and circuit racing. From rally it draws the jumps and “one racer at a time against the clock” time-trial format. However, the tracks are similar to circuit racing, with each race consisting of multiple laps around the same track (the track may change slightly from lap to lap, however) Controls are very tight, simple and arcadey, similar to Mario Kart (accelerate, reverse, steer, drift), but with a bit more dynamic “smash into things” physics.

Seamless Leaderboards

After beating the gold trophy for a course, ghosts from other players just barely ahead of you on the leaderboard are automatically downloaded to race against, getting you into that "just one more" flow as you chase down rivals. Limiting the auto-download rivals to Steam friends only is also an option.

Realtime Multiplayer

Create or join a lobby of up to 8 players for realtime peer-to-peer non-contact racing!

Split-screen Multiplayer

Connect some controllers and relive the glory days of split-screen multiplayer for 2-4 players with contact and non-contact options.

Retro Style

Designed to look and feel like a long lost Sega Saturn game that could have been released in ~1998. This includes low-resolution, low-poly, chunky textures of course, but also extends to the audio, simple interface, and streamlined game scope. Oh, and CHEAT CODES too!

Walaber Entertainment games are made by humans, for humans, without the use of generative AI technologies.

games.name: Silent Planet - Elegy of a Dying World
games.shortDescription: Silent Planet is an exploration-focused, gothic sci-fi metroidvania rooted in Cosmic Horror. Explore the claustrophobic corridors of a massive underground complex filled with the remnants of technological and biological horrors created by a dead civilization.
games.aboutText:
The story takes place in the year 2997. You play as Apranik. Your mission is to travel to the planet Thulcandra in search of a crucial item: the Angel’s Egg, a very ancient artifact believed to be the source of all life in the Universe. You journey through the claustrophobic corridors of a massive underground complex filled with the remnants of technological and biological horrors created by a now dead civilization.

"What I witnessed could not be described. It seemed instead a convergence of nameless states collapsing into what cannot be comprehended: flesh and bones writhing and weaving into a turmoil of organic anarchy, appendages propelling the aberration toward me as it crawled upon an onyx, mucus-like substance which itself seemed endowed with life."

- Wield devastating melee and psychokinetic weapons to take down ruthless foes.
- Customize your survival through layered RPG systems and progression trees.

- Immerse in a deep, evocative story of rich lore and forbidden secrets.

- Navigate a hostile sprawling underground complex in eerie, solitary isolation.
- Experience finely tuned mechanics built for exploration, immersion, and replay value.

- Shape dynamic environments that react to your actions and choices.

- Uncover ancient artifacts revealing the lost chronicles of a forgotten alien civilization.

games.name: Fruit Mountain
games.shortDescription: Fruit Stacking Puzzle Game Connect the same types of fruit together to make them grow bigger and bigger! Stack them up without letting them overflow from the plate, and build your own Fruit Mountain!
games.aboutText:
Fruit Stacking Puzzle Game
Connect the same types of fruit together to make them grow bigger and bigger!
Stack them up without letting them overflow from the plate, and build your own Fruit Mountain!

[Easy to Play!]
Simply throw fruits and stack them on the plate.
Combine fruits of the same kind to make them bigger!
Game over if the fruits fall off the plate!

[Score Up]
The bigger the fruit, the higher your score!
Make chains for even higher scores!

[Ranking]
Compete with players from all over the world and test your skills.
Aim for a high score and keep challenging yourself!

games.name: 我的小鲨鱼
games.shortDescription: 来领养一只电子小鲨鱼吧！你可以在这里把它当作物品一样处置，并掌握它的一切。但请放心，无论发生了什么，电子小鲨鱼仍然爱你。
games.aboutText:
来领养一只电子小鲨鱼吧！

给它喂食、让它锻炼、看它睡觉，这一切看起来就像治愈快乐的宠物养成游戏一样。

尽管小鲨鱼是弱小的，面对一切都是无能为力的。

但请放心，无论发生了什么，电子小鲨鱼仍然 爱 你。

游戏总共包含11个普通结局和2个最终结局，根据你对小鲨鱼做过的事情，游戏将走向不同的结局。

来和小鲨鱼成为 朋友 吧！

【温馨提示】

本游戏含有黑暗与不适的内容，心脏疾病患者与精神创伤者可能不适合游玩。

games.name: Purble Place 3D
games.shortDescription: This is Purble Place 3D! - three exciting adventures in an updated classic! Create and win, just like in the good old days!
games.aboutText:
Step into Purble Place 3D , a colorful world of fun mini-games where every level challenges your logic, attention, and reflexes. Perfect for quick gaming sessions or extended family playtime, this game offers entertainment for players of all ages.

Three Unique Mini-Games

Make Pairs
Sharpen your memory and attention by finding matching pairs of cards.
**

Cakes factory
Bake the perfect cakes by choosing the right ingredients and combinations. Boost your strategic thinking and hand-eye coordination as you decorate each sweet creation.
**

Clothes Shop
Solve logical puzzles and assemble the correct sets to earn points.
**

Game Features

- Simple, intuitive gameplay suitable for players of all ages.

- Vibrant 3D graphics and smooth animations bring each mini-game to life.

- Mini-games increase in difficulty, offering a constant challenge.

- Play quick sessions or dive deep into the world of Purble Place 3D for hours of fun.
**

About the Game

Purble Place 3D is an original game built from the ground up, inspired by the nostalgic charm of early 2000s mini-games.

All characters, mechanics, and design elements are original and not affiliated with any external brands or companies.
**

games.name: Hollow Floor
games.shortDescription: Hollow Floor is an exploration-based single-sitting Metroidvania inspired by VVVVVV and REDDER. Hollow Floor is a relaxed game that is full of secrets and hard challenges that can be tackled at any moment in the game or completely ignored.
games.aboutText:
Hollow Floor is an exploration-based single-sitting Metroidvania inspired by VVVVVV and REDDER. Hollow Floor power-ups are based on adding movesets that will expand the player's ability to explore all three different dangerous biomes. Hollow Floor world is full of secrets and hard challenges that can be tackled at any moment in the game or completely ignored. All you need to finish is to collect any number of power gems to power up the portal and escape this dangerous dimension.



Controls:

- Arrows: Move

- X: Special/Respawn

- X + Down: ????



Features:

- Single-sitting Metroidvania where you can finish it in an hour.

- 99 optional coins to collect which provides extra challenges for challenge seekers.

- Secret passages and shortcuts to explore the whole world.

- A huge world with more than 100 rooms to explore.

- Powerups change the way you play and traverse the full world.

- Three different main biomes that feature different game mechanics and challenges related to them.

- A final biome where the player can test their skills acquired during the previous three biomes.

- Finally, the game doesn't contain any time restrictions which allows for more relaxed play.

games.name: Dumb Ways to Party
games.shortDescription: The world’s dumbest party game is here! Play as your favorite Bean, and go head-to-head with up to three other players to become the Dumbest of the Dumb. Will you use skill, sabotage or sheer dumb luck to win?
games.aboutText:
Dumb Ways to Party throws contestants into the The Dumbest of the Dumb game show - a whirlwind of wacky challenges, hilarious mishaps, surprise twists, big wins and even bigger fails!

The challenge? Out-dumb the competition and take home the prestigious title of Dumbest of the Dumb!

Are you here for glory? Fame? Or just to make a fool of yourself? Let’s find out!

MINI-GAME MAYHEM

40 outrageous Mini-games to hurl at contestants, each one as wild and unpredictable as the last!

PARTY WITH YOUR FRIENDS

Whether you're playing solo or with up to three other players, the thrill of victory fuels the fun… and competition. Let the sabotage begin!

HILARITY IN UNCERTAINTY

Game Show Moments will completely shake up the round! One minute you’re close to victory, then, BAM! An item with chaotic effects leads to your comical downfall.

Whether you're playing or watching the chaos unfold, dumb fun is guaranteed!

FEATURES

- Four player action awaits in couch co-op and online multiplayer - get ready for wacky head-to-head challenges!

- Play as iconic Dumb Ways characters, such as Numpty, Botch and Clod, each bursting with their own quirky personality.

- Use a variety of items to make every Mini-game even dumber than before!

- Compete in the Game Show mode or enjoy non-stop action with back-to-back Mini-games in Freeplay.

- Pick up and play mechanics that keep the fun and competition centre stage!

- Experience the beloved Dumb Ways art style, reimagined in vibrant 3D.

games.name: Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo
games.shortDescription: Are you ready for the first Yoyovania?! In this 2D top-down adventure you'll explore a sprawling urban landscape, reinterpreting your surroundings through your mastery of yoyo tricks. Navigate the city's many districts, fight rival crime bosses, and regain the influence of the Pipistrello family!
games.aboutText:
Explore a vast urban landscape in this exciting 2D top-down platforming adventure!

Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo combines combat, platforming action, puzzle-solving, and exploration — all enveloped in a delightful character-driven story about corporate shenanigans! Face off against the rival crime entrepreneurs and their underlings using the weapon you know best: your prized yoyo! With Yoko Shimomura contributing as guest composer, you're in for a truly authentic nostalgia blast!

Pay close attention to your surroundings to discover new ways to traverse the terrain! With each newly-learned yoyo trick, you'll come to reinterpret the cityscape, and by chaining these maneuvers together, you'll be able to dexterously reach places you could never have imagined! Many challenges have multiple solutions — so come up with your own novel routes in this mouth-watering adventure!

Features

- Explore the city's 4 districts with over 1000 screens' worth of challenges and secrets!

- Infiltrate the businesses of the 4 crime bosses! Navigate their labyrinthine buildings, take on foes, and solve action puzzles!

- Master over 10 yoyo tricks and Special Moves to create your own yoyo-parkour routes and pulverize your enemies in combat!

- Collect over 40 equippable Badges that alter the way you play!

- Unlock over 20 passive Upgrades through a shady loan shark!

- Find over 80 other collectibles throughout town, from life upgrades to precious treasures!

Corporate shenanigans abound!

Pippit, the self-declared yoyo master, has never meshed well with the rest of his family: the powerful and influential Pipistrellos, headed by his auntie, Madame Pipistrello. The family's had a firm grip on their city for over a decade, owing to the monopoly on electricity that they hold.

It just so happens that, when Pippit finally drops by for his annual visit to the Pipistrello Manor, he gets caught up in the rival companies' nefarious plot to dethrone the Madame and take the source of energy generation for themselves! After the attack, Pippit and the Madame find themselves having to cooperate in a completely new arrangement......

The Big City

Your journey takes place across a huge, bustling city run by rival crime entrepreneurs. From shopping districts to industrial complexes, to a geek culture convention and a sports-addicted neighborhood, you'll track down these dastardly crime bosses that have challenged your own family's dominion over the city!

Get ready for the first Yoyovania!

It never hurts to be on the lookout for secret nooks and crannies! Carefully explore the city's districts with the aid of your map, and carve your own path towards the bosses' places of business! Venture into their dangerous lairs, crack puzzles, and be prepared for epic showdowns!

games.name: Sojourn Past
games.shortDescription: Sojourn Past is an exploration game, a journey of finding hope in the face of adversary. Set in a handcrafted world, discover it’s mysteries, overcome its tough bullet-hell inspired challenges and embrace hope in this action-adventure.
games.aboutText:
Sojourn Past is an exploration focused action-adventure about overcoming loss.

Journey through an intricately connected world as you embark on a path of adversity and growth. Overcome its many bullet-hell inspired challenges, uncover secrets, discover hidden paths, and awaken new abilities along the way.

MASTER UNIQUE ABILITIES

Master abilities like the teleportation dagger to break through enemy lines, escape danger, or reach otherwise inaccessible places.

EXPLORE AN INTERCONNECTED WORLD

Venture through a seamlessly connected world filled with handcrafted environments. Uncover hidden routes, discover powerful artifacts, and unlock new paths and abilities to traverse it.

BULLET-HELL INSPIRED COMBAT

Dash, dodge, and fight your way through intense bullet-hell inspired combat that tests your abilities.

FIGHT CHALLENGING BOSSES

Engage in fast-paced, skill-based combat against challenging enemies and difficult bosses that push your skills to the limit.

UNCOVER SECRETS AND HIDDEN MYSTERIES

A world of discovery awaits those who look deeper.

FROM A SMALL TEAM

A passion project from our small indie team at ReDimension.

games.name: BattleCap
games.shortDescription: Dive into an exhilarating maritime battle for 1 to 4 players! Assemble warships with a variety of bottle caps, allowing the warships to transform and break, experiencing flexible physics that brings a refreshing maritime battle! Fight monsters together, or engage in a battle with your friends.
games.aboutText:
BattleCap is a casual naval combat shooting game suitable for 1 to 4 players. Come on, become a top BattleCap sailor, pick up the caps floating on the sea, and assemble your own battleship! Engage in thrilling battles with friends or join forces to defeat those furious sea monsters, enjoying the endless fun of the clash of various warships and tactics!

Collect Caps and Naval Combat Shooting

Bid farewell to the rigid control of traditional naval warfare; the Nymph's battleship offers a refreshing experience. The operation is simple, allowing you to master it in just a few minutes!

Gather the scattered caps, glue them into a powerful turret, and craft a giant battleship capable of extending and transforming!

Three Major Battle Zones, Diverse Maps

From mysterious ruins to devilish whirlpools, experience a variety of environmental features and tactical shifts. Utilize the scene's mechanisms to gain an advantage!

Roguelite Elements Throughout the Party

Want to be stronger? Acquire powerful caps from airdrops or purchase blessings and relics from the store to bestow more special abilities upon your battleship!

Cap Party (Party PVP Mode, Multiplayer only)

- In the Party PVP mode, experience the intense and exhilarating three-round tournament, challenging multiple meticulously designed map stages.

- The selection of your battleship and the random map will jointly determine your subsequent tactical strategy—will you charge recklessly or develop cautiously?

- Also, look forward to the mid-game mini-games that could spike your blood pressure!

Sea Monster Fishing (Cooperative PVP Mode, Single Player or Multiplayer)

- Even more Roguelite elements: Collect rare blessings and relics to fortify your BattleCap flagship and embark on an unprecedented naval battle!

- Defend the Nymph's camp against waves of enemy assaults!

- In addition to solo challenges, you can also invite friends to collaborate, sharing the pressure from the sea monsters and offering mutual support.

Join BattleCap now and assemble your battleship!

games.name: Trizna
games.shortDescription: “Trizna” is a classic plot-driven 2.5D metroidvania filled with intense battles utilizing the unique features of weapons, evasions, parries, and counterattacks. Explore the mysterious and eerie realm deeply intertwined with pagan beliefs, with blade, magic and a keen mind.
games.aboutText:
The Game

A nameless fallen warrior, not buried according to the rite and raised by a powerful ancient witch, becomes a mindless tool to help her achieve goals hidden behind an arcane veil.
By exploring the world and becoming stronger, the hero will get an opportunity to gain will and start to pursue his own goals, willingly side with the witch or her equally obscure opponents, or remain a puppet, driven by the will of ancient forces.

The world of the game is a hidden domain of embodied ideas, the materialization of mythological tropes, human fears and aspirations that have taken on flesh.
A crucial part of the plot and gameplay will also be the Shadow Realm - the unstable state of this world, where fears and aspirations are not yet fully realized and formalized.
The setting is inspired in many aspects by Slavic culture and mythology. Features

- A world tailored from several radically different settings, allowing you to freely move between locations to advance through the plot, explore and find secrets.

- At any moment hero is able to shift to the Shadow Realm - an unstable and distorted state of the world, inhabited by even stranger creatures, allowing one to overcome otherwise impassable obstacles and hiding many treasures and answers to questions.

- Intense combat based on the search and exploitation of enemy weaknesses and use of different combat techniques, including dodging, rolling, blocking, parrying and using the features of various types of weapons.

- Special acquired skills that will not only allow you to overcome previously impassable obstacles, but will also be woven into the combat system, expanding the arsenal of available techniques and their combinations.

- Secrets stuffed with secrets with a secret sauce.

- A modular equipment system that includes body armor, helmets, arm and leg armor, amulets, shields, one-handed, two-handed and ranged weapons.

- A system for developing combat and magical skills that allows you to form your preferred fighting style.

games.name: Lost Call
games.shortDescription: Lost Call is a top down pixel art 2D Zelda inspired game with a metroidvania style map. Take off on a quest through an abandoned and ruined town to stop your phone from ringing all the time, and learn more about the characters who still remain within it.
games.aboutText:
Embark on a quest to stop your phone from ringing all the time in Lost Call, a top down Adventure inspired by classic 2D Zelda games and Metroidvanias. In order to disable all nearby cell towers, you will find yourself traveling through many distinct areas, fighting strange and fearsome creatures, and making use of ordinary household objects in order to reach your goal of some peace and quiet.

Explore and uncover your own path

- Find your own unique route through a vast open map, with many possible paths

- Unlock shortcuts, uncover secrets, and find new areas in unexpected places

- Collect abilities to reach new areas, and find helpful upgrades

Master unconventional means of combat and movement

- Collect items with more than one use, assisting both with fights and travel

- Ring your phone and fling hair elastics to deal damage, and push enemies around with a hair dryer

Meet friendly characters and discover your own story

- Uncover memories from your past, and collect your discarded poetry

- Meet a wide range of characters, left behind in a broken town

- Attempt to solve the mystery of a missing explorer by searching for tape recordings

games.name: Platypus Reclayed
games.shortDescription: A clay animated shoot-em-up focused on swarming enemies, numerous weapons, and end of level bosses, Platypus Reclayed marks the return of Anthony Flack to his classic hit, combining fun single and 2 player co-op gameplay, retro tunes, and physical stop-motion artwork into a game for all to enjoy.
games.aboutText:
Platypus Reclayed is the highly acclaimed, clay-animated arcade shoot-em-up from original Platypus creator Anthony Flack. The family friendly cult classic returns with full high definition artwork physically rebuilt from scratch, along with new content, a glorious Retro64 chiptunes soundtrack, and full modding support. With multiple game modes, official mods including a 4:3 as-is remake of the original Platypus, as well as single and 2 player co-op support, it's the definitive version of the handcrafted indie original.

The once-thriving metropolis of Colossatropolis is now bursting at the seams. Towering skyscrapers dominate the skyline, while pollution chokes the air - and parking is a nightmare. Desperate times call for desperate measures, and Colossatropolis sets its sights on neighbouring Mungola for expansion. But little do they know, Mungola isn't going down without a fight. The legendary F-27 "Platypus" are the Mungolan people's last hope for freedom.

KEY FEATURES

- Clay animated stop-motion graphics made using classic physical techniques

- Multiple game modes across 25 different areas

- 2 Player co-op simultaneous action

- Official mods including an as-is remake of the original Platypus

- Adjustable difficulty settings, including an easy mode for all age range accessibility

- Perfect for the entire family

The original handmade shooter!

games.name: OneShot: World Machine Edition
games.shortDescription: A completely self-contained portable version of one of the highest user-rated games. Built on an entirely new engine with new UI, support for Steam Deck, & more. Features world-bending puzzles, intriguing denizens, surreal environments, and a captivating story about the truth of the game's reality.
games.aboutText:
A rebuilt version of the acclaimed puzzle adventure game, now playable on Steam Deck and Windows!

OneShot, one of the highest user-rated titles on Steam, has been completely rebuilt for modern portable consoles. With an entirely new engine, new UI, new hidden collectibles, support for more platforms, and more, OneShot WME features world-bending puzzles, intriguing denizens, surreal environments, and a captivating story that reveals the truth of the game's reality.

Players will interact with a strange computer operating system--a window into an alternate world. Together with Niko, a child who is also a stranger to this place, they work to rekindle the long dead sun and – hopefully – save everyone.

But remember, you only have One Shot.

Features

- Puzzles that require you to explore both the reality Niko inhabits, as well as your own.

- Original Soundtrack from Nightmargin, ft Eliza Velasquez and GIRakaCHEEZER

- Charming Pixel Artwork courtesy of Nightmargin and GIRakaCHEEZER

- NEW For World Machine Edition: Character Profile "Friends" Gallery, with bonus writing by Noxid

- NEW For World Machine Edition: Cutscene Art Gallery

- NEW For World Machine Edition: Colorful Wallpapers for the World Machine desktop, featuring many guest artists

- NEW For World Machine Edition: Music Box

- NEW For World Machine Edition: Full Analog Movement Control support

- NEW For World Machine Edition: Support for Steam Deck!

games.name: Cultivation Realm: Card Survival
games.shortDescription: Cultivation Realm: Card Survival is a cultivation survival game built around card-based interactions. Trapped in a mysterious realm that drains your lifespan but brims with spirit power, you must cultivate, survive, fight, and find a way to escape.
games.aboutText:
Cultivation Realm: Card Survival is a cultivation survival game built around card-based interactions. Trapped in a mysterious realm that drains your lifespan but brims with spirit power, you must cultivate, survive, fight, and find a way to escape.

- Explore different areas, including lakeside plains, dense forests, scorching deserts, and volcanic lands. Each area has its own Five Elements attributes, resources, and harsh weather conditions.

- Built around card-based interactions, the game lets you use resources such as Wooden Sticks and Stone to craft tools and buildings. Gather Mushrooms, Clams, Citrus, and other ingredients to cook meals and unlock more recipes. You can also collect spirit herb seeds and cultivate your own Spiritfield.

- The outside world has long been depleted of Spirit Power, while the Illusion Realm is rich with it, greatly increasing the speed of cultivation. Train here, and you may even break through to the realm of a mighty cultivator. Meditate to cultivate, study cultivation manuals to learn new Arts, and once you break through to a higher realm, you will no longer need food or rest. Refine pills and weapons to strengthen yourself, then slay Heart Demons and demonic beasts.

- In the Illusion Realm, every item affects the Five Elements. The Five Elements, in turn, influence a cultivator’s Spiritual Root. To break through to the next realm, cultivators must meet the required Five Elements conditions and practice the corresponding Arts.

- A realistic survival system built around a mortal’s path to cultivation. You must manage mortal needs such as Wellness, Hunger, Stamina, and Sleep, while also keeping a close eye on cultivation-related attributes like Mood, Spirit Qi, and lifespan. If negative states persist for too long, Heart Demons may invade, and your path to cultivation may come to an end.

- Resources in each area are not endless. As time passes and you continue exploring, resource yields will dynamically change. If you fish too often by the lakeside, you will need to wait for the fish to reproduce. Old Gourds may dwindle from near extinction to complete disappearance. Plan your resources as carefully as possible.

- Survival pressure comes not only from your own condition, but also from the demonic beasts that arrive with the Blood Moon. Gather resources, refine Pills and Artifacts, and keep cultivating to survive in the Illusion Realm.

- The game features hundreds of cards for Tools, Buildings, Cooking, and Equip, divided into Outer Sect Tools and Celestial Crafting Artifacts. Together, they cover the items you need for both survival and cultivation. You can also experiment with using and combining different cards. For example, Stone can be sharpened against a Boulder to create a Stoneblade, or combined with Wood to build a Campfire.

games.name: AOKAKI
games.shortDescription: A disgraced ronin returns to his homeland to find it ravaged by war. Taking up his sword once more, he must battle through the feudal forces of the shogun and take on foes he once called friends. Parry, pogo, and dash your way through a land of insect samurai in this platformer.
games.aboutText:
Take on the role of Aokaki, a tokusatsu inspired ronin that must travel through a huge feudal land facing outlandish insect enemies both great and small. Upgrade your isopod ronin, rebuild your homeland, and parry and pogo your way to victory.

Features

Parry, Deflect, Strike!

Use a blend of samurai techniques to vanquish your foes. Deflect ranged attacks, parry blows to build up a powerful counter-attack, and strike when your enemies are most vulnerable.

Platform and Puzzle

Pogo from enemies, torches and spikes to reach ever greater heights. Dash to avoid traps and propel through the air. Curl yourself into a bouncing, speeding ball to unlock secrets and solve puzzles.

A Beautiful Pixel World

Explore this feudal, insect inhabited world with adorable allies and frightening enemies. Every area is lovingly crafted after feudal inspired settings and backdrops. Find all the secrets of this Japanese-inspired land as you rebuild it from ruin.

games.name: Cat Bait
games.shortDescription: Cat Bait is a casual game with cute pixel graphics. Control the Cat Bait, dodge enemies, and use the unique abilities of helper cats.
games.aboutText:
Get ready for exciting battles in the world of Cat Bait , a casual game with cute pixel graphics inspired by Vampire Survivors and Brotato ! Control the brave Cat Bait , dodge hordes of mice and other rodents while your loyal helper cats destroy enemies with their unique abilities.

Main Features:

- Unique Helper Cats: Each helper has its own special abilities and characteristics. For example, summon the Druid Cat to slow down enemies with roots and deal periodic damage. And who said you can summon only one helper?

- Upgrade System: Upgrade your helpers during each run. Increase damage, add more projectiles, and unlock other unique upgrades for each cat.

- Meta-Progression: Collect coins from defeated enemies to upgrade your character and helper cats between runs, making each new attempt more powerful.

- Skins and Abilities: Unlock new skins for the Cat Bait that not only change the appearance but also add new active abilities. For example, the standard skin allows repelling enemies.

- Epic Bosses: Fight unique bosses, like the mouse rider on a rat. Each boss has its own set of moves and attacks, making each battle unpredictable.

- Interesting Locations: Choose from various locations, each offering its own challenges and variety of enemies. Start with an empty character and choose your first helper cat to begin the adventure.

- Session Gameplay: Short gaming sessions make it easy to jump in and out of the game, continuing from the same wave you stopped at.

Fight waves of enemies, upgrade your helper cats, and conquer all locations in Cat Bait . Are you ready to take on the challenge and become a true hero among cats?

games.name: Unless
games.shortDescription: Challenge yourself and master 4 Distinct worlds with 66 finely tuned level screens and climb to the top of the Steam Leaderboards in this retro pixel art speedrunning platformer!
games.aboutText:
The Forest of Worlds is withering, and along with it; the creative spark of every living thing. Venture into fantastical levels, gather the Golden Leaves within, and use them to avert the fate of a world devoid of imagination!

Tackle 66 finely-tuned screens built for newcomers and speed-runners alike.

Collect Crystal Berries by clearing levels quickly to unlock Bonus Levels .

Race for the World Record using a dedicated Speedrun Mode to display an in-game timer, speed up level transitions, and auto-skip dialogue sequences.

Generous checkpoints and a co-operative Assist Mode help players of all ages and ability see everything the game has to offer.

Unlock Shuffle Mode to randomize level connections and Leaf positions. Share seeds and race friends, or try to top the leaderboard of the Daily Challenge .

Unless also includes the following accessibility features:

- Adjustable Game Speed

- Customizable Inputs

- Tweak jump and wall-cling behaviour

- Font selection and Text scaling

- High contrast UI & reduced distraction modes

Discuss the game, share record-breaking runs, and be the first to get news on the development of Unless!

JOIN OUR DISCORD via the invite link in the right sidebar.

games.name: Janosik 2: Prologue
games.shortDescription: Pick up the mantle of the plucky maiden getting ready for her date night that is unceremoniously interrupted by the dastardly duo of Countess Bathory and Baron de Blonde in this prologue to the colourful Janosik 2 retro action-platformer…
games.aboutText:
Janosik 2: Prologue is an introduction to "Janosik 2", presenting a separate story that takes place right before the events of the main game.

Take on the role of Janka, Janosik's beloved, who is getting ready to meet up with her boyfriend. Little does she know that her plans are about to be disrupted by the evil Baron de Blonde, acting on behalf of the even more wicked Countess Bathory.

Use Janka's abilities to overcome various obstacles and enemies.

Metroidvania-style gameplay allows exploring previously visited locations to discover new secrets and bonuses through newly acquired skills. Features:

- Play as Janka: Step into the shoes of Janka, Janosik’s beloved, on an exciting adventure

- Unlock New Abilities: Gain powerful abilities like double jump, freezing enemies, dashing through air, illuminating darkness, and wall climbing, with the help of Baba Yaga and her shop

- 8 Challenging Levels : Explore 8 unique levels filled with challenging obstacles and deadly enemies

- Metroidvania-style gameplay: Revisit previously explored areas and uncover hidden secrets and treasures with the help of newly unlocked abilities

games.name: Leap Year
games.shortDescription: Leap Year is a clumsy platformer about knowledge and discovery. Explore a compact, hand drawn world filled with hidden paths. Understand the game’s secrets to reach new areas and collect all the pages of your calendar.
games.aboutText:
Leap Year is a clumsy platformer about knowledge and discovery.

Explore a compact, hand drawn world filled with hidden paths. Understand the game’s secrets to reach new areas and collect all the pages of your calendar.

Features

- About 2 hours of playtime

- 40+ rooms

- 6 audio tracks

- 12 Steam achievements

- Dancing friends

Leap Year was commissioned by Sokpop Collective, an indie game studio from the Netherlands who create playful, experimental games for $3 a month.

games.name: Rat Quest
games.shortDescription: In this platformer, jumping will be your main mechanic as you climb the level, each jump matters, if you miss a jump, you have to restart. You may be small but so are the platforms.
games.aboutText:
About this game: Rat Quest is a game about a rat platforming up the level to get his sweet sweet cheese.

Difficult platforming:

The platforming in this game is very difficult! Every jump matters, if you fall, its right back to the bottom.

Not as it seems: everytHing is finE, no reason to worry in the sLightest. very Pleasant game.

games.name: Bang Bang Barrage
games.shortDescription: Survive the treacherous sea in this quirky multiplayer shooter game! Play solo or team up and fight off Cthulhu's minions. Master a unique recoil-based mechanic to blast enemies and chart your course. Mix and match upgrades to craft the perfect sea-surviving strategy!
games.aboutText:
You've awakened the Unnamable, and now hordes of enemy minions encircle you! Take aim, shoot them down, and use the recoil to dodge for your life! Your power grows over time, yet hallucinations and visions never cease. Will you navigate your way out of these treacherous waters? Caution Survival Tips:

- Fire at anything that looks suspicious (even if it appears friendly).

- Your guns won't misfire, but their recoil might backfire.

- Avoid unnecessary physical contact.

- Embrace moments of unexpected wonders.

- Swapping outfits might cause illusions (stay calm if this happens).

- Team up with your allies (or "drag-ons") for thrilling adventures!

- Facing off against Cthulhu? Well, there's a slim chance of success... fingers crossed!

P.S.: A kiss from your friend can bring you back to life (in-game only).

games.name: Slash/Jump
games.shortDescription: How do you platform if walking and jumping aren't an option? With a sword of course! Bounce and slash your way through this short and sweet, uniquely controlled precision platformer!
games.aboutText:
Using your sword as your only method of traversal, jump and slash your way through obstacles and hazards to master this unique platforming movement system!

Use the recoil from your sword swings to get from place to place and figure out the complexities of these deceivingly simple controls. Features:

- A simple 2 button + Joystick control scheme

- Controller rebinding

- No walking!

- A short and sweet 20-40 minute experience

games.name: HARK THE GHOUL
games.shortDescription: Emerge from a cocoon under the light of an ominous star. Just who were you before your rebirth? HARK THE GHOUL is a first-person dungeon crawler based on freeform exploration and discovery, set in an amber-crazed city full of secrets, shortcuts, and adversaries.
games.aboutText:
Make use of your equipment and ingenuity to traverse a twisting, interconnected world filled with secrets and shortcuts. Throw yourself down a mine shaft, barter passage through the Ratman’s Horrid Holes, or get lost in the Sacred Marsh’s eerie fog… You’re free to wander wherever your adventure takes you.

Wield swords, whips, pistols, cannons, magicks, and your mighty kicks to overcome your adversaries and reach places you shouldn’t. Each tool in your arsenal features a dynamic moveset: grapple enemies with your harpoon gun, plant your spear in a wall to use it as a platform, stack boxes created out of thin air, or dream a bridge with the puff of a pipe.

The Astre’s foreboding light illuminates a city driven mad by amber-sickness, but some still retain their sanity. You will meet peculiar allies, face ghastly monstrosities, and square off against daunting bosses as you seek out your past life and fulfil your mysterious purpose.

HARK THE GHOUL is a neo-gothic love letter to the graphics and games of a bygone era, complete with customizable visual filters and a 72-page in-game artbook with developer commentary.

games.name: Blasterbug: Last Bug Standing!
games.shortDescription: Bzz bzz! Hop in chaotic bomb-fueled battles inspired by arcade action classics we all love! Blaster up to 8 players locally with ant-astics Pome-grenades in this bomb-em-up party game and bee the last bug standing!
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Blasterbug: Last Bug Standing!

Throw out explosive Pome-grenades and punch out your opponents to become the ultimate bug ! Be careful not to get caught in the blast as you navigate evolving arenas , or you might end up as just another splatter on the arcade wall.

Play as 15 colorful ant-stoppable bugs with dedicated special moves .

Fly your way out of deadly situations with the… Fly , trap your enemies with your web as the sticky Spider or roll a destructive flaming dung ball with R. Beelte .

Each bug has a very particular set of skills and mastering them can be a game-changer. Which one will worm up your heart?

Beetle your way into 15 playable areas , each bringing their own gameplay twist .
Escape the dangerous hazards of the Temple , trap your opponents on the fast lane in Bugville , avoid getting hit by spoons in the Kitchen …

Get spotless wins by using each environment to your advantage and creating buzzing chaos !

5 fantas-tick game modes are available: last-bug standing Death Battle , richest-bug-wins Coin Battle , hold on to your hat Crown Battle , splatter-spreading Paint Battle and the ultimate mix it up Party Battle combining all of them together with random modifiers.

Blasterbug: Last Bug Standing! is designed for immediate quick-fire fun for up to 8 players locally .
Perfect for tussling with friends, loved ones and co-workers.

Bring your hive-mates and bzz, ziip and tsizz!

games.name: Bat Galaxy
games.shortDescription: Half on-rails shooter, half exploration-driven adventure. Zoom into a world where billions of bullets surround you and your handy punch feature can send enemies flying.
games.aboutText:
Bat Galaxy is half on-rails shooter, half exploration-driven metroidvania style adventure inspired by 32-bit action games. Zoom into a high octane world where you'll weave through billions of bullets and use your handy punch feature to send enemies flying.







Mao and Kou, two fighter pilot trainees, are unavoidably thrust into a mission that only they can complete. They'll charge through linear stages with hordes of enemies surrounding them, explore colorful and mystically beautiful ancient worlds for technology and power-ups, and take on massive bosses built by a society their world forgot.

games.name: Chrono Gear: Warden of Time
games.shortDescription: Turn back the clock and fight to repair Time itself in this cinematic action platformer with fast sword combat and time-based powers. You are the Warden of Time, Ouro Kronii - be proud and fight hard!
games.aboutText:
You are Ouro Kronii, the Warden of Time. Your desire to become the strongest being in the universe led to the creation of the Chrono Gear, an artifact with the power to preserve timelines.

But where power lies, evil will seek to control it.

A fierce battle against the demonic Alter Laplus has shattered the Chrono Gear, scattering its Golden Gears across the stars. As Kronii, you must fight against the darkness that shattered your universe, find the Golden Gears, and repair the space-time continuum.

Chrono Gear: Warden of Time is a retro 2D action game that mixes speedy platforming and sword combat with explorable hub areas and a dramatic story.

Features:

- Control the flow of time with Kronii's special abilities, using Haste to accelerate time and Stasis to slow down time

- Speed your way through missions to achieve the fastest time records or explore for hidden collectibles; The game caters to either play style!

- Relax in central hub areas that connect you to each destination in your journey and become increasingly populated with hololive talents and fans as you make progress in the story

- Jam out to a pulse pounding soundtrack with over 75 pieces of collectible music, including remixes of popular hololive originals

This game is published under CCMC Corp(※1)'s Indie game brand "holo Indie".(※2)

This game is allowed to be monetized under the examination and terms of "holo Indie".

Please note that any monetized derivative work games that include Cover Corp.'s content outside of holo Indie is not covered by these terms and is not allowed.

CCMC Corp. is entrusted with website management (ex: Steam) including, examination, publishing and other necessary tasks by Cover Corp.

※2. About "holo Indie"

holo Indie's objective is to cooperate with hololive production fans and creators.

It is a game brand that offers "Game Creator Support Program" for the derivative work games.

For more details about "holo Indie", Please refer to the Cover Corp.'s "Derivative work guidelines".

games.name: One's Own Exile
games.shortDescription: Follow Sybil in her pursuit for survival, having to sacrifice everything - her culture, her identity, her values - to achieve a single objective: escape from a place that is constantly trying to kill her. A short game about persecution and identity.
games.aboutText:
A Short Narrative Experience

One's Own Exile was initially developed for a Game Jam competition. It is a short narrative experience that tells the tale of Sybil , an outcast in the region where she lives, which when pursued by the local guards needs to find a way to escape a tragic fate by concealing her identity.

The game reflects upon what builds one’s identity, values and memories. How painful it is to sacrifice everything you hold dear, if the purpose is survival? Which one is better: the pain of unceasing struggle or the death that follows failure?

Persecution and sacrifice

Is it better to die or to live in pain?

Sybil was discovered; living hidden isn’t an option anymore. The narrative follows the story of a protagonist who, to escape persecution and the threat of death, needs to take all possible measures to trespass the country’s border.

- Look for items that can help you in some way;

- Observe the local customs in order to pass as one of them;

- Find ways to conceal your identity, whatever the cost may be;

Lie, deceive and run away. Do what you must to survive.

Face Difficult Decisions

Sybil holds items and customs that are precious to her and her culture, and it's up to you to decide how much you want to abandon in pursuit of survival.

Depending on how much you observe, and sacrifice, the outcome changes...

But is every outcome desirable? Is a price too steep to pay?

One's Own Exile features multiple endings, that change according to your decisions and to how much information you obtain during the game.

With 8 different endings , see if you can reach the desired conclusion to Sybil's fate.

games.name: Isle of Reveries
games.shortDescription: Make a pilgrimage skybound to the Isle of Reveries, where any wish can be granted. Conquer puzzlebox dungeons and explore a vast Metroidvania-style world in this retro adventure.
games.aboutText:
Take control of an owl named Lief as they make a pilgrimage skybound to the forsaken Isle of Reveries, where it's said that any wish can be granted. Players will traverse a Metroidvania-style world, fight through six puzzlebox dungeons, each with their own unique themes and mechanics, and meet charming anthropomorphic characters along the way in this Zelda-inspired adventure.

Use your fairy companion’s magic to duplicate and spawn a variety of objects in the world, and discover how they interact with your robust set of items to solve head-scratching puzzles.

EXPLORE A VAST OVERWORLD & CONQUER DUNGEONS

Eight different biomes in the overworld. Seven different dungeons, each with their own unique theme, mechanics, and key item.

COPY & SPAWN OBJECTS

Use Lief's fairy companion to copy and spawn a myriad of objects, using them to solve puzzles and fight terrifying enemies.

FORGE A COMMUNITY

Construct various buildings and forge a township. Characters that Lief saves throughout the game will move to the township, offering new quests and stories.

DUNGEON CRAWL WITH A FRIEND

Play through TWO separate multiplayer stages with a friend, either in local co-op or online via Steam Remote Play Together. These stages are separate from the main adventure.

games.name: DRAPLINE
games.shortDescription: "DRAPLINE" is a roguelite training game where you raise a dragon girl who eats anything and train her to become the strongest in one year. Feed her a variety of things to increase her abilities, combine various skills to build your own strategy, and defeat the impending catastrophe!
games.aboutText:
Raise the Divine Dragon You’ve Nurtured to Overcome the Catastrophe!

"DRAPLINE" is a roguelite training game where you raise a dragon girl who eats anything and train her to become the strongest in one year. With the game’s ending achievable in as little as about one hour, you can enjoy multiple playthroughs and experiment with various training strategies.

Raising the Dragon Girl

To prevent the impending World's Doom in one year, you must raise a dragon girl known as the "Divine Dragon." This food-loving dragon eats anything and transforms it into her own power. Meat, fish, rocks, iron... no, even lava, mountains, and other people's houses become fine delicacies in her eyes.

Battle Against the Catastrophe

A mysterious enemy stands in your way, intent on bringing about the end of the world. Will you fight with powerful attacks? Use defense and healing skills? Or weaken them gradually with poison? Combine over 200 different skills to create synergies and build your own unique strategy.

Your Unique Growth Through Nurturing

The Divine Dragon is a pure being, just born. It’s not only her strength you must nurture, but her heart as well. Depending on how you raise her, her appearance and personality will change over time. The people she interacts with and the way she spends her year will determine the various possible endings to the story. Ultimately, the truth behind the "calamity" may also be revealed.

However, the Divine Dragon eats "anything".
If you raise her the wrong way...

Beyond Raising Your Dragon — 25 Possible Futures

As you experience “A Year with the Divine Dragon” again and again and progress through the story, the Divine Dragon’s future will eventually branch into 25 different endings.

What kind of life awaits the Divine Dragon you spent an entire year raising?

Her future depends on how you raise her.

About the Author: Kanawo

An indie game creator who develops games solo.

Continues to release popular titles, including "Noel the Mortal Fate," which was ported to Nintendo Switch™ / PlayStation®4 / Xbox in 2022 (available on Steam® since May 2018).

DRAPLINE Streaming Guidelines

- Streaming is OK!
Feel free to stream on YouTube, Twitch, NicoNico, X, or any other platform.
We’d really appreciate it if you could include a link to this page in your video description.

- Monetization
Using platform monetization features (e.g., YouTube Partner Program, Super Chat, etc.) is totally fine!

- Notes
Please refrain from doing anything illegal or anything that would bother others.

*Please be careful not to include any spoilers in the thumbnails.

games.name: Gorble
games.shortDescription: Gorble is a short marble-based dungeon crawl.
games.aboutText:
Gorble is a short marble-based dungeon crawl. You are a marble and you explore a dungeon and fight enemies.

Estimated play time 10-20 minutes. Gameplay

Use the mouse to aim and flick the marble.
You can charge the flick to make it stronger, and you can aim in any direction. Tips

You can charge your flick ability while in the air.
While charging in the air you fall slower.

games.name: Alabaster Dawn
games.shortDescription: Break Nyx’s curse and guide humanity's rebirth in this top-down 2.5D Action RPG from the creators of CrossCode. Battle enemies with stylish combos, wield multiple divine weapons, solve intriguing puzzles and explore a changing world.
games.aboutText:
Alabaster Dawn is an Action RPG building on top of the best aspects of Radical Fish Games' previous title CrossCode , featuring a deep and engaging combat system, challenging puzzles and an epic story set in a curious world full of secrets to discover and places to explore.

The shadow of Nyx has fallen, warping the world into a wasteland and vanishing the gods and their people. Now, Juno, the Outcast Chosen, awakens to an impossible task: bring it all back. Tiran Sol, a World in Ruin

Alone and without the guidance of the gods, Juno finds herself in a ruined world she once called home. Her task : awaken the rest of humanity and rid the world of Nyx. Only in unity can the world be rebuilt and only through the strength of a Chosen can the curse be broken.

But where are the gods? How long has humanity slept and what is the mysterious entity known as Nyx?

A (planned) 30-60 hours of playtime await you in this massive adventure, with 7 unique areas and many secrets to uncover. Rebuild settlements, establish trade routes and advance science by helping people. Each new advancement will be accompanied by the settlements changing visually, opening up new paths and opportunities! Dance around your Enemies

Experience a deep and fast-paced combat system inspired by Devil May Cry , Kingdom Hearts and CrossCode . Take full control over a total of 4 elements and 8 unique weapons of which 2 can be slotted into each element at any given time. To fight the many different enemies found in the game, you will have to make use of everything at your disposal and to help with that - you can switch your setup at any time, even during combat!

Unlock Combat Arts on each weapon’s skilltree (yes, that's one skilltree per weapon!) to pummel enemies in style, and top it all off by equipping Divine Arts to each element, unleashing powerful spells to finish off even the hardiest of foes. Exploration

While the gods may be silent, they've left many structures and secrets for you to find. Solve challenging puzzles using your weapons and team members, parkour along hidden paths, find treasure or simply collect various resources while exploring the world of Tiran Sol. Treasure found while exploring can contain a host of different rewards, such as new recipes for the cooking system, gems to slot into your equipment, upgrade materials and many more. Whatever you do will always be a help to you or the various communities you will come across!

Can’t reach some loot yet? No worries, the world map allows you to place reminders, fast travel between landmarks/checkpoints and mark objectives. It’s up to you to decide how much guidance you want! An RPG Through and Through

Alabaster Dawn gives you plenty of systems to build your main character. Equip gems into your weapons and core to activate powerful enchantments . These can range from simple stat increases to situational buffs that change the way you engage enemies. Expand your available gem slots using the skilltree and craft/upgrade gems via particular NPCs called “Artificers”.

You can even level-up your healing options! Cook dishes at resting spots to increase your stock of healing bulbs and unlock powerful temporary boosts . By cooking a great variety of dishes and using your boosts, you will increase your Palate Level , further enhancing the effects of your future meals. With plenty of ingredients at your disposal, it would be a waste not to turn them into precious “food XP”!

games.name: Town to City
games.shortDescription: Build an idyllic 19th century Mediterranean town and help it flourish into a prosperous city. Freely place and customise each element to create the perfect home for your growing population in this cozy city builder from the creators of Station to Station.
games.aboutText:
Break free of the grid in Town to City: a cozy city builder that invites you to create a beautiful and bustling community.

Freely place houses, shops, and amenities and natural elements to delight your residents and encourage new families to move in. As your population grows, so can your ambitions: create multiple towns that can grow alone or thrive together, helping the whole region develop and prosper.

In story or sandbox mode, you're free to build at your own pace, placing each flower bed with pixel precision, or prioritise growing your economy and developing your town into a thriving city.

Shape Your City

Truly grid-less building sets you free to lay out your town however you like. Plan out carefully ordered rows of houses and city districts, or grow outwards organically with residences, amenities, parks and plazas connected by winding streets and alleys. Freely shape the land beneath your feet with terraforming tools for elevation, water, and terrain.

Unleash Your Creativity

Beautify your settlement to your heart's content with a plethora of customisation options. Set up lighting, plant flowers and wooded parks, and decorate houses and buildings to complement or contrast. With gorgeous voxel graphics as a base and plenty of tools for fine-tuning, it's easy to create something beautiful that you'll want to capture with the in-game photo mode or stroll through in first-person view.

Nurture Your Community

As your town flourishes, you’ll need to meet the needs of your growing population. Provide amenities that will cater for everyone – from workers to artisans and the bourgeoisie – alongside specific requests by individual residents. Get to know each person as they arrive in town, and watch them settle down to form new families in the homes you built for them with pets and livestock by their side.

Grow Your Economy

Assign workers to jobs, research new buildings and decorations, and boost your sleepy settlement into a bustling centre of commerce. As you expand beyond the bounds of your first town, you'll pursue new developments in farming and tourism by building new towns, all connected by trade and travel routes.

Key Features

- Truly grid-less city building

- Full campaign and sandbox modes

- Land and water terraforming

- Rich customisation, with hundreds of decorations and detailed placement tools

- Photo and first-person modes

- Multiple towns with agriculture and tourism links

- Town and citizen management views

- Research trees for buildings, technology, and decorations

- Pets and livestock

- Beautiful voxel art style

- Relaxing soundtrack by Paul Aubry

games.name: Lelu
games.shortDescription: Get your gears in motion for a captivating monochromatic adventure where you play as Lelu, a small but determined clockwork toy who has gained consciousness and found a taste for freedom!
games.aboutText:
Get your gears in motion for a captivating monochromatic adventure where you play as Lelu, a small but determined clockwork toy who has gained consciousness and found a taste for freedom!

Navigate your way through the toy factory, a labyrinthian tower filled with puzzles and traps set by the factory’s eccentric guardian. Use your wits and agility to overcome challenges, from conveyor belts and electrifying circuits to sentient toys and towering titans.

As you delve deeper into the world, uncover hidden abilities to aid you in your quest, alongside a variety of secrets and other toys sharing your desire for freedom.

Will you find your way to the elusive exit, or will you just be another toy on the shelf?

Face off against an army of twisted toys and mechanical monstrosities lurking within the abandoned factory. Each encounter brings its own challenges, demanding quick reactions and a clever use of your abilities to overcome the threats standing in your way.

Unlock and master a range of unique abilities to overcome obstacles, outsmart enemies and uncover new paths. Every new ability opens up possibilities for exploration, helping you push further on your quest for freedom.

Solve puzzles, search every corner, and put your skills to the test to see if you have what it takes to escape this strange and mysterious place.

games.name: WEBFISHING
games.shortDescription: WEBFISHING a multiplayer chatroom-focused fishing game! Relax and fish (on the web!)
games.aboutText:
WEBFISHING is a multiplayer online casual fishing game where you relax, hang out, make friends, and catch fish!

CATCH THEM ALL!

Nearly 100 different creatures to catch- from the smallest snail to the biggest shark- you can catch it! Complete your journal, find rare fish, get loads of money, and get tons of special rewards!

UPGRADE AND CUSTOMIZE!

Become the ultimate fisherman! Upgrade your gear with new baits, lures, and rods- and collect tons of different cosmetics and props to show off your personality!

PLAY WITH FRIENDS!

WEBFISHING is designed around being social and hanging out with friends and strangers in the camp! Meet new people, find hidden spots, make awful fish puns, and catch fish together!

PLAY WITH TOYS!

Play REAL Guitar! Punch your friends! Draw with chalk! There's many tools and toys to play with in the sandbox of WEBFISHING!

games.name: Spook-A-Boo
games.shortDescription: Spook-A-Boo is a ghost hunting couch co-op game for 1-4 players. Play with friends and family to seek out and capture ghosts hiding in plain sight. Detect, scan, hook and trap all the troublemaking ghosts and have a spook-tacular time.
games.aboutText:
Welcome Cadets!

Detect, scan, hook and trap ghosts with your fellow hunters and stop them from causing havoc across the galaxy. Travel through wacky worlds and dizzying dimensions to find and capture every ghost.

A spook-tacular 1-4 players couch co-op experience where you detect, scan, hook and trap clever ghosts before they escape. Race against time across 28 levels through four themed worlds and discover why the ghosts are wreaking havoc.

Spook-A-Boo is a fun family adventure with laughter, cooperation and a ghostly good time.

Use Cutting-edge Tech

State of the art devices to seek, locate and capture the trouble making ghosts.

Detector s locate the pesky phantoms.

Scanner s spook the specters into running!

Hook and pull those poltergeists!

Trap the ghosts in their final resting place.

Encounter a Diverse Variety of Ghosts

Normie, Doughy and Zappy aren't the only ghosts in the galaxy! They come in various shapes, sizes and with wicked powers. Make sure you're capturing them and not the other way around!

Overcome Obstacles Together

Work with - and against! - your teammates to trap every ghost you run into across the four unique worlds you play through.

Please note that additional controllers would be required to play this game in local multiplayer mode.

games.name: Hack Fate
games.shortDescription: Hack Fate is a fast-paced hack-and-slash game with Chinese cyberpunk pixel art. Manipulate the timeline, switch identities, and kill enemies in one hit. Turn traps and foes into weapons and find multiple routes through every level. Ancient myth meets cyberpunk, each choice defying fate.
games.aboutText:
Hack Fate is a fast-paced, cyberpunk pixel-style hack-and-slash action game. In a flash of lightning, control time and space, switch identities, and deliver swift, fatal blows to all enemies.

One-Hit Kill

Time manipulation, precise parries. But what is the purpose of this carnage?

A single hit can decide who lives and who dies. Deflect bullets with your blade, bind enemies with your talismans, and slow down time to read the battlefield.

Twin Characters

Superior character performance, free time travel. But what are we fighting for?

Every double jump shifts time and space, switching between the Swordsman and Taoist as one world gives way to another. Master the timing, weave blade and talisman together, and turn every leap into a chance to defy fate.

Chain Mechanics

Strategically plan your battle route. level mechanics, items, and enemies are all interconnected. Is this all fate's arrangement?

Every level is a carefully crafted killing ground, and every battle has more than one solution. Read the battlefield, plan your kills, and use traps, hazards, and even enemies themselves to create an opening.

A Fateful Choice

You will always stand at the crossroads of fate, forgiveness or execution? That is the question.

Rooted in the emotions and desires that make us human, Hack Fate intertwines ancient Chinese mythology and cyberpunk in a story of fate, free will, and consequence.

Who you kill and who you spare will shape both worlds. Many endings await, but no path is without consequence.

If everything is predestined, then hack fate.

games.name: ON ANY JOURNEY
games.shortDescription: Designed exclusively for two players, < On Any Journey > is a co-op adventure packed with varied gameplay challenges that call for teamwork, coordination and a healthy dose of sabotage. Play locally or online with a friend!
games.aboutText:
Features

● Co-op isn't a mode — it's the game.

● Local or online co-op.

● Constantly changing mechanics.

● Help, interfere, and adapt.

● A world shaped by diverse visual styles.

● Show, not tell.

● Playground is more than a mini-game.

Cooperation Keeps Changing

On Any Journey is built around the idea that two players should never have to cooperate in quite the same way twice.

Work together, interfere with each other, combine your abilities, and adapt as new mechanics reshape the way you play.

Work Together. Or Don't.

Not every challenge asks you to cooperate in the same way.

Help your partner reach the next platform. Combine your abilities to solve a puzzle. Throw, pull, push, kick — or occasionally get in each other's way.

A game built around two players, not a single-player game with co-op mode.

A Journey with Many Styles

From hand-crafted environments to stylized 3D worlds and arcade-inspired sequences, On Any Journey moves freely between visual styles as the adventure unfolds.

Different chapters bring different atmospheres, and new ways to see the world.

More Than One Kind of Adventure

Platforming. Puzzles. Combat. Boss fights. Arcade-inspired sequences.

On Any Journey constantly shifts between different kinds of play, introducing new mechanics that keep changing how you interact with your partner.

Playground

When the adventure is over, keep playing.

Playground gives you a more open space to experiment with the game's mechanics, mess around with your friend, and discover new ways to play.

games.name: Nonolith
games.shortDescription: The NONOLITH consumes you. Copy and paste the world around you to discover the secrets of this ancient, enigmatic structure. You are very powerful, you just don't know it yet.
games.aboutText:
The NONOLITH consumes you.

You have been trapped inside the NONOLITH, a living structure where untold secrets are hidden in plain sight. Every piece of the world can be moved, rotated, and destroyed. Use this immense power to reach areas you previously thought to be unreachable. Build bridges, dig tunnels, and create your own path to unravel the secrets of the nine worlds within.

Escape the NONOLITH.

The walls will part for those who know the many truths. Solve puzzles to discover incredible tricks that redefine what is, and has always been, possible. Anything is within your reach, but first you must master the world around you.

Control the NONOLITH.

For the most adventurous, escape is only the beginning. Reach the highest level of mastery and the NONOLITH will succumb to your will. Power awaits the few who dare to wield ultimate control.

Features

- Compact experience with 9 worlds to explore

- Creatively solve puzzles , experiment, and enjoy satisfying ‘aha’ moments

- Nothing unlocks , discover tricks you could’ve used at any time

- Pick your own path to explore and escape the NONOLITH however you choose

- Master the secrets of the Nonolith , and be rewarded for your effort

- A haunting, atmospheric soundtrack composed by Clockmaker

games.name: Die Deep
games.shortDescription: Die Deep is an action game focused purely on the confrontation with your enemies. No exploration, no puzzles, The only core is Combat. One reckless move or greedy strike, and it’s all over. Answer the silent call of the abyss. Descend into the depths to find your forgotten desires.
games.aboutText:
When everything is devoured by the Abyss, Fight, even if it's just for the sake of feeling your heart beating.

Die Deep is an action game focused purely on the confrontation with your enemies.

No exploration, no puzzles, no filler. The only core is Combat .

Observe enemy attacks, find their weaknesses, and devise strategies using precisely executed attacks. One careless mistake in battle, or get too greedy, and it's all over.

Control characters with distinct traits and goals. In a relentless cycle of fierce battles, pursue the mysterious power to rewrite fate.

Step into the Abyss. Face death.

The World

When everything is devoured by the Abyss, all desires turn to dust. Wandering souls have long forgotten the instinct to strive, and even the reason to live.

Until the Abyss sends a silent call. It lures you deeper to uncover the forgotten that your once truest desire.

Even if it is merely a lie to bait a sacrifice. In this suffocating void, pursuing a lie is worth more than facing a hollow eternity.

Descend. Towards the end of the Abyss, to touch that single hope.

Fight. Only to confirm your heart is still beating.

A Pure, Focused Combat Experience

Focus on observing enemy movements and seizing every opportunity. Plan your strategy wisely and strike with precision. Any reckless attack or greedy strike can lead to fatal consequences.

But this does not mean you are slow or clumsy. Your characters possess agile moves and powerful skills. Unleash their full potential while staying calm under pressure.

The One-Eyed Warrior, skilled in shield combat.

Unique Playable Characters

From the one-eyed warrior skilled in perfect parries, to the agile rogue wielding dual blades, each character boasts a distinct fighting style. Delve into their unique traits. Harness their strengths. Find your own path to victory.

The Dual-Blade Rogue, with storm-like speed.

Challenging Bosses

Face distinct and powerful enemies of the Abyss. Any misjudgment will lead to instant destruction. Only a perfect response ensures survival.

Distinct and Powerful Enemies of the Abyss

Intense Continuous Battles

As the terrain automatically shifts, battles come at you nonstop. Seize every fleeting moment to recover. Break through one challenge after another.

Don't forget to heal during intense battles.

Build a Versatile Combat Style

Gain soul energy through victories to grow stronger. Combine various charms and skills to forge your own unique fighting style.

Use Charms to forge your own unique fighting style.

games.name: Mech Havoc
games.shortDescription: Sandbox of destruction. Billion different ways to build your mech. Feel the weight and impact of obliteration in this modern old school mech combat sim.
games.aboutText:
The rogue AI HIVE has seized control of the planet. Now it's up to you to WREAK HAVOC! Take command of a deadly fleet of war machines. From nimble weaponized delivery trucks to towering heavy Mechs.

Complete missions, upgrade your arsenal, and equip your machine with powerful weapons . When firepower isn't enough, unleash artillery strikes and crush waves of killer robots in explosive battles.

Unlock high-tech equipment like lasers, railguns and experimental mechs. Or go all-in with missile barrages and heavy tanks. Build your perfect loadout and dominate the battlefield your way.

Call in devastating artillery strikes , deploy turrets to lock down choke points, and launch drones to harass enemy swarms. Well-timed tactical abilities can turn the tide of battle against the endless hordes of HIVE killing machines!

Face off against a variety of hostile automatons , each with unique strengths and weaknesses. Clear swarms of detonating drones with grenades, or bring out the heavy guns to dismantle towering war machines .

Features

- Control a wide range of war machines. From towering mechs to tanks and fast-moving vehicles.

- Unlock a vast arsenal of weapons.

- Deploy powerful support abilities like artillery strikes, automated turrets, and combat drones.

- Destroy cover and alter the battlefield with fully destructible environments

- Battle across diverse landscapes: deserts, frozen wastelands and sprawling cities.

games.name: Chronoquartz
games.shortDescription: In Chronoquartz, every move matters! You have 10 turns per loop: explore, solve puzzles, and use your past knowledge to progress. Strategy, critical thinking, and time management will be your allies in this unique temporal adventure. Will you succeed in saving time?
games.aboutText:
In Chronoquartz, every move matters! You have 10 turns per loop: explore, solve puzzles, and use your past knowledge to progress. Strategy, critical thinking, and time management will be your allies in this unique temporal adventure. Will you succeed in saving time?

Every Move Counts

In Chronoquartz, your number of moves is limited. You'll need to be clever to make the most of the 10 turns you're given.

Time Loops

You'll need to use the knowledge gained from previous loops to progress further in the game. This will allow you to open coded doors, take secret passages, know the location of objects, and discover the fastest paths to reach your destination.

Strategic Choices

With each loop, you'll need to decide which path to take and which object to retrieve to reach your goal. Your number of turns is limited, so choose wisely.

Temporal Puzzles

To gain new insights into the game, you'll need to solve puzzles that span one or more loops. Meticulous planning is essential, because remember: every move counts.

Save Time

All the information you gather might help you thwart Morthas' plans. He wants to seize the Chronoquartz and manipulate history. Time needs you: will you succeed to save it?

games.name: Arisen Force: Life Devotee - Initial Ver.
games.shortDescription: Enjoy a stylish action combat experience as you explore a chapter storylines from Journey to the West.
games.aboutText:
Arisen Force: Life Devotee is an challenging A-RPG game featuring exquisite high-definition pixels ,it combines the engaging Stylish Actional combat experience.

The levels design is base on one part of storylines of Journey to the West .

Features

- Action Battle : Experience high-octane, stylized action designed for maximum enjoyment and tactical depth..

- Seamless Blend of Old and New : Encounter a unique mix of classic gameplay elements and modern design, featuring challenging adversaries and ingenious level architecture.,

- Immersive Battle Environments : Journey through each hero’s distinct thematic setting, enjoying diverse and visually stunning combat scenarios.

Battle

There are numerous combat skills to explore in action games, including Evade, Charging Attack, Block, Counter, Punish, Just System, Cancel, and Throw/Execute. Dive in and discover your favorites!

games.name: Paddle Cats
games.shortDescription: Paddle Cats is a cozy two-player couch co-op fishing adventure where two cats share one boat. Paddle together, explore the waters, catch fish and bring your haul back to camp.
games.aboutText:
A game about two cats in a boat.

They row around.

The water is nice.

Fish are tasty.

Sometimes they catch one.

Some fish are hard to catch.

Some fish are too strong.

Maybe one cat can reel while the other rows.

...

That usually helps.
---------------------------------------------------------

Paddle Cats is a cozy local co-op fishing adventure about two cats sharing one boat.

Work together to paddle across the water, find promising fishing spots, cast your lines, and wrestle your catch back to the boat. Both players occupy the same boat and can paddle or fish at the same time, so every trip becomes an exercise in cooperation and occasionally complete chaos.

Share One Boat

Each player controls one of the two cats aboard the boat. Coordinate your paddle strokes to steer, avoid rocks, and reach new fishing spots. You can work together carefully or accidentally crash your boat.

Fish Together

Aim and cast your rod, manage the line, and reel in fish with different sizes and behaviors. Hooking a fish is only the beginning: powerful catches can fight back, pull the boat through the water, and drag both players toward danger.

Protect Your Boat

Land, obstacles, and unruly fish can damage the boat. Pay attention to your surroundings while fishing.

Choose What to Bring Home

Caught fish take up space in your shared cooler. Decide which catches are worth keeping before returning to camp.

A Cozy Cooperative Adventure

Paddle Cats combines relaxed exploration and fishing with physical, cooperative boat handling. It is designed as a controller focused couch co-op experience for two players playing together on one screen.

Early Access

The Early Access version includes the game’s core local co-op loop: paddling a shared boat, exploring the water, catching fish, managing your cooler, and returning with your catch. We plan to expand the experience during development with additional progression, NPC requests, unlockable items, fish, and environments.

games.name: Fearwoods
games.shortDescription: Fearwoods is a 4 co-op survival horror where light and silence are your only weapons. Explore the cursed forest, uncover Aveline’s story, evade a relentless demon, and fight for escape before the darkness consumes you.
games.aboutText:
FEARWOODS

A co-op survival horror where the forest becomes your enemy.

Step into the cursed woods. Silence lives here. And the shadow watches.

Will you save Aveline… or condemn her forever?

Explore.

The forest breathes. The fog thickens.
Every step echoes, as if something listens.
Sometimes you hear whispers. Sometimes it’s just the wind... or maybe not.
The light flickers. The ground creaks.
You are not alone among these trees.

Find your path between fear and silence.
Every trail could be your last.

Find.

Everything matters – a torn notebook, a glint of metal, a voice on the radio.
Search for GPS fragments, Aveline’s journal, and the clues that lead deep into the cursed forest.
The more you discover, the less you want to know.

Each piece of the story brings you closer to the truth.
Or closer to something that cannot be stopped.

Face it.

Silence shatters.
Something steps out from the dark.
It doesn’t breathe. It doesn’t blink.
It just watches.

Light is your life.
But even that won’t always save you.
Not every fight is meant to be won – sometimes survival means running.
Hide. Turn off your flashlight. Don’t move.

The demon senses fear. And it feeds on it.

See what remains.

The door opens slowly. The smell of blood, smoke, and ash.
Signs of struggle. Bodies.
A mark on the wall – the same one you’ve seen before.

You know it’s the demon’s work.
But why? Who was it looking for?
You keep moving forward, because there’s no other choice.
Only answers might lead to escape.

Survive together.

Three players. One night.
Each of you holds the light. Each of you could be the last.

Help each other – or watch your friends fall one by one.
Sometimes silence saves. Sometimes it betrays.
Only teamwork gives you a chance.

Trust becomes the currency of survival.
But remember… something always watches from the trees.

Tracks. Fear. Choices.

You see footprints that don’t belong to humans.
You hear something moving behind you.
Is it the demon? Or just the echo of your fear?

Together you decide – direction, light, silence.
Every choice has a price.
Not every path leads to salvation.
Not every silence is safe.

Escape... if you can.

The GPS signal grows stronger.
The radio crackles – someone answers.
A helicopter awaits... or maybe it lies.

Your heart races. The demon is right behind you.
The light flickers, your scream drowns in the forest.

This is the final run.
The final chance.
Don’t look back.

Key Features

- 🌲 Dark, haunting forest – silence, whispers, and fear.

- 👥 4-player co-op – share the light and the panic.

- 📖 Aveline’s story – uncover her fate and decide her salvation.

- 🔦 Light & noise mechanics – shine wisely, or die trying.

- 👹 Relentless demon – stalking, hunting, killing.

- 🗺️ Exploration & survival – puzzles, traps, and the struggle for every GPS piece.

- 🚁 Climactic escape – radio chatter, rescue signals, and a desperate sprint to freedom.

😈 Will you dare to enter the forest?
The darkness waits. You decide who returns from it

games.name: Salvage Protocol
games.shortDescription: A short horror about exploring abandoned space stations and collecting junk in order to pay off your S.R.P.O debt.
games.aboutText:
Salvage Protocol is a single-player horror game about infiltrating abandoned space stations. Break anything in sight, recover valuable components, dodge traps and fight off terrifying monsters hiding in plain sight!

And maybe one day YOU will pay off your debt to the S.R.P.O. mega-corp.

Sneak through vents, climb unstable structures and reactivate ancient machines to open new paths.

Every station is a handcrafted maze where death is lurking just around the corner.

If it looks like you can break it, you probably can.

Wreak havoc and collect scrap to satisfy S.R.P.O’s endless appetite for worthless junk.

Put your hard earned credits to good use, upgrade your gear and buy new tools to make the job easier!

- 5 handcrafted locations 🛰️

- Dangerous monsters and traps😱

- A variety of tools and upgrades ⚙️

- Satisfying prop DESTRUCTION 💥

- The joy of paying off your debt (maybe) 💸

games.name: おしゃべりキング！コミュ力診断ゲーム
games.shortDescription: A game that tests your ad-lib verbal skills using a microphone. You can test your word power with various subjects, such as handling a bank robbery with just the power of words, or becoming a weathercaster and ad-libbing your way through a weather forecast.
games.aboutText:
