■How Good Is Your Communication Skill?

A new kind of game where what you say freely is scored!

■Basic Game Flow

① A prompt is displayed → ② The player answers via microphone or keyboard → ③ The AI scores it out of 100 points

■Four Types of Prompts with Different Ways to Enjoy

There are four types of prompts, each offering a different style of fun.

- Articulation & Brain Training
Tongue twisters, word association games, and other prompts that are easy for anyone to enjoy.

- Serious Thinking
Prompts that test what you say.
For example, explaining modern concepts in a way that Oda Nobunaga would understand, giving gift advice, and other challenges where the content of your answer itself is tested.

- Role-Playing
Prompts that test how you say things.
Examples include ad-libbing a weather forecast as a TV weathercaster, or giving a sports day speech as a school principal—becoming a version of yourself you normally wouldn’t be.

- Conversation Battles
Prompts where you exchange lines with the AI several times to achieve a goal.
Examples include verbal arguments, debates, and job interviews.

■Two Modes with Different Goals

Test Mode : For those who want to seriously measure their communication skills
Stage Clear Mode : For those who want to enjoy a variety of stages while having fun

■Co-op Stage Clear Mode (Offline Multiplayer)

This mode allows 2 to 4 players to play the Stage Clear Mode together.

Players take turns speaking in a relay format to create a single answer.

Enjoy the unique improvisational feel as you try to connect your response to the previous player's statement.

※ Currently does not support online multiplayer (designed for sharing one microphone on a single PC)

※ The topic content is the same as the single-player Stage Clear Mode.

Translated with (free version)

■Test Mode

Test Mode measures your language ability.

You will take on 10 prompts, and your language skills will be graded from Level 1 to Level 5.

You can compare your scores in each skill area with the national average to see your strengths and weaknesses.

You can also see your position in the national rankings—so give it a try!

- Test Mode can only be played once per day.

- Test Mode is only playable via microphone input.

■Stage Clear Mode

Stage Clear Mode lets you enjoy various situations while pushing your communication skills to the limit.

Unlock stages as you go and play about 40 different prompts across four difficulty levels: Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced, and Superhuman.

■Volume

- Test Mode : About 20–40 minutes per playthrough

- Stage Clear Mode : Playing every prompt once takes about 2 hours

■Notes and Play Restrictions

- This game uses the functionality of the conversational AIs ChatGPT (provided by OpenAI) and Gemini (provided by Google). Depending on the status of ChatGPT’s or Gemini’s servers, gameplay may be delayed.

- If OpenAI’s ChatGPT or Google’s Gemini undergo changes to their features or services, the game service may be suspended or terminated without prior notice.

- This game uses the AmiVoice speech recognition service provided by Advanced Media, Inc. for transcribing microphone input. If AmiVoice’s servers are down, the game may not be playable.

- If AmiVoice undergoes changes to its features or services, the game service may be suspended or terminated without prior notice.

■Streaming Guidelines

We welcome video streaming and gameplay commentary.

Monetization is also allowed, with no restrictions on the scope of streaming.

Both individual and corporate streams are permitted.

When streaming, please include the URL of this game’s Steam store page in the video description.

(If the platform’s rules prevent adding a URL, please mention where the game can be purchased within the video.)

We would greatly appreciate your help in promoting the game so that viewers may take interest—and hopefully purchase it.

However, the following actions are prohibited:

- Videos that violate the laws of any country

- Videos that infringe on the intellectual property rights of this game or others

- Defamatory or slanderous videos

- Videos recorded with illegally obtained game data

These guidelines may be updated or changed without notice. Thank you for your understanding.

■Location of Image Assets for Streaming and Other Uses

Game Title Screen > ‘Documents’ > ‘Streaming Guidelines’ → Link at the very bottom

※This will take you to Google Drive. Please download and use the assets.

※The terms of use for image assets are outlined in the in-game document ‘Streaming Guidelines’.

■Important Notice for Voice Changer Users

Regarding the ‘Play’ button that replays player responses in-game: Depending on your environment, the original unaltered voice may be played.

If you use a voice changer for streaming, we recommend testing the ‘Play’ button once before going live.

■Bug Reports and Inquiries

Bug reports will be addressed and posted sequentially on the [Bulletin Board] found on the store page

games.name: Berry Bury Berry
games.shortDescription: A juicy first-person incremental game about growing berries and tossing them down an ominous hole. Earn money and upgrades. Make new friends with sentient berry pals. Grow and control the hole as you unearth why nobody leaves this accursed garden. Bury it all, Berry everything.
games.aboutText:
Berry Bury Berry is a surreal first-person incremental game about growing berries and putting them in a hole. Lots and lots of berries.

BERRY BERRY BERRY BERRY BERRY BERRY BERRY BERRY BERRY BERRY BERRY BERRY

Make and Upgrade Berry Buddies to grow higher and higher tiers of berries!

MONEY MONEY MONEY MONEY MONEY MONEY MONEY MONEY MONEY MONEY MONEY MONEY

Use all that sweet sweet money earned to unlock upgrades and tools to help increase profits and explore more of the accursed garden!

BURY BURY BURY BURY BURY BURY BURY BURY BURY BURY BURY BURY BURY BURY BURY BURY BURY

Grow and gain control of the Hole to bury things deep below, where nobody will ever find them...

Additional Features

- Multiple endings! Unearth the secrets of the accursed garden and its inhabitants!

- Expansive upgrade tree with unlockable gadgets and tools

- Highly addictive incremental game fun, in a bouncy and squishy world

games.name: Look Outside
games.shortDescription: Look Outside is a survival horror RPG set in a single apartment building. A mysterious event turns anyone who looks out the window into grotesque monsters, leaving the world in absolute chaos. Scavenge the building to seek food, supplies, and weapons while encountering strange characters.
games.aboutText:
Look Outside is a survival horror RPG set in a single apartment building. A mysterious event turns anyone who looks out the window into grotesque monsters, leaving the world in absolute chaos. Scavenge the building to seek food, supplies, and weapons while encountering strange characters - human and otherwise.

Survival Horror & Resource Management

Plan tense expeditions outside your apartment as you fend off grotesque monsters dwelling in and around your building. Return to your home with gathered resources and partial answers to your questions to recuperate by playing games, making dinner, crafting tools, and getting to know your neighbors turned allies.

Inventive Turn-Based Combat

Clash with over 150 hand-crafted creatures in turn-based combat that accounts for space between you and your foes as you wield makeshift weapons and items you've gathered in the corridors of the building.

Impeccable Body Horror Aesthetic

Meet your macabre fate in a bizarre world teeming with an unconventional and occasionally psychotic cast of characters - some of which you can recruit and offer safe harbor in your apartment as the mystery unravels.

Small, Experimental, and Unwaveringly Weird

Offering 10 - 12 hours of playtime with a dozen boss encounters, friends to recruit, and visitors to invite back to your home, Look Outside offers different experiences for every player on their way to uncover several different endings.

games.name: Ascent DX
games.shortDescription: Crashed on a desolate but mysterious planet you find yourself eye to eye with an ancient civilisation. Explore the planet, find powerful upgrades, and fulfill your destiny.
games.aboutText:
Ascent DX is a tiny metroidvania brought to life in glorious 64 x 64 pixel art and soothing chiptune music. Crashed on an unknown planet you have to explore lush jungles, lifeless deserts, and luminescent caves in search of anything that can help you understand what has happened to the planet and how to get off it.

While the game is a bigger version of the original Ascent, with almost twice as many locations to explore, it is still quite a short game. With the same celebrated gameplay and atmosphere, the DX versions also brings more items to find, more platforming puzzles, and more lore to uncover.

FEATURES

- A world brought to life by tiny but expressive pixel art

- Explore the planet's many biomes in your own pace and direction

- Find new powers and abilities that help you on your way

- Uncover the fate of the planet as well as your own

- Different endings based on how much was discovered

CREDITS

Design, code, & pixel art: Johan Peitz

Music & sfx: Brent Houston

Capsule art: Jon Nielsen

games.name: Liminal City: Axiom of Maria - Chapter One
games.shortDescription: A 3D Metroidvania set in Seoul, left empty as humanity dwindled and now tended only by AI. Chain wall runs, air dashes, and a growing set of movement abilities to uncover hidden places and the stories tangled within them.
games.aboutText:
AI Dystopia

Humanity chose euthanasia — they stopped marrying, stopped having children, and withered away. AI tended to the empty reality they left behind. It filled waterless aquariums with whale bones, and hung theater entrances in midair. Like the awkward hands early AI once drew — careful, and wrong. The reality humanity left behind became AI's unconscious, and humans became something akin to monsters wandering through it. You follow a voice you cannot trust, and step in anyway.

Metroidvania Exploration

As you gain new abilities, walls become paths, chasms become passages, and gaps become entrances. Newly opened spaces loop back to where you've already been.

Combat & Boss Battles

Great trials stand in your way. Each one you pass makes you more whole.

games.name: Rogue Worlds
games.shortDescription: Rogue Worlds is a chaotic tactical roguelite platformer where you wield the environment and creative abilities to overcome challenges. Outwit powerful guardians and blast, dash, grapple, fight, and charm your way through ever-changing labyrinths! This is the Lite edition of Aura of Worlds.
games.aboutText:
Rogue Worlds is a roguelite platformer where you use the environment and creative abilities to overcome challenges. You'll need planning, wits and reflexes to make a way through these ever-changing death labyrinths.

The game provides a free (lite) edition of Aura of Worlds, with a shorter campaign and shared progress ( A " Demo" in a way ) .

Explore strange biomes, escape flooding poison, outwit gargantuan bosses. Do you play defensively with a repeater and energy shield, or swing into the fray with a boomerang and grapple hook? Do you scour the levels for potions and runes; or dive headfirst into the chaos?
Along the way, unlock starting gear options, shortcuts, character perks, pets, and more. The friends you rescue on your journey will help you. Each procedurally generated run presents new hazards, layouts, and tactical decisions. You can further customize your build with runes, and gear modifiers that synergize in a myriad of ways. Veterans can push their limits by disabling perks or cranking up the difficulty for greater challenges—and greater rewards.

Features

- Diverse Level Themes : Tidal corridors lined with mines, flickering lights in underground ruins, rising lava pits, and carnivorous gardens. Each environment brings unique dangers and opportunities.

- Creative Abilities : Master parkour, cloak from enemies, or even enthrall foes to fight on your side.

- Multi-Use Objects: Light your way with a lantern—or throw it as an improvised flaming Molotov.

- Challenging Boss Fights: Outsmart colossal adversaries by using both your reflexes and the environment to your advantage.

- Handcrafted Pixel Art & Animations: Beautifully detailed pixel visuals bring the world to life.

- Unique Musical Score: An immersive soundtrack that evolves with your adventure.

- Permanent Progression : Unlock new items, character backgrounds, and more to customize your journey.

And much more awaits…

Rogue Worlds is the free (lite) edition of Aura of Worlds ( A " Demo" in a way ), with a shorter campaign and shared progress.

games.name: Withering Realms
games.shortDescription: A ghost and her doll guardian explore the mysterious town of Penwyll and the sprawling graveyards, tombs, caves and rotting estates that surround it in this Horror Action RPG from the solo developer of Withering Rooms.
games.aboutText:
It is 1926, ten years after an immense “occult event” halted the Great War and transformed the world overnight. The dead walk, spirits roam, and a gifted few can even cast spells.

9-year-old Clover awakens alone in a decaying mansion just miles from the epicenter of the occult event, and soon discovers that she is a ghost.

Her only companion is a strange and powerful doll constructed from wood, metal, and human remains.

In this Horror Action RPG from the creator of Withering Rooms , join Clover and her doll guardian as they explore the mysterious town of Penwyll and the sprawling graveyards that surround it, seeking a way to bring her back to life.

- Descend into tombs, caves and rotting estates in search of treasure, upgrade materials and magical artifacts

- Craft weapons and machines to slot into the doll’s missing right arm like the Enchanted Candelabrum, Chain Rock, Machinegun, or Flamethrower

- Expand the world map by defeating massive perimeter guardians

- Make allies such as the daring freelance investigator Althea who will do anything to uncover Penwyll's dark secret including interrogation, lockpicking and forgery

- Return to any area at night to encounter new, horrifying creatures and secrets

games.name: Normal Golf Game
games.shortDescription: A very normal golf simulator. Hit anything. Shoot from anywhere. But remember: you’re not leaving until Luke Muscat himself (Fruit Ninja, Jetpack Joyride) is satisfied.
games.aboutText:
Hazy memories. A $100,000 fee. No sign of an exit.

Welcome to a very Normal Golf Game.

HOW HARD CAN IT BE?

From the twisted well-adjusted mind of Luke Muscat (Fruit Ninja, Jetpack Joyride), Normal Golf Game is a sadistically accurate recreation of the noble game of golf. Use physics to manipulate the path of your club, while simultaneously managing your stance, direction, and the angle and path of the face.

OKAY, QUITE HARD IT TURNS OUT.

Explore a giant golf course that is both a trap and a playground. Shoot from anywhere, aim at anything. So long as you don't try and leave, we will have a fun, normal time.

OTHER FEATURES

- A nice day out

- Learn a fun new sport

- Meet a game developer

- Have a great, very normal time

WAIT, WHO?

Normal Golf Game was built almost entirely by me, Luke Muscat. The real Luke Muscat that is, not the fictional Luke Muscat that traps you in the game. Confusing, I know. I’m a solo dev, Youtuber, and have the worlds worst golf swing.

games.name: Bait & Tackle
games.shortDescription: Catch exotic fish and fight comical sea-monsters as you chase after The One That Got Away in this fishing-centric boss rush!
games.aboutText:
Get Hooked on this Fishing Adventure… Where The Fish Fight Back!

Step into the boots of a legendary fisherman returning from a shameful retirement. Travel the coastline chasing after exotic fish and regaining your forgotten skills. But beware – deadly catches are lurking everywhere…

Take down a variety of comical bosses in fast-paced, high-intensity fights! Cast your fishing line like a grappling hook to sling yourself around stages, while also using your rod to smack sea monsters into submission!

The One That Got Away…

Long ago, The Big One got away and forced you into an early retirement. But now, you finally have the chance to redeem your reputation following recent sightings of the mythical monster! Follow the trail of rumors while taking down other terrible creatures that have been terrorizing the coast, including Mini Minnow , Big Bass , Crude Crab , and Swordmaster Swordfish .

No Laughing Matter.

Don’t let their wacky appearance fool you: each boss fight will push you to your limits and provide fresh challenges that force you to make the most of the fishing rod you wield. You’ll learn to master various movement techniques and boss patterns while constantly switching up strategies and adapting on the fly! As you improve, chase high scores as you replay past fights and challenge yourself with Super-Boss versions of fights! A suite of accessibility options ensures that you can play by your own rules and rise to any challenge.

Gotta Fish ‘Em All!

Chase after dozens and dozens of unique fish (and secret easter eggs) in each location! With unique rarities and difficulties, filling up your Fishdex is no easy task…

Download for Free Today!

Filled with hand-crafted pixel art, gut-busting jokes, and nail-biting challenges, the world of Bait & Tackle awaits… Grab your fishing rod, cast your line, and chase after The One that Got Away !

games.name: Catgirl
games.shortDescription: Catgirl! The RPG where you're a cat and also a girl. I bet you'd like that, wouldn't you? You little freak. Haha jk, ur good.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Catgirl. In this RPG, you control a cat whose dog gets kidnapped by an evil demon queen. Now you must rescue your best friend... and maybe some other ppl too.

features:

- Story focused game play (but you can body slam absent fathers too).

- Short & sweet, just a couple hours.

- Lots of mini-games

- Charming original art and soundtrack..

- Idiot-rich story with an emphasis on humor and pain.

- Created by 3 people, that's over 2 brains worth of game.

- Be friends with an orange doggy named Mopmop.

- You can make beats with a caveman.

- 猫娘

- There's a really handsome guy in the game

- Sometimes i can't help but feel like a failure, no matter how hard i try

- Super fun epic adventure filled with fantasy and friends!!!

games.name: Revive! Onsen Town!
games.shortDescription: Revive! Onsen Town! is a cozy life simulation set in the Japanese countryside. Play as a girl on summer vacation or the mayor revitalizing the village. Catch bugs, fish, work part-time, cook, and help locals. Shape the town with your choices and bring this quiet hot spring town back to life.
games.aboutText:
As the scenery outside your window slows and fades into the distance, you finally arrive at your summer destination—Onsen Town, a quiet and remote village hidden away from the bustle of the city.

With no internet due to its location, you’ve traveled here with your mother, who was transferred for work, to help the town build its first communication tower.

Along the journey to restore the town’s vitality, who will you meet, and what stories will unfold? A warm and healing summer awaits—filled with possibilities for you to discover.

In Onsen Town, you leave behind the noise of the city. Here, you’ll be greeted by star-filled night skies, endless blue oceans, and—most of all—the peaceful moments shared with the people who live here.

In this small village with limited connectivity, lift your gaze, listen to the gentle music, and discover the beauty hidden in everyday life.

To help revive the town, you’ll earn money through various daily activities while enjoying the slow pace of countryside life. From fishing and bug catching to part-time jobs, running a stall, or sharing posts on SNS—there are countless ways to contribute to the town’s restoration.

And of course, what would rural life be without farming and fishing? Harvest the vegetables you’ve grown, cook meals with your freshly caught fish, and savor the simple flavors of the countryside.

On your third day in the town, you can choose to live as the Mayor or Kyoko, the visiting girl. Once selected, you will play as that character for the day, while the other will go about their own life based on your choices.

Whether it’s the hometown Mayor or the newly arrived Kyoko—both are part of this little community, each experiencing their own journey in Onsen Town.

Note: The game is currently in development. All art assets and gameplay shown are work in progress and may not represent the final version. We will continue to expand and refine the content before release, so stay tuned. If you are interested in the game, feel free to join our official Discord server for the latest updates and to connect with other players.

games.name: Clear the Snow
games.shortDescription: Play with up to 4 friends and help clear the city of snow. Work together using shovels, snow blowers, and heavy machinery to complete jobs and upgrade your gear. Enjoy cozy winter vibes, and the freedom to play your own way!
games.aboutText:
Clear the Snow with Friends

From casual players to perfectionists — everyone will find something for themselves. Enjoy the calm rhythm, cozy atmosphere, and meditative satisfaction of clearing snow one patch at a time.

Have Fun with up to 4 Friends

A shovel isn’t just a tool — it’s also a ride!

Slide down snowy hills with your friends and prove who’s the fastest to reach the bottom. Have snowball fights, build snowmen, and take on fun challenges — there’s always something to do together!

Choose the Right Tool and Enjoy the Process

Watch as every movement reveals a perfectly clean surface beneath. Layer by layer, the heavy snow disappears, leaving behind a sense of order and peace. It’s more than just cleaning — it’s a mesmerizing, soothing experience.

Use Powerful Equipment

You’ll have access to shovels, snow blowers, melting trucks, anti-ice chemicals, and even heavy machinery! Each tool you use earns experience points you can spend on upgrades and skill improvements.

Clear the Snow and Earn Money

Start with simple tools and take on snow-clearing jobs around town. Complete tasks, earn money, and gradually improve your equipment. As you progress, unlock new machines, access larger contracts, and expand your snow-removal capabilities step by step.

Wishlist and Follow for Updates!

games.name: Whisk
games.shortDescription: Whisk is a two-player platformer about shared movement and communication. Coordinate jumps, climbs and throws with a partner to get every Dreamcat home.
games.aboutText:
Scout your route. Dash, leap, throw. Trust.

Whisk is a two-player platformer about shared movement and communication. Dash through surreal worlds as Luna and Foam. Rescue Dreamcats by launching them into interdimensional portals.

Stages are short and sweet

Laugh off your misses and run it back. The fastest runs demand coordination, timing, and the confidence to commit.

Save ‘em all!

features

- Work together in split screen or online coop

- 8+ stages in the demo to ascend through

- 10+ secret lost cats to rescue in the demo

- Fast and fluid movement mechanics and physics

- Achievements and time trial badges for every stage

- Friends and global leaderboards for every stage

- A stylized watercolor world

- Original Soundtrack by Pizza Hotline

games.name: Horsey Game
games.shortDescription: Collect Horses. Breed Horses. Race Horses. Genetically Modify Horses. Create a Horse paradise or just get rich!
games.aboutText:
Do you like Horses / Money?!

Can I interest you in Horse racing!?

What's better than owning a Horse?

If you have two horses you can breed them

or use CRISPR if you're in a hurry

So get in the balloon!

Don't watch TV that's lame

Wouldn't you rather play some

Horsey Game

games.name: Flock Around
games.shortDescription: Flock Around is a multiplayer bird watching game. Explore a nature sanctuary with friends, snap pictures of birds, and fill out the guide book!
games.aboutText:
Flock Around is a co-op birdwatching game where you explore a nature sanctuary. Solo or with friends, snap pictures of funny birds, and fill out the park guide book!

Snap them all!

Goose Lake Sanctuary is home to numerous bird species, and if you can see it, you can take a picture of it. Fill out the guide book with pictures of each bird in its various poses, from the common Robin, to more rare and exotic birds. Explore a variety of biomes, perform actions and use items to lure in species, and mess with your friends!

Flock Together!

Flock Around is designed to be a shared social space where you and your friends can work together to get pictures of birds or each other! Birding is best with others, so you can play with up to 10 friends!

Customize your birder!

Collect cosmetics and make your birder unique, expressing your personality and eagle eyes to your friends. After taking your pictures, develop them for money to spend on outfits so you can go birding in style!

games.name: Pronoun Palace
games.shortDescription: Pronoun Palace is a word-spelling roguelike set in a dystopian future where the government has taken your pronouns. Use spells to manipulate letter tiles, catch fish, and abuse amphetamines to defeat the Party and get your pronouns back!
games.aboutText:
Pronoun Palace is a word-spelling roguelike set in a dystopian future where the government has taken your pronouns. Use spells to manipulate letter tiles, catch fish, and abuse amphetamines to defeat the Party and get your pronouns back!

Gameplay

- Strategize your spelling; use wooden tiles to attack and plastic tiles to defend. Activate spells to manipulate tiles to your favor—shift letters across the alphabet, turn tiles into candy, and watch words spell themselves with wildcards.

- Retransition as different characters in the face of an oppressive bureaucratic collectivist state. Take advantage of their unique abilities to hole punch tiles and submit multiple words at once, weave through fish to catch specific letters, or juggle ticking bombs against a racing clock!

- Battle a wide variety of enemies that each change the game. Manage tiles afflicted with effects such as poison, trigrams, and capital letters. Solve mystery letters through deduction, keep yaoi and yuri tiles from touching, or spell words long enough to make an enemy heel!

Features

- 6+ playable characters

- 50+ unique enemy encounters

- 95+ different spells

- 90+ unlockable achievements

- 10+ difficulty levels

- Daily runs, complete with leaderboards

- Over an hour of incredible music by RENREN

games.name: Jelly Bubble
games.shortDescription: Stick with the same color, bounce off the rest! Snatch the soap, sabotage your friends! Adorable jelly critters are here for chaotic, hilarious showdowns! Supports 4-player local and up to 6-player online battles, plus a map editor so you can jump into laugh-out-loud matches anytime!
games.aboutText:
Stick together, bounce apart. Grab soap, mess with your friends.A cute but chaotic multiplayer party game where jelly creatures compete, collide, and betray each other. Play with up to 6 players online or 4 players locally, and jump into wild matches—or build your own with the map editor

In this chaotic playground, soap is power. Pick it up from the ground. Steal it from others. Or lose it the second you grab it.That’s just how it goes.More soap = stronger abilities. Bigger size = more control. Bring your soap back to the scoring point and climb the leaderboard — if you can make it there alive.

Your bubble is both shield and weapon.Same colors attract—get close, steal resources, or even absorb your opponent. Different colors repel—bounce enemies away or save yourself at the last second.Switching colors at the right moment can turn the fight around.

Soap doesn’t just make you stronger.It can blast enemies away, swap positions, or save you in critical moments.Every piece of soap is a tactical choice.

Supports up to 6 players online or 2–4 players in local multiplayer. Dorm room gaming? Friends’ party? Just gather your crew and it’ll quickly turn into a chaotic friendship-destroying showdown. With multiple game modes and fun-filled challenges, every match brings a fresh experience!

The game features a DIY map editor.

Create:

- A trampoline-only arena

- A full-speed boost racetrack

- Or something even more ridiculous

Then share it with friends and see what happens.

Features

- Easy to pick up, fast-paced, light competitive gameplay

- Multiple competitive and cooperative modes

- Unique core mechanic: attract (same color) / bounce (different colors)

- 20+ types of soap with different effects

- Custom map creation

- Fun customization and mix-and-match outfits

- Up to 6-player online

- 2–4 player local multiplayer

games.name: Evolve or Die
games.shortDescription: A co-op voice-controlled action game where yelling is the combat system. Team up, scream into your mics, and unleash absurd sound-powered attacks. Coordinate, panic, or just shout nonsense until the enemies—and your friends—totally melt down.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to the world’s loudest co-op action game — a place where your voice is the controller , your microphone is a weapon, and your teammates are the reason everything falls apart.

This is a co-op voice-controlled chaos simulator where yelling, humming, chanting, coughing, or accidentally sneezing can all trigger actual in-game skills.
If you've ever wanted a game that rewards you for being loud and punishes you for laughing mid-battle, congratulations — you found it.

Team up with friends, shout nonsense into your mics, and try your best to survive enemies who definitely deserve better than whatever sounds you're making.

Your Voice = Your Skill Set

Forget keyboards. Forget buttons.
In this game, everything is voice-activated :

Want to attack? Make a noise.

Want to heal? Make a different noise.

Want to cast your ultimate? Good luck keeping a straight face.

Chaotic Co-op

Play solo if you dare…

…but the game shines when 2–4 players team up and attempt “communication.”

Expect conversations like：

“Was that your attack or your sneeze?”

“Stop laughing, you’re triggering your ultimate!”

“Bro your mic sensitivity is a war crime.”

This is not just co-op — it’s surviving your friends.

games.name: Well Dweller
games.shortDescription: Well Dweller is a dark fairy-tale metroidvania, full of charming characters living in a wretched kingdom. Play as Glimmer - a tiny bird armed with a matchstick - who must burn the wicked queen to save his family.
games.aboutText:
Deep within the forest, at the bottom of a well, lives the only creature brave enough to kill the queen...

WELL DWELLER is a dark fairy-tale metroidvania made by the creators of Crypt Custodian and Islets!

Play as Glimmer - a tiny bird armed with a matchstick- who must burn the wicked queen to save his family. Explore a dark fairy-tale landscape and befriend the charming characters who reside in the kingdom’s underbelly. Battle terrifying beasts and gain new abilities to expand your map. Solve puzzles, discover secrets, and unravel the mysteries that lie in this rotted kingdom.

Among the rotting ruins are a charming cast of characters just trying to get by. Go camping with Ilda, a tiny mouse who is on the run from the queens grasp. Explore an abandoned castle with Looter, a mysterious scavenger who searches the kingdom for the best wares to steal. And find and reunite with all of your sheltered siblings who were snatched up one night by a crazed hunter.

Light up your matchstick to illuminate the world and aid in combat. Collect trinkets to upgrade your abilities, and mix-and-match them to customize your game play. Solve puzzles, defeat vicious bosses, and forge your path to the queens quarters to save your family.

games.name: Pact, Passion, Puchimon!
games.shortDescription: Journey across a continent teeming with diverse monsters! Capture them through intense bullet-hell battles and grow stronger together. With an in-depth nurturing system, you can build bonds with your "Puchimon" to unlock exclusive storylines and turn them into your ultimate battle partners!
games.aboutText:
These lands are home to all kinds of monsters. What looks like a harmless, pitiful creature just might unleash a brain-blasting barrage of bullets. Stay on your toes...or die! Fortunately, you possess a unique ability—you can capture any monster and have them fight for you! Each monster has its own distinctive shooting style. Make good use of their abilities and adapt on the fly to gain the upper hand on the battlefield.

There are a total of 12 puchimon that can transform into stunning humanoid forms. Build bonds with them and unlock a variety of exclusive, amazing events!

Moraphina

The omniscient, omnipotent mother goddess of the puchimon, she has existed for thousands of years. Her magic is awe-inspiring—she can freely wield the powers of various puchimon, and she also has...godlike titties.

Mimosa

Flower spirits are known to be a fragile race, yet Mimosa possesses formidable magical power. Despite this gift, she is perpetually haunted by self-doubt.

In your presence, she shyly conceals her intense emotions and primal desires. To preserve her purity, she has chosen a life of abstinence, struggling to suppress the yearning that burns deep within her soul.

Camerys

With a fickle and ever-changing personality, Camerys loves to stay in control. Driven by a powerful urge to dominate, she is the embodiment of a pure hedonist.

She unashamedly unleashes her desires in every possible way. Far from seeing you as her master, she believes the reality is quite the opposite—you are the one under her thumb.

Yurin

A Puchimon dwelling in an ancient underground fortress, Yurin commands formidable magical power. At its peak, her influence can reach the surface, plunging the world into a cataclysmic ice age.

Due to her frigid exterior and overwhelming strength, both humans and Puchimon alike keep a respectful distance. In reality, she is merely a lonely, innocent girl who yearns for companionship.

Sif

Driven by a powerful protective instinct, Sif views the care of all aquatic life as her sacred duty, the very embodiment of a compassionate mother.

While she is gracious toward all creatures, she harbors a deep-seated hatred for humanity, plotting her revenge by any means necessary. However, consumed by her own obsession, she has unwittingly become the very source of the calamity plaguing the oceans.

Silothia

A spider Puchimon who's initially friendly attitude made it seem she was just another motherly puchimon, but the truth is she needs a man's essence to reproduce. In truth, she relies on men’s essence for reproductive energy.

She stops at nothing to seduce the protagonist, constantly claiming her previous husband has died, though her story of how he died changes every single time...

Silatie

Silatie belongs to a species of beings that have existed in the ocean for eons. She is highly intelligent and in possession of much lost knowledge.

She deals with the protagonist using unwavering reason and rationality. Therefore, they have established a contract for "sharing magical power and relieving sexual desire."

Silatie also secretes a special slick slime that serves as a highly effective lubricant.

Embark on a journey to discover more Puchimon hidden across the continent!

Long ago, humanity used the power of lustan to restrain monster babes endowed with immense power, and were thereby able to live in peaceful coexistence with them for hundreds of years.

However, for reasons unknown, humans gradually lost the ability to wield lustan. The monster babes fell into a state of chaos and began attacking humans, leading to the collapse of civilization.

You are an ordinary young man living in the declining kingdom of Solowon. One day, fate would have it that you accidentally awaken the long-lost power of lustan, allowing you to subdue the dangerous monster babes.

To avoid being drained of your essence, you are forced to strike back against the swarms, and must actively explore the four major regions of the land. Capture monster babes, form contracts with them, and search for a way to stop the chaos.

●Get ready to capture 25 types of puchimon with over 50 different visual variations. Each puchimon has its own unique attack style!

●A total of 12 puchimon can evolve into sexy, seductive humanoid forms. Grow closer with your monster babes and unlock a wide range of spicy events!

●Over 70 pieces of gear that can be freely mixed and matched. Combine to create a shooting style that's uniquely yours!

●Explore ever-changing labryinths—every adventure is a brand-new experience!

games.name: Fourmiworld
games.shortDescription: Carve your own path through Fourmiworld - an "open-world-ant-farm-metroidvania". Play as an interdimensional urban explorer girl, collect Gamut to unlock new abilities, and discover the sights, plights, & soundbites of a surreal alien dimension.
games.aboutText:
"In times of boredom, there's only one logical thing to do...

...travel to another dimension, recreationally!"

- A. Wandereye (probably)

Fourmiworld

Fourmiworld is a free game all about exploring a strange world orbiting a dying star. Along the way you'll discover the remains of a lost civilization, encounter bizarre creatures, unlock tools to aid your expedition, and more.

If you'd like to support us, consider checking out the Wandereye's Writings DLC . It isn't necessary, but we recommend it if you want the definitive Fourmiworld experience.

Should you play?

If you enjoy at least 7 of the following points , we think you'll really click with Fourmiworld :

- Games with destructible environments and secrets to discover.​

- Open-world exploration and nonlinear progression.

- Insects , bugs and Sci-Fi ecosystems.

- Piecing together the history of a long-gone alien race.

- Atypical artstyles , collage, girls with flowers for eyes.

- Growing stronger and gaining abilities to better navigate your environment.

- Games that don't hold your hand and just let you figure things out.

- Atmospheric , ambient music that adapts to where you are.

- Personalized experiences, seeing things other players will not see.

- The word "Frondosity" invokes a certain joy in you.

Inspirations

These games inspired us a lot during development. We think you should give the game a try if you enjoy at least two of these:

Metroid - Game-altering upgrades & lonesome alien atmosphere.

Terraria - Digging anywhere & obtaining resources to get new abilities.

Hylics - Surrealistic stylization & unconventional vibe.

Yume Nikki - Exploring exactly how you want to & seeing weird/cool/scary things.

Starseed Pilgrim - Lack of hand-holding & tile interaction aspects.

games.name: Plush Time
games.shortDescription: Plush Time is a 1-6 player online and local multiplayer party game where cuddly meets chaos! Customize your adorable plush, then throw down with friends or AI in a wild board game packed with ridiculous minigames guaranteed to wreck friendships and spark hilarious mayhem.
games.aboutText:
Plush Time is a 1-6 player online and local multiplayer party game where cuddly meets chaos! Customize your adorable plush, then throw down with friends or AI in a wild board game packed with ridiculous minigames guaranteed to wreck friendships and spark hilarious mayhem.

ONLINE AND LOCAL MULTIPLAYER

Play your way. Plush Time supports 1 to 6 players, whether you're online or huddled around the same screen. No matter how you play — solo, with friends, or against ruthless plush-brained AI — it’s all the same chaotic, friendship-testing fun.

MINIGAMES

From sugar-fueled scrambles to full-blown food fights, Plush Time serves up a deliciously wild variety of minigames. Fight for cake dominance in Sugar Rush , shove your way through a crowded restaurant in Tippy Waiters , hurl unwanted toppings in No More Olives , and build the tallest dessert disaster in Sundae Stackoff . Cute on the outside — pure competitive chaos on the inside.

BOARD MODE

There’s only room for one winner, and let’s be honest — it better be you. Race across unpredictable boards, collect absurd items, and use every dirty trick in the book to outplay, outwit, and out-chaos your plushy rivals on the road to victory.

SOCIAL HUB

The calm before the chaos. In the Social Hub, you can chill out, chat with other players, customize your plush, talk to quirky NPCs, or even watch YouTube videos together in the cinema room — all while waiting for that one friend who takes forever to join the game. It’s the perfect place to vibe before the chaos kicks in.

BOTS

No friends? No problem. Plush Time’s got fully functional bots with adjustable difficulty — from harmless fluff to full-blown plush assassins. Whether you're practicing solo or just pretending your friends showed up, the AI is always ready to rumble (and probably cheat a little).

DEVELOPED BY A SINGLE PERSON

Built by one very tired human. Plush Time was created entirely by a solo developer — every feature, every detail, every bug lovingly handcrafted. If something breaks, just remember: it was probably held together with coffee and determination.

games.name: DungeonBox
games.shortDescription: A fantasy party game for up to 8 players, where everyone joins in from their phones. Type what you want to do, vote for the best idea, and roll dice to see if it works!
games.aboutText:
DungeonBox is a party RPG for up to 8 players. Everyone plays from their own phone: submit your funniest ideas, vote for the best one, and watch the story bend around whatever your party decides.

Your Dungeon Master (run by your choice of a player or computer DM) sets the scene and everyone answers at once: heroic, clever or completely unhinged. Players join from their phone's browser with a room code. No app, no account, no extra controllers.

Every answer lands on the big screen. The party votes, the best idea scores, and the winning move becomes the story, consequences and all.

Pick a lock, spot a trap, slap a gnome. Risky moves call for a skill check rolled right from your phone, and your class, stats and items tip the odds. A natural 20 is legendary. So is a natural 1.

Descend into the Lion's Labyrinth, a papercraft dungeon crawl where every player steers their own hero. Search chests, sniff out hidden keys, outwit trolls and mimics, and fight turn-based battles on the way to the Gilded Serpent's hoard.

When a quest turns violent, the whole party votes on cards: back your heroes' attacks and block the enemy's nastiest moves. Loot a million gold, survive a Super Blast, or simply stand there looking cool.

- Up to 8 players, one phone each – join with a room code, or fill empty seats with CPU players.

- A Dungeon Master who never runs out of ideas – every answer changes the story, narrated aloud.

- Draw it into existence – sketch magic items and monsters on your phone and watch them come to life in the dungeon.

- Build your character – choose from 12 heroes, earn XP, raise your stats and unlock abilities like Fireball, Pickpocket and Diss Track.

- Hand-written quests, endless outcomes – from tavern brawls to pirate-ship escapes, with 100 random events waiting to shake things up.

- Your table, your rules – set the Content Rating anywhere from “Family Friendly” to “Anything Goes”.

- Made for streaming – extra viewers join as the audience and vote, and the room code can be hidden on stream. Remote Play Together supported.

- 12 languages – menus, quests and narration fully localized.

games.name: Over the Radio
games.shortDescription: Local co-op game about flying a plane. One player is the pilot, the other the navigator. The pilot has no map. The navigator guides the pilot using only words. Work together to reach your goal in a remixable national park map.
games.aboutText:
Reach your destination using only words!

A pilot and a navigator work together to fly the plane. The pilot watches the screen and controls the aircraft, while the navigator reads a physical map. Since neither can see the other’s information, only sharp communication will get you there!

Replays let you relive the flight!

Celebrate success. Or laugh at moments like “Wait, that’s what you heard!?” and those unexpected detours.

Use every sight and sound as your guide!

From the cockpit, the pilot can spot mountains, lakes, and other landmarks to navigate. Entering certain airspaces triggers unique sounds as audio clues. With each player seeing different information and clues, clear communication is key to a successful flight.

Boost immersion with a paper map

Print out the custom map, mix and match the pieces, and explore fresh terrain every time. The mix of paper and digital creates a unique, hands-on play experience. The map will be available to view and download from our website.

Play anywhere with your own conversation style

Over the Radio is designed for local play, but with an external voice or video call, you can enjoy it even when you're far apart.

games.name: Rabona
games.shortDescription: Rabona is an online multiplayer soccer game with physics-based gameplay. Take total ball control with precise touches. Join the real football action with your friends. Feel the game.
games.aboutText:
Rabona is an online multiplayer soccer game where physics define every moment. No scripts. No predetermined outcomes. From precise ball touches to heavy tackles, you're in total control. Join the real football action with your friends and own every moment.

PHYSICS-BASED GAMEPLAY

Forget pre-recorded animations. Your player's movement is calculated in real-time, giving you full agency over your body to move freely and react instantly. The ball is a free-moving physical object, never 'glued' to a player, making every loose ball a true battle of physics and reaction.

CURVE THE BALL

Every pass, long ball, and shot is 100% unique. Apply realistic spin to curve the ball into the top corner or chip it over a rushing goalkeeper. Master skill moves like the Rabona, Trivela, or Elastico to dominate the field.

RAGDOLL PHYSICS

Football is a contact sport. Feel the weight of every challenge with a robust active ragdoll system. Time your slide tackles to intercept the ball or take down opponents, then watch players fall, roll, and stand up in a continuous, physics-driven loop.

REACTIVE GOALKEEPING

Face off against goalkeepers that react like humans, not robots. They physically jump and dive to reach the ball, creating unpredictable and exciting save moments instead of playing preset animations.

ATMOSPHERE & DETAILS

Immerse yourself in a realistic stadium environment with detailed grass and dynamic goal net physics that react to every shot's power and angle. Feel the tension when the ball hits the post.

games.name: Sujefa
games.shortDescription: Sujefa is co-op puzzle platformer where two players can play as Rock, Paper or Scissors. Work together to solve puzzles and reach the end. Play online or locally on a shared screen.
games.aboutText:
Sujefa is a cooperative 2D puzzle-platformer made specifically for two players. Every level is designed around teamwork: communicating, coordinating, and using each character’s strengths and weaknesses to solve challenges together.

Each player chooses to play as Rock, Paper, or Scissors. Rock must avoid Paper, Paper must avoid Scissors, and Scissors must avoid Rock.

Solve 40 levels filled with platforming, cooperating and puzzle solving built around rock, paper and scissors.

You can play online with a friend or share a single screen locally.

games.name: Dogpile
games.shortDescription: Dogpile is a roguelike deck builder about merging cute dogs into bigger dogs. Play dogs, get money, customize your dogs with special Traits, refine your deck, PLAY MORE DOGS! DOGS!
games.aboutText:
When two of the same dog touch, BAM! You get a BIGGER dog. With careful placement, some clever purchases, and a can-do attitude, you can merge pups strategically and achieve the biggest dogs imaginable.

You really shouldn't adopt a dozen dogs, but now you can! Dogpile gets you to wrangle a cute collection of canines into the perfect deck, customize them, and play them expertly. Manage the clutter, upgrade and improve your cards as you go, and strive for the BIGGEST dogs.

Like in real life, dogs come with quirks and untapped potential! You’ll discover any variety of weird traits such as Barky, Sleepy, Timid, Cool and more. Take your dogs to the Dog Wash to add even more traits, and find Dog Tags that bolster and benefit from Trait synergy!

Utilize a clever array of powerful Dog Tags to modify how your dogs and their Traits function. Find interesting synergies and unique combos to aid you in all of your merging endeavors. And always remember your ultimate goal: BIGGER!

games.name: BLACK SOULS II
games.shortDescription: Despair. Fear, Madness, once again. An original work based on "Alice in Wonderland" and "Through the Looking-Glass." Dark Fairy Tale Fantasy x Psychological Horror RPG focusing on the themes of "Exploration of a Mad World" and "Life or Death Combat against Demonbeasts".
games.aboutText:
Despair. Fear, Madness, once again.

An original work based on "Alice in Wonderland" and "Through the Looking-Glass."

Dark Fairy Tale Fantasy x Psychological Horror RPG focusing on the themes of "Exploration of a Mad World" and "Life or Death Combat against Demonbeasts".

※Includes content from all 3 DLCs.

●Introduction

In this work, you'll meet 45 Heroines.

Almost all of them are the fun characters you may have met before in the famous tale "Alice's Adventures in Wonderland".

Though, now all of them are charming girls.

(However, the most important for you is Alice, of course, isn't that right?)

・The White Rabbit

・The Cheshire Cat

・The Hatter

・The March Hare

・The Dormouse

・The Duchess

・The Mock Turtle

・The Gryphon

・The Queen of Hearts

・The Red Queen

And many others...

●SEN System

All NPCs in this world can be killed. However, should you do so, your SEN would decrease. And as it gets too low:

・BGM will disappear.

・All the inhabitants will begin to talk in an incomprehensible language.

・Some things that should not be seen will become visible.

What a frightening ailment it is!

- A vast, open world made of many different and charming maps.

- Will you kill or will you be killed? Tactical and tense ATB combat.

- Explore the Wonderland end to end, gathering souls and raising your level.

- Death is not the end, merely a setback as you resume from the last bonfire.

- Many different endings

games.name: Invokyr
games.shortDescription: A co-op survival horror game about a cursed board game. Play in a group of 6 players. Roll the dice, survive the horrors that are summoned, and beat the Gamemaster to win your freedom.
games.aboutText:
Every Roll Summons a New Surprise!

You’re trapped. The house groans around you. Cold. Dark. On the table sits a 1970s board game, dusty but humming with energy. You’d heard rumours, of course. About the board, the house. You look to your friends, and a voice, whimsical yet bitter, speaks: “Let’s play a game.”

Once a beloved toy, the Gamemaster now rules this abandoned house. Escape is possible but only if you play. You roll the dice, and another worldly sound echoes through the house. Will you win your freedom or be dragged into the darkness?

Beat the Gamemaster

Play the game and survive the unpredictable terrors, traps, and curses that are summoned. Reach the end and you’ll escape. Perhaps.

Face the Fear Together

Online co-op with up to 6 players. Work together… or leave someone behind. Death is not always the end.

Explore to Find Dice

Scour the house to recover the dice hidden within. Each can only be used once. Choose wisely.

Special Dice

Some dice offer powers to heal, hide, or hinder those who hunt you, but nothing comes without risk.

Try Not to Get Lost

The house is a labyrinth of rooms. Lose your way, and you may never make it back to the board.

Fear-filled Features:

- Immerse yourself in a co-op psychological horror, built around a cursed game that is desperate to be played.

- Face bizarre, unique creatures: each with their own way of hunting.

- Traps, curses, and chaos await every turn.

- The house has different biomes: jungle, ice mountain, oversized toy chest.

- Survive to earn rewards… and unlock more formidable challenges. Will you play again?

Come, friends, and play.

Live or die, who could say?

games.name: Thunder Spikes Volleyball
games.shortDescription: The most authentic volleyball feel ever made in 2D. One button, a whole playbook: spike, tip, block and serve with pixel-precise control. Build your club in Career mode, take on national teams in Arcade, or grab a gamepad and play co-op or versus with friends on the couch.
games.aboutText:
Thunder Spikes Volleyball is a 2D video game where you can perform every volleyball move: spikes, tips, blocks, serves, and spectacular diving saves.

Read the defense mid-air, pick your move, and score! Just as reading the attack well can help you pull off satisfying monster blocks .

- Local multiplayer ( or online streaming via Steam Remote Play Together)

- Over 1,500 frames of hand-drawn animations

- Arcade Mode : challenge and unlock all National Teams and win the cup

- More than 12 unique courts , from playgrounds and school gyms to stadiums and world-class arenas

games.name: 港警成雙：來自城寨 Dual Fire Walled City
games.shortDescription: Dual Fire Walled City is a story-driven co-op game for two players. Featuring close friends who grew up together in the Kowloon Walled City, only to be pulled onto vastly different life paths by a twist of fate. Get ready to immerse yourself in a classic Hong Kong-style movie.
games.aboutText:
In Dual Fire Walled City, experience their intense careers firsthand through split-screen local co-op or Steam Remote Play.

Our game delivers a gripping narrative with diverse missions and gameplay, allowing you and your partner to cooperate through an emotional journey—just like playing through a classic Hong Kong crime thriller.

Play Together with Steam Remote Play

Only one copy of the game is needed—invite a friend online via Steam Remote Play and dive into the story together!

- Iconic Visual Style & Atmosphere

Travel through nostalgic old tong lau buildings, neon-lit streets, and the modren concrete jungle—all inspired by the gritty, glamorous look of classic Hong Kong action movies.

- Full Dual-Language Voiceover

The game features full voice acting in both Cantonese and Putonghua .

Switch freely between them to fully immerse yourself in the world of Dual Fire Walled City.

A Thrilling Cinematic & Cooperative Experience

Navigate the vibrant streets of Hong Kong and tackle thrilling missions together!

Every punch and kick lands with force

The operation won’t be easy; enemies won’t go down without a fight!

Play as Multiple Characters

As the story unfolds, you’ll step into different roles—even returning to their childhood —to explore the famous memorable Kowloon Walled City.

A Variety of Nostalgic Mini-Games

Play alongside your partner and enjoy our childhood favourite games.

Disclaimer :

The story,all names,characters and incident portrayed in the production are fictitious.

No identification with actual persons(living or dead),places,buildings or products is intended or should be inferred.

games.name: MONUMENTUM
games.shortDescription: Take control of a small rolling square and utilize long dormant mechanisms to ascend to the top. Watch your step!
games.aboutText:
DISCLAIMER: This game requires a gamepad controller and utilizes sustained button presses. If you feel that holding a button down for longer than 10-15 seconds at a time will be uncomfortable, you may want to try the demo before purchasing. Thank you!

MONUMENTUM is a metroidvania-rage-puzzle-platformer-pinball-like where you control both the environment and the player character. Overcome platforming challenges, climb upwards, and activate new mechanisms of movement to reach the top!

FEATURES

- 1-2 hours of playtime

- 100+ platforming challenges

- 5 mechanism abilities to discover and activate

Activate and utilize long dormant mechanisms to reach new heights. Enjoy an immersive, diegetic experience. Play without forced UI or tutorial interruptions. Experiment and forge your own path upwards! You can't die but you can and will fall. Try not to fall though. But you will, probably.

games.name: Torii: Beyond The Gates
games.shortDescription: The spirit realm has broken. Your brother has gone missing. Forge the path you were destined for. Explore the gates and find out why the links inside the spirit realm have been broken. Battle, discover and find the secrets, and make new connections in a beautiful hand-drawn 2D style.
games.aboutText:
Explore the Spirit Realm

The spirit realm has broken. Your brother has gone missing. Discover the path you were destined for. Explore the gates and find out why the links inside the spirit realm have been broken. Battle, discover and find the secrets, and make new connections in a beautiful hand-drawn 2D style.

Features

- Dodge, parry, dash and slash your way through different enemies and bosses.

- Classic platformer action in a beautiful hand-drawn 2D art style.

- Discover new gates and worlds, all connected together by the spiritual gates of the world.

- Decide your path. Make new friends. Find the secrets of the Spirit Realm.

- Learn new arts, skills and equipment. Find your way to your brother – perhaps he knows what is going on?

- Hand-painted landscapes – every single part of the game drawn by hand with care.

- Difficult obstacles, bosses and enemies, all with varying abilities. Study them closely, then strike when you are ready.

Hand Drawn with Love

Torii is a game where every piece of art is hand-drawn, from the characters to the entire world itself. There was no other way to express this world, and to bring it to life, Torii was made with careful attention to bringing back the traditional hand-drawn 2D art style that pioneered the genre as we know it today.

If you enjoy platformers and classic-style 2D art with a modern flair, Torii is ready for you!

games.name: Don Memo
games.shortDescription: Don Memo is a brave bull who embarks on one final journey across Costa Rica to rescue his granddaughter and confront Pisuicas. Fight against legends and shadows of the past in this 2D pixel platformer, while carrying the legacy of a family destined to protect the world from evil.
games.aboutText:
Don Memo is an old bull who lives with his wife and granddaughter, Milagro. He descends from a proud lineage of brave bulls marked by the legend of Malacrianza , the mythical bull who was the first to face the demon Pisuicas and managed to banish him to hell. Since then, Malacrianza’s descendants have inherited the responsibility of fighting Pisuicas, who returns whenever negativity in the world rises.

Don Memo also fought his battle in the past, successfully banishing Pisuicas. However, the demon quickly returned due to the growing hatred and despair in humanity. Years later, Don Memo’s son carried on the legacy and, alongside his wife, gave his life to banish Pisuicas once again. Since that tragedy, Don Memo has cared for his granddaughter Milagro.

Now, in the present, Pisuicas has returned sooner than expected—and this time, he has kidnapped Milagro. Burdened by the pain of his past and the weight of the years on his back, Don Memo sets out on one final journey across Costa Rica. He must face not only ancient legends and dangers, but also the weight of his legacy and the fear of failing once more.

- Machete Mastery: Wield Don Memo’s trusty machete to slash through enemies and break obstacles. Dodge roll out of danger, read enemy patterns, and collect scrap so Moncho can upgrade your blade with more reach, faster swings and a ranged slash wave.

- Betty’s Kitchen: Gather ingredients across Costa Rica, unlock all 23 recipes from Betty’s cookbook and cook dishes at the Fogón. Equip them before each level for boosts to combat or exploration.

- Platforming and Secrets: Run, jump and dodge through 21 levels across all seven provinces. Every level hides secret areas, alternate routes and collectibles, and new abilities let you return to earlier levels to reach places you couldn’t get to before.

- Folklore Boss Battles: Face legends of Costa Rican folklore corrupted by the Pisuicas: El Cadejos, La Llorona, La Cegua, El Viejo del Monte, El Padre sin Cabeza, La Bruja de Zárate and La Mano Peluda, before the final showdown at the summit of Cerro Chirripó.

- A Story with Tico Heart: The Pisuicas has kidnapped Milagro, Don Memo’s granddaughter, and fled in a red taxi. Travel from Guanacaste to Limón, meet unforgettable characters and discover a story about family, loss and empathy, full of Latin American humor.

games.name: Rhombus
games.shortDescription: Rhombus is a first-person puzzle game where you build your path through panels controlling platforms. Explore and find your way through a compact environment in this small metroidbrainia.
games.aboutText:
Rhombus is a first-person puzzle game where you build your path through panels controlling platforms. Explore and find your way through a compact environment in this small metroidbrainia.

Features

- Unique puzzle mechanic that plays with perspective

- Compact 'open-world' environment with multiple paths & non-linear exploration

- Estimated length of 2-3 hours - perfect for a single evening/afternoon

games.name: Leaf it Alone
games.shortDescription: Finally, it's that time of the year to clean up this leafy mess. It's been a while since the last time you've done it, so don't waste any second and derust your raking skills!
games.aboutText:
Leaves have been piling up for too long, and they aren't going anywhere on their own. Time to roll up your sleeves and get back to work.

You don't need much. A rake , a leaf blower , or sometimes even a mighty hand might become handy.

The plot changes slowly at first, but once you start upgrading your tools, the process becomes quick - and the yard begins to feel alive again.

Keep track of the progress in your journal, complete objectives, and unlock achievements along the way! Show your friends how it's done, thanks to the in-game leaderboards .

Every leaf you move brings the place closer to order. See what you will uncover...

games.name: Polly's Puzzle Box
games.shortDescription: As a small flea, explore a strange puzzle box full of secrets. Gather shapes and combine them to reveal hidden abilities. Polly is always watching… Can you escape?
games.aboutText:
In this handcrafted metroidBRAINIA , you find yourself trapped in a whimsical puzzle box shrouded in layers of mystery. Stalked by a giant parrot, you must collect shapes and other odd items with many secret powers that you discover along the way. Chart your own course through this world of childlike wonder, but be warned: Not everything is as it seems…

Uncover Layers of Secrets

- Explore a densely packed world with no distinct areas — Every room is different

- Use bizarre items — Craft tools like see-saws and boats from your arsenal of shapes

- Dig deeper into the box and unearth knowledge better left unknown

Learn the Rules of the Box

- Discover new ways to interact with the world that unlock the path forward

- Solve interconnected puzzles of all kinds — physics, spatial, perceptual, logic, and more…

Find Your Own Way Out

- Pursue a nonlinear path — encounter items and clues in a unique order

- Create your own solutions with clever use of your tools

You'll find lots around, if you'll just look and see.

games.name: Devoid
games.shortDescription: Devoid is an immersive journey into the medieval world of vampires who feed on human souls. You will have to put an end to their power with the help of sword and magic. Use an arsenal of tools and magical abilities on your way to defeat the most ancient evil.
games.aboutText:
Devoid is an immersive adventure for all fans of games like Dishonored, Thief, Gloomwood. Medieval cities are overrun, old kings are executed, and the surviving people are hiding in the slums - this marked the era of Vampires. Given a sword, shield, bow and other indispensable tools in battle, as well as magical powers, you will have to exterminate vampires, sneak behind their backs, solve puzzles for the sake of saving the human race.

The dark deity has endowed you with superpowers in return for depriving you of your soul, you will have to use them and various gadgets (bow, shield, magnetic tripwire, etc.)

Open combat is not terrible, because there is a reliable sword and different types of blows (light, heavy, falling, etc.)

Sneak around, distract enemies with various pick-up items, memorize their routes - all for the sake of a silent and quick elimination of the target.

games.name: WORLD WAR V: LAST CALL
games.shortDescription: Lighthearted comic war action! Battle across voxel and pixel worlds to stop the V Empire’s ambition. Break terrain, uncover items, and face unique bosses. Behind the cute visuals lies a truly challenging game waiting for you!
games.aboutText:
World Overview

A lighthearted, comic take on war action!
In a world shifting between voxel battlefields and retro pixel scenes, stop the ambition of the V Empire!

Characters & Story

From the boastful Colonel Freak, to the sadistically charming Sophia, and the determined yet innocent Rena—
every character brings their own flavor. Their quirky personalities create a funny and entertaining scenario that keeps you hooked stage after stage.

Gameplay Features

Destroy terrain, uncover hidden items, and carve shortcuts across a voxelized battlefield.
Face off against varied enemy patterns and unforgettable bosses that test your skills.
Behind the cute visuals hides a seriously challenging difficulty !

Technical Features

Powered by our proprietary Voxel Perfect™ system, experience optimized voxel action that blends comic humor with explosive gameplay.

Demo Available

Try out the demo now and play up to Stage 2 . Please note that some content may differ in the final release.

About the Creator

HORANG is best known as the webtoon creator behind chilling works like Ok-su Station Ghost and Bongcheon-dong Ghost . But long before becoming famous as a storyteller, he had already lived as a web developer, tool maker, and game creator .

This unique blend of experiences fuels WORLD WAR V: Last Call . The game carries the playful comedy of his storytelling, the sharp visual timing of his webtoons, and the technical ingenuity of a self-made developer.

games.name: CorgiSpace
games.shortDescription: CorgiSpace is a collection of 8-bit games that have short legs on purpose. This anthology includes more than a dozen action, adventure, arcade, and puzzle games, and each can be thoroughly explored in under an hour.
games.aboutText:
You are now entering CorgiSpace, where all the games have short legs on purpose. This collection by Adam 'Atomic' Saltsman includes more than a dozen action, adventure, arcade, and puzzle games, and each can be thoroughly explored in under an hour.

In CorgiSpace, you can play games like:

- Kuiper Cargo - a run-based puzzle game where the right upgrades make all the difference as you deliver cargo and raise your guild rank.

- Cave of Cards - a mini rogue-like where you have to clear a cave full of killer mushrooms by setting off bombs and making new resources from poker hands.

- Mole Mole - a sokoban puzzle with a twist (the twist is bombs).

- Dino Sort - A new logic puzzle where every dinosaur has to be in just the right spot. For example, some dinosaurs need to be next to their favorite food (plants) while others have to be near their favorite food (dinosaurs).

- Rat Dreams - a top-down souls-like with no walking, only dodge rolls.

CorgiSpace collects a year of original games full of new ideas, strange reveals, and unexpected delights, plus developer diaries about how each game was made. Some of the games can even save your progress. No secret stuff, though. Welcome to CorgiSpace!

Features

- Breaking out of jail (a lot)

- Being a pug

- Stabbing nazis

- Falling off stuff

- Terraforming a planet

- Drinking various popes

- Mushroom farming

games.name: Chronigma
games.shortDescription: Master time in this time-bending sokoban-like puzzle game with a story. You travel back in time to be in two places at once, to solve puzzles impossible to complete alone. Your success hinges on your ability to collaborate with yourself. Can you learn to manipulate time to save humanity?
games.aboutText:
Who is this made for: Gamers who like taking their time to enjoy time manipulation sokoban-like puzzles with a text narrative story. The game starts out with traditional sokoban mechanics and then introduces the time manipulation mechanics at Level 6 (around 20 minutes into the game).

Story: They called it the Time War. A conflict where humanity's greatest achievement, time travel, became its tombstone. Born into a silent world, you are Cygnus, and your father, Kronos, has dedicated his life to one purpose: your training. This puzzle adventure is a series of his lessons (puzzles), each one a challenging test of your ability to manipulate time.

Game: This is a single-player, story-rich (text narrative), time-bending puzzle game. You use time travel to be in two places at once to solve increasingly complex puzzles. With the Chronigma device, you are never truly alone. You record your actions, travel back in time, and team up with your "Past Self" to solve puzzles impossible for a single person. Your success hinges on your ability to collaborate with yourself.

Controller Support: Chronigma supports Xbox, PlayStation, and Switch controllers natively, so no setup needed and Steam Input should be OFF. If you experience controller input not working, double inputs or wrong button icons, try disabling Steam Input (Library → Chronigma → Properties → Controller → "Disable Steam Input") and restart the game.

Key Features

- Completely free game. We built this game as a family hobby, fueled by our passion for Time Travel, Sci-Fi, Escape Rooms, and Puzzles, to be completely free from day one.

- Time Manipulation Puzzle Game: This is a sokoban-like puzzle game and is meant for those that enjoy time manipulation puzzles.

- Team Up With Yourself: Record your actions and collaborate with your own
"Past Self" to overcome obstacles no single person could.

- A Journey Through Time: Explore 60+ of handcrafted levels, from simple logic problems to multi-layered temporal challenges. Providing over 4 hours of mind-bending puzzle gameplay.

- Play the Game Your Way: Stuck on a tricky paradox? Get a nudge in the right direction with in-game help, or skip a level to come back to it later. You can also unlock all levels to explore the game at your own pace. And if you are not interested in text narrative stories, you can choose the Minimal Story mode.

- A Story of Hope at the End of Time: Uncover the secrets of the Time War and the heavy burden shared between a father and son, training to save a world they've never known.

- Bonus Challenge: For the truly dedicated, seek out and conquer difficult levels that will test your mastery of time to its absolute limit.

games.name: S.O.N.A.R. - Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready
games.shortDescription: S.O.N.A.R. (Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready) is a 1–6 player co-op submarine sim where teamwork is essential, panic is inevitable, and sinking is always one wrong button away. Use sonar, pilot, fight, repair, and pray your friends know what to do.
games.aboutText:
S.O.N.A.R. is a 1–6 player online co-op submarine simulator where teamwork is essential, panic is inevitable, and sinking is always just one wrong button away. Coordinate with your crew, use sonar to detect threats, and operate a cutting-edge submarine through combat operations, stealth infiltrations, and treasure recovery missions. Repair catastrophic malfunctions, recalibrate complex systems, and desperately hope that the person sitting next to you isn't just randomly pressing buttons.

UNDERWATER MISSIONS

The oceans are under enemy control. Gather a team of highly trained specialists (or at least people who claim they know what they're doing) and complete dangerous missions beneath the waves.

- Locate hostile vessels with sonar and send them to the bottom of the sea. Preferably before they do the same to you.

- Protect valuable cargo ships. Because apparently the military couldn't find anyone else to babysit them.

- Hunt for treasures. Use sonar to search the ocean floor for lost riches, forgotten artifacts, and evidence of previous crews' poor decisions.

- Slip past enemy destroyers undetected. Stay quiet. Stay hidden. And whatever you do, don't sneeze.

COOPERATION

Up to four crew members must work together to manage nine critical stations, including navigation, diving, sonar, periscope operations, engineering, and damage control. Your sonar operator tracks contacts while the rest of the crew keeps the submarine alive. When the sub catches fire or starts taking on water from twelve different holes at once, communication is the only thing standing between you and becoming fish food.

Use proximity voice chat to:

- Shout urgent orders.

- Warn everyone about imminent disaster.

- Explain why the catastrophe is definitely someone else's fault.

And if a crewmate starts reading the manual during a torpedo attack, give ’em a friendly slap back to reality!

Nothing says "successful mission" quite like a victory dance while all hell breaks loose.

CUSTOMIZATION

In S.O.N.A.R. every character is unique. Choose from dozens of uniforms, hats, and questionable fashion choices. Customize your equipment before deployment and unlock new gear as you level up. If you're going to make terrible decisions underwater, you should at least look good doing it.

SURVIVAL

Machines aren't the only things that break down. Humans do too.

Manage your crew's food supplies, rest schedules, and overall well-being. Neglect them for too long and they'll become exhausted, seasick, delirious, or mysteriously incapable of following simple instructions.

Health Tip: You really, really don't want to be vomiting inside your diving helmet when it's your turn to load the torpedoes.

Trust us on this one.

games.name: VHOLUME
games.shortDescription: VHOLUME is a melancholic first-person parkour adventure set in a dystopian brutalist city where bureaucracy turns a simple task into an odyssey.
games.aboutText:
In the derelict capital of Afro-Eurasia, ruled by an all-controlling Ministry, Robert embarks on a bureaucratic quest to restore his family’s revoked ration tickets .

Movement-centric gameplay where the player can jump, run, climb and slide with great freedom . Environments challenge both agility and creativity .

Mastery-driven players can exploit momentum, discover shortcuts , and break the labyrinthine design, making each run a test of skill and efficiency as they chase target times .

Play solo, or join friends in multiplayer and experience every level together.

See other players’ ghosts, share your own, and discover new ways through each level.

Steam workshop support: Play levels made by the community or create your own.

games.name: Emissary One
games.shortDescription: Co-op horror (1 to 6+ players). The squad was sent to the next site, but contact was lost. Find them and team up for the current mission. It seems you're not alone here again.
games.aboutText:
The squad was sent to the next site, but contact was lost. Find them and team up for the current mission. It seems you're not alone here again.

- Various creepy monsters.

- Play the story campaign alone or with a company online (up to 6 players or more) or with splitscreen multiplayer (up to 2 people).

- A large changing location with lots of exploration. Explore the area and complete tasks. Use vehicles to reach hard-to-access areas more quickly. Adapt to changing weather.

- Communicate via voice chat in the game online.

- Invade other players’ worlds as hostile entities.

games.name: TROLLHEIM: GNOMES
games.shortDescription: Explore an ancient, living forest as a tiny gnome in this co-op PVE survival crafting adventure inspired by Nordic folklore. Gather, craft and build a home for your gnome family amongst the treetops, and encounter the Väsen, mythical beings both friendly and dangerous. Play solo or up to 8 players
games.aboutText:
The last Sprýg Gnomes in Midgård are driven from their home by Oden and his corruption, leaving them one place left to go: Trollheim, a magical realm of mythical beings where trolls, faeries and sirens are real. Set out into the unknown to reunite with your lost kin, and behold the untold tales of the Väsen who dwell in the Dark Forest alongside you.

TROLLHEIM: GNOMES is a PvE survival adventure where you must reunite your gnome companions to survive and thrive together in the Dark Forest. Explore an ancient Nordic wilderness, uncover its mysteries, encounter the Väsen - the mythical beings of Nordic folk belief, and make the forest your home. Play solo or with up to 7 friends in a procedurally grown forest sandbox.

The Dark Forest found you.

Into the Dark Forest

Step into an ancient forest through the eyes of a tiny gnome. Every tall pine, mossy hill and damp rock is a climb, and every climb is a challenge of its own. Stumble across scattered gnome dwellings, delve into mossy caverns and explore carefully curated biomes teeming with life.

The pressure to survive drives you forward, opening up new possibilities and discoveries as the Dark Forest reveals itself as a living world of mystery, wonder and danger. Cold, hunger and hidden threats push you to adapt. Gather blueberries and twigs, craft everything from arrows to musical instruments. This is a wilderness not just meant to be explored, but a place to understand and ultimately call home.

Live Among the Väsen

The Väsen: Trolls, faeries, sirens and other mythical beings also call the Dark Forest home, each one handcrafted and drawn from the World of Trollheim. Some will wander over and join you by the campfire. Some will attack on sight. Calm their nerves or offer them something in return, and they might even come and live with you.

Make the Forest Your Home

Let creativity shape your dwelling, wherever feels like home. Build idyllic housing in the treetops, within hollowed logs, tucked into rock crevices or by the mist-filled forest lakes. Add bridges, clad your walls in moss and set some low lighting, whether you're blending into nature or standing out as uniquely yours.

Survive and Thrive

TROLLHEIM: GNOMES is a place to connect with yourself, nature, and each other. It is fully playable solo offline or in co-op with friends, supporting up to 8 players.

For more adventures in the Dark Forest visit our website

Enter the Dark Forest and the untold tales of Väsen through an interconnected narrative spanning books, collectibles, music, games, and more.

games.name: Freefall '95
games.shortDescription: Chain massive trick combos, dodge deadly debris, and chase huge scores in this fast-paced arcade adventure. Earn coins, upgrade abilities, collect rare items, and uncover a wild time-bending narrative aboard this doomed flight in the year 1995
games.aboutText:
