You're the sole survivor of a mid-air plane explosion, plummeting towards the earth. What do you do with the time you have left?

Might as well do some rad tricks.

Pull off huge combos, grab other people's falling luggage, and dodge dangerous debris to build up huge scores.

And then groundhog your way back to the plane and do it all again. Back on the plane you can interact with fellow passengers, buy stuff with your hard-earned coins, and take on quests to discover what might be causing this aviation nightmare.

Inspired by games like Tony Hawk's Pro Skater , SSX Tricky and other classic extreme sports games, Freefall '95 combines arcade score-chasing, exploration and an absurd time-bending story all wrapped in a heavily 90s-flavoured pixel-art world with a pumping soundtrack.

Features

- 5 sprawling levels evolving over 3 difficulty tiers, 15 stages in all, devolving into bullet hell mania

- A deep trick and combo system for chasing HUGE scores

- Arcade-style Challenge Levels for bite-sized, score-attack runs

- Roguelike Gauntlets: chain 3, 5, or 7 levels back-to-back on a single health bar, picking from 3 rewards when you achieve each goal

- An absurd, time-bending narrative

- Leaderboards, with friends-only and worldwide options

- Ability items that let you explore and experience levels in wild new ways

- Adjust your loadout with Traits and build a playstyle that works for you

games.name: Your Mom
games.shortDescription: Your mom is here, come quickly to play happily with your mom.
games.aboutText:
Your Mom is a desktop simulation game.

Feeling that your computer desktop is too plain? Want to find a gentle mom to keep you company? Then try this desktop mom!

Instructions:

Supports gaze tracking with the mouse, dragging, rotating and zooming in and out.

Drag with the left mouse button, rotate with the right mouse button and use the scroll wheel to zoom in and out.

Right-clicking on the character brings up menu options, which allow for changing costumes and making related settings.

Contents:

The game includes a gentle mom character and multiple costumes.

Productivity & Cozy Features:

Pomodoro Timer — Customize focus and break durations to build a comfortable rhythm for work or study.

To-Do List — Create tasks, organize them into categories, set priorities and track completion.

Smart Reminders — Schedule one-time or daily reminders for work, study plans, important dates and everyday tasks.

White Noise Player — Mix relaxing ambience such as rain, forests and cafés, with independent volume controls.

Cozy Music Player — Enjoy curated Cozy / Lofi tracks with categories, favorites, shuffle, repeat and a mini player.

Dance with Your Music:

Choose from the built-in dance collection, import your own VMD files, and play, loop or smoothly switch between dances whenever you like.

Link dances to the built-in music player: assign a specific dance to each song, use shuffle, or repeat the current dance.

Prefer Spotify, YouTube or another music app? Enable external music linking, choose which apps may trigger dancing, and she will start or stop with the music. The built-in player always takes priority.

Motion-aware effects and automatic expressions add a lively touch without stealing the spotlight.

games.name: Break Shoot
games.shortDescription: Break Shoot combines the precision of billiards with roguelike builds. Stack powerful ball abilities and accessories to explode your score and crush each round's target!
games.aboutText:
Shoot the Ball, Beat the Score

Line up the perfect shot, trigger spectacular chain reactions, and smash past the target score before the round ends!

Every Round is a New Puzzle

No two tables ask the same question. Read each layout, find the right angle, and turn a tricky board into a scoring opportunity.

Build Your Own Strategy

Choose ball abilities and accessories that fit your playstyle. Combine their effects, refine your build, and create your own route to a high score.

games.name: Cirno! Lifts a Boulder
games.shortDescription: Help Cirno get back into her home! A chill, bite-sized 3D platformer in which you explore a frozen Misty Lake and gain boulder-lifting strength.
games.aboutText:
A Boulder is No Match for This Fairy!

A mischievous group of fairies has locked Cirno out of her very own home by placing a huge boulder right in front of it. Luckily for Cirno, getting rid of it is simple: she just needs to get stronger .

How? By collecting Power items, of course!

Cirno! Lifts a Boulder is a short and relaxing 3D platformer and Touhou fangame in which the titular ice fairy explores a frozen-over Misty Lake in search of strength-granting items. As Cirno grows more powerful, she unlocks distinct abilities that help her navigate the snowy landscape and reach new areas.

- Explore the Misty Lake any way you like : you never know what you might run into!

- Set your own pace : There's no rush. Sprint across the ice, or take a leisurely walk along the lakeshore.

- Unlock abilities : As Cirno gets stronger, she gradually remembers what an ice fairy is truly capable of.

- Find hidden frogs : Several sneaky frogs are hiding around the lake. Can you find them all?

- Listen to some tunes : Get lost in the snow with an arranged soundtrack by lapspider45!

games.name: Gum Squad
games.shortDescription: Gum Squad is a co-op PvE shooter set in a quiet world gone sticky. Start with a peashooter, explore together, and gear up to survive the gum epidemic with up to 8 players!
games.aboutText:
Play Co-op PvE with up to 8 friends!!

The world is quiet… a little dusty… and very, very sticky. Gum Squad drops you into wide open fields and sleepy deserts where gum became the world’s favorite resource, and maybe its biggest mistake. With a humble peashooter and a few friends by your side, you’ll wander curious places, uncover what went wrong, and slowly build yourself up from whatever you can scavenge.

There’s no rush but the danger is real. Enemies move with intent, take cover, and push back when they spot you, turning calm exploration into sudden, focused firefights. Between trips, tune your loadout, manage your inventory, and customize your character before heading out again.

A quiet world, a sticky problem, and just enough trouble to keep things interesting.

Created by a human

Made by one silly gal named Fern, with the love and support of the whole FreshWaterFern community. This game was put together in 90 days as a silly experiment.

Key Features

- Online PvE - Start a world and jump right into the action with up to 8 friends !

- Character Customization - Make changes to your outfit with a large range of options or dress up with loot that you find on your adventure!

- Character Progression - Gain XP as you defeat enemies and level up various skills to build yourself into the gum demon of your dreams.

- Exciting Gun Fights - Go against NPCs that take cover, peek out to shoot at you, and fall back when they need to reload.

- Massive Game World - Explore a gummed-up world full of enemies, loot, and skateboards??

- In-depth Inventory Systems - Manage your carrying weight, organize your bag before going on trips.

games.name: STEP THEATER
games.shortDescription: WELCOME TO THE “STEP THEATER” :) “STEP THEATER” is a vibrant rhythm game where the story unfolds and the screen comes closer to success with every step you take. Dive in and enjoy this charming, vibrant drama!
games.aboutText:
WELCOME TO THE “STEP THEATER” :)

An uplifting rhythm game where your steps bring stories to life.

STEP THEATER is a music-and-rhythm game where you step to the beat to bring each “film” to life.

With every step, the story begins to unfold, the stage comes alive with color, and each film takes shape. As you progress, STEP THEATER gradually regains its buzz, and new films begin their run.

Each film offers a unique world and style, from tales of school life to side-scrolling-game-inspired stages. The music, backgrounds, characters, and actions all change from stage to stage, keeping every play session fresh.

Adorable characters in motion, catchy original songs, and stories brought to life by your own steps.

With your steps, make the theatre light and lively again.

ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー

Features

- A game system where the story comes together as you play on the music

- A wide variety of stages, each with its own theme, presentation, and actions

- Cute character animation paired with a warm art style

- Colorful pop tracks

Collaborating Creators

Graphics: Subikaka, Aramon

Sound: Chroma, Mafumafu

Estimated Demo Playtime

20 minutes

【Guidelines for Gameplay Streaming and Uploading Video Content】

We welcome livestreams and gameplay uploads from individuals and corporate entities. However, please be sure to review and comply with the following guidelines:

- Please include the game link in easy-to-access locations for viewers, like the description box.

- Monetization through features offered by video streaming platforms, including ad revenue and tips, as well as exclusive streaming and posting for paid members via membership plans, is allowed.

- Posting or streaming videos containing defamatory content or violating public order and morals is prohibited.

- NB Games is not liable for any damages or issues resulting from video posting or streaming.

- These guidelines may change without prior notice. The most recent version will apply to videos posted or streamed after any updates.

games.name: Pickupbal
games.shortDescription: A simple game all about picking up a ball.
games.aboutText:
Do you want to play my game?

Pickupbal is a simple arcade game about picking up a ball and trying to keep it in the air for as long as possible while avoiding enemies and juggling them.

- Easy to pick up, hard to master.

- Endless waves that increase in difficulty

- Cursor-based ball spinning for maximum style

- Cards that spice up each run

- Raise, collect and sell fish from the Fish Tank

- Unlockable cosmetics and backgrounds

- Global leaderboards

games.name: SONIC PICO PARK
games.shortDescription: The co-op action puzzle game series PICO PARK is back... and this time, we're teaming up with SEGA's legendary Sonic the Hedgehog! This collaboration is packed with co-op gameplay that combines the flair of Sonic with the puzzle teamwork fun of PICO PARK! Play locally or online with 2 to 8 players!
games.aboutText:
Sonic dashes into the world of the hit indie game, PICO PARK!

Experience the multiplayer co-op action puzzle gameplay of the PICO PARK series like never before! In our latest entry, the PICO PARK series is teaming up with SEGA's legendary Sonic the Hedgehog!

SONIC PICO PARK is a 2D action puzzle game where cooperation is essential!

The rules are simple: just reach the goal plate on the right side of each stage. But the only way to succeed is for everyone to work together.

This exciting crossover lets every playable character use Sonic's iconic Spin Dash, while adding classic Sonic-style gameplay elements such as rings, loops, and springs! Team up with your friends and take on these new challenges together!

Just like the rest of the series, the game supports 2 to 8 players locally or online. All content can be enjoyed with any number of players! Online play also supports cross-play, and up to 7 local players can join online from a single PC.

Combining the flair of Sonic and the puzzle teamwork fun of PICO PARK, this one-of-a-kind collaboration is packed with fun for everyone... whether you experience it with family, friends, your partner, or even new teammates you meet online!

Gather your squad and try it today!

games.name: Jibbers
games.shortDescription: Physics-driven ski game with fully simulated bodies and flexible skis. No trick buttons. Control, timing, and motion earn every move. Full customization, tunable physics, community maps, multiplayer.
games.aboutText:
What is it?

A physics-driven ski game focused on control and realism:

- Fully physics-based character and ski simulation

- Free, analog-style controls that are hard but intuitive

- Tricks are earned through motion and timing, not button combos

- Realistic body dynamics for setting tricks

- Full collision with terrain and objects

- Flexible, physically simulated skis

Current State

The project is in active development. Patreon-supported playtesting and early access are planned.

Planned Features

- Deep Customization: clothing, skis, poles, custom grabs & stances

- Extensive physics and feel tuning options

- Community-made custom maps

- Multiplayer

- Snowboards & Monoski

games.name: Orbrix
games.shortDescription: Orbrix is a bullet heaven where you craft a unique build to defend against a swarm of bricks. Discover devastating synergies across 60+ upgrades. Survive 10 waves and bosses, then push your build to absurd limits in endless mode. Plus, there are alien pets!
games.aboutText:
Orbrix is a bullet heaven meets idle breakout game , built around satisfying bullet bounces, build experimentation, and mesmerizing visuals.

Meet your pets!

Unlock more pets as you play. Feed them colorful pellets that drop from destroyed bricks, and they'll lay eggs colored by what they ate. Spend eggs on special upgrades or sell them for extra cash. Can you collect all 35 pets?

Create your own build

There's no single path to victory. Mix and match 60+ unique upgrades with 275+ levels across 4 upgrade systems , then experiment to find the build that works for you. Unlock ability bullets (bomb, scatter, electric, poison, ice and lazer), satellites, proxy mines and special bricks, and discover the synergies between them.

Challenges, achievements and 25 color palettes

Think you've mastered Orbrix ? Try one of the challenges in challenge mode ! Or unlock all achievements, each one unlocking a new color palette! Or compete in the online leaderboard !

Endless waves of bricks

Fight through 10 unique brick waves , each ending in a boss fight against one of 7 unique bosses . Beat the final boss to finish the game, then keep going in endless mode , where the bosses come back stronger.

Can you beat all 10 waves and escape the Orbrix?

games.name: Split Happens
games.shortDescription: Manage an old, rundown nuclear power plant with up to 5 friends in online co-op. Fix hazards before you put the reactor in critical condition, manage the chaos to avoid a meltdown, and try not to get in the way of your coworkers.
games.aboutText:
Fix hazards using whatever tools you can get your hands on. Pipes will burst, systems will fail, and there’s never enough time to do things “the right way.” Luckily, duct tape, mops, and questionable engineering decisions are usually good enough to keep the reactor from exploding… for now.

Manage the reactor’s power by pulling the energy lever. The higher the output, the more unstable the reactor becomes, meaning more hazards, more panic, and more reasons for your coworkers to yell at you.

Not every minute has to be intense, radioactive chaos. If you manage to find a spare moment between disasters, take some time to mess around with your coworkers, dance, joke, and make a few questionable decisions that definitely won’t slow things down later.

games.name: HOLO-KINGDOM
games.shortDescription: This is a 3D action game where you control Hololive members and fight your way through enemies to clear each stage.Carefully read enemy attacks and overcome challenging trials using parries and evasive maneuvers.This game requires keyboard and mouse controls.
games.aboutText:
The kingdom stands on the brink of collapse.

To save the world—and the people who cherish Hololive—
a warrior takes up their weapon once more.

■ What is HoloKingdom?

This is a world kept in peace by the “Holomembers,” beings blessed with extraordinary powers.

However, a sudden invasion by a mysterious enemy has plunged the kingdom into its greatest crisis.

You must protect the last hope, Princess Luna, and lead this battle to victory.

■ What kind of game is it?

This is a 3D action game where you control Hololive members and fight your way through enemies to clear each stage.

Each of the four playable characters wields a unique weapon and combat style, challenging you to survive intense battles.

Learn skills rooted in the history of the Holo Kingdom and defeat incoming enemies with each character’s distinctive abilities.

Some stages also feature light puzzle elements that you must solve in order to progress.

games.name: Candellum
games.shortDescription: Play as a candle warrior fighting to keep your flame alive in a world where fire means life and death. Steal wax from enemies to survive, wield your flame tactically in intense hack-and-slash combat, and uncover the dark secrets of a dormant wax factory filled with danger !
games.aboutText:
Candellum is a top down hack-and-slash where fire is everything. Trapped in a dormant wax factory crawling with hostile candle warriors, you must fight, think, and burn your way to the truth lurking in its darkest depths.

In this world, fire means life. And life means death.

You are a candle. A warrior. And you are always on the verge of melting away.

Your candle can be lit , hitting harder, burning brighter, but draining your wax with every second. Or unlit , preserving what's left of you, at the cost of your power. Neither state is safe. Neither can be ignored.

The twist? You throw your flame to switch states, and wherever it lands, it lands on an enemy. Ignite a foe to weaken them. Pull your flame back to slow your own decay. Every decision ripples across the battlefield.

Key Features

- MASTER THE FLAME THROW SYSTEM. Toggle between Lit and Unlit modes by throwing your flame mid-combat. Your enemies, fellow candle warriors, operate the same way. Learn to exploit their states before they exploit yours.

- STEAL WAX TO SURVIVE. Health doesn't regenerate on its own. Rip wax from defeated enemies to keep your candle burning.

- SLASH, THINK, REPEAT. Intense hack-and-slash combat meets environmental puzzles. Pure aggression will only get you so far sometimes you need to stop and think before you burn.

- EXPLORE A FORSAKEN FACTORY. Navigate the dark corridors of a dormant wax factory, uncovering the grim secrets buried within its walls. Not everything that's dormant stays that way.

- FACE DIVERSE THREATS. From nimble candle scouts to hulking wax brutes, each enemy type demands a different approach. Adapt or melt.

- CONFRONT THE FINAL BOSS. One last, formidable threat guards the factory's darkest secret. It knows fire too, perhaps better than you do.

Candellum is an award-winning student game, recognized with multiple prizes for its innovative dual-state gameplay and atmospheric design.

games.name: Farmed & Dangerous
games.shortDescription: Not another farming game. Plant by night, then defend your crops from dawn to dusk in a first-person roguelite shooter, solo or in 3-player online co-op. Blast crop-hungry crows out of the sky with shotguns, turrets, air strikes and the occasional RPG. Miss the truck's order and the run is over.
games.aboutText:
Grandpa left you three things: the farm, a bag of carrot seeds, and his old revolver. You're going to need all three.

DEFEND THE HARVEST

Your farm is under siege from the sky. By day the crows come, wave after wave and more of them each morning, and you meet them in first person. Start with Grandpa's revolver and work up to shotguns, SMGs, a grenade launcher, an RPG and, for some reason, a katana. Back them up with auto turrets, sprinklers and scarecrows.

Keep everything watered while you shoot, because every peck and every dry hour is yield you never get back. Snatch a crow off your tomatoes and throw it. When it all goes wrong, radio in the Crop Duster or call down a nuke. Or just fire a rocket into a circling flock and watch the birds rain out of the sky.

PLANT BY NIGHT

When the sun goes down, the shooting stops. Night is safe and in no hurry: plant, harvest, shop and plan. Any crop that survives the day grows another stage.

FEED THE TRUCK

Farmed & Dangerous is a roguelite where killing earns you nothing (golden birds excepted): the crops are the economy, and you are their heavily armed babysitter. Sell your harvest to pay for seeds, turrets and air support, or stockpile it for the delivery truck that rolls in every few days demanding a bigger order. Miss the order and the run is over.

BRING FRIENDS

Up to three farmers can work the same farm in online co-op. You share one wallet and one truck order, with proximity voice chat for yelling across the cornfield. The flock grows with your crew.

BEND THE RUN

Three perk cards hit the table at nightfall. Pick one and bend the run your way. In co-op, the whole crew votes.

Feeling lucky? The farm's casino has slots, roulette and blackjack for the money you probably should have spent on sprinklers.

KEEP WHAT YOU GROW

Between runs, spend your hard-earned Cores on land that stays yours, new guns for the armory wall, and a basement grow room for the one crop the truck driver doesn't need to know about.

Then start again a little stronger, on a farm that gets a little louder every day.

games.name: All Rats on Deck
games.shortDescription: All Rats on Deck is an online co-op adventure game where you must navigate a paddle steam boat through dangerous waters. Forced to leave your home, you must work together to operate the boat, scour for resources, and overcome obstacles to reach the ocean.
games.aboutText:
All Rats on Deck is an online co-op adventure game where you must navigate a paddle steam boat through dangerous waters. Forced to leave your home, you must work together to operate the boat, scour for resources, and overcome obstacles to reach the ocean.

NAVIGATE YOUR SCRAPPY STEAMBOAT

You and your rat buddies have put together a steamboat made from scraps and loose parts. Navigate this pile of junk as you are forced to leave your home.

SURVIVE DANGEROUS WATERS

The waters ahead are treacherous, so take good care of your boat and don't just go full throttle down fast rapids (or do, it's pretty funny).

REACH THE OCEAN

Rats are being forced to leave their homes. You will need to find a way out of the swamps to reach the ocean.

WORK TOGETHER TO OVERCOME OBSTACLES

On your adventure, you will come across many obstacles. Working together with your friends will be essential in overcoming them while keeping the boat in one piece.

SCOUR FOR RESOURCES TO KEEP THE ENGINE FED

The engine needs to be fed. Luckily, it can take just about anything you get your hands on*.

*DISCLAIMER: we are not responsible for side effects and exploding engines, feed at YOUR OWN RISK.

Features:

- Navigate a Steamboat with up to 4 players

- Boat grapple gun

- Engine - can feed it anything (with potential side effects)

- Online co-op

- Proximity voice chat

games.name: Ship or Burn! Coop express
games.shortDescription: Someone’s order burned? At least the train made it! Explore a dangerous open world, deliver cargo, and protect it from zombies. Out of fuel? Toss someone’s parcel, a zombie, or your annoying friend into the firebox! Online co-op for 1 to 4 players.
games.aboutText:
The train runs as long as something's burning. Toss everything into the furnace.

You and your friends are couriers on a locomotive that only runs while something's burning in the firebox. Coal. Parcels. Zombies. Someone's wedding cake. Decide fast — the station won't wait.

Delivery, chaos and greed for 1–4 players

At every station you pick and deliver parcels: expensive, fragile, too heavy to carry alone, suspiciously wriggling. Load the cars, plot your route. The train devours fuel, zombies claw at your cargo, and the next station is still far away. You decide what matters more: delivering the order intact, or chucking it into the furnace to reach the next stop and cash in on something pricier.

Special Delivery: Chaos

Zombies want your cargo? Make them work for it. Shoot, kick and throw anything you can grab to keep them off your train. Your friends are throwable too, so try to agree on who’s fighting and who’s flying. And if a zombie gets too close, there’s always room in the furnace.

What will end up in your furnace?

Grab your friends. Grab the train. Grab more parcels than you can carry. Let's see how much you deliver, and how much burns along the way.

Add to wishlist so you don't miss the demo launch!

games.name: Plink Lab
games.shortDescription: A satisfying active plinko incremental where you drop and bounce fantastic creatures (tiny humans for starters) to clear pegs and earn a trillion $! Wacky balls, massive tech tree, total physics-based chaos, and a very chatty goblin shop owner.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Plink Lab! Play as Dr. Plink and drop kidnapped humans, griffins, cyclopes, along with many other wacky mythical creatures into the special plinko machine where they'll get smashed in cauldrons so you can earn loads of money. Clear enough pegs before time runs out to take on your next challenge.

Spend your hard-earned money wisely in Lou's shop, and unlock upgrades that create wild synergies. From splitter balls and chain lightning to poison and explosions, every new upgrade can push your plinko boards to the next level.

Explore 100+ Tech Tree nodes, discover powerful combos, and grab temporary pick-ups that can completely change the course of a run.

Featuring 20 challenging stages, 14 unique balls, 5 peg types with 3 modifiers, 5 multiplier buckets, and 8 powerful pick-ups, you are bound to experience a wild ride.

Get ready to send 1,000+ balls flying at once, bouncing through boards packed with 100+ pegs in a spectacular frenzy of bouncing, splitting, exploding madness, and walk away filthy rich.

games.name: RUNNING TRAIN | 走ル列車！
games.shortDescription: New realistic 3DCG Train Game is here! Step into the crew's cabin and immerse yourself as train operator. Navigate 40km+ across Japanese Rural Railway with breathtakingly detailed scenery through the seaside and heart of countryside.
games.aboutText:
HOP ON OPERATOR'S CABIN!

Start your journey along Coastal Hayamori Railway and Rural Kofuku Railway . both routes have distinct operational pattern and characteristic. Make sure that your passengers get from station to station safely!

EASY TO LEARN / HARD TO MASTER!

Love the challenge? turn on HARD-MODE, or NO-UI, or even NO-SPEEDOMETER mode for extra score!

FREE MODE!

Tired of driving and got punishing too much in scoring mode? Set back and relax, let AI driver drive the train and you can enjoy breathtaking environment along coastal and rural Japanese as both passenger and trainspotter.

GET CREATIVE!

Your vision, your train. Customize your liveries with open textures and bring your designs to life!

ELEVATE YOUR IMMERSION WITH CONTROLLER SUPPORT!

COMPLETE FEATURE LISTS:

- 4 Train type with different characteristic

- 2 Fictional Railway operator spanning 40km of meticulously handcrafted fully detailed route

- Railway Safety system such as Vigilance and Automatic Train Stop implemented

- Semi-realistic physics, arcade control and train motion

- Features over 40 diagrams both local and express train spanning early morning, afternoon, and nighttime operation.

- 2 seasons available: Sakura Spring and Snowy Winter

- Selectable weather and environment settings

- Master controller support

- Auto-drive mode, let you enjoy route scenery as passenger or trainspotter

- Open livery editor

- Photo mode

games.name: Knuckle Creek
games.shortDescription: Knuckle Creek is a slapstick single player and multiplayer party game designed for chaotic fun, crazy characters and weapons galore. Complete an extensive solo campaign with hundreds of unlockables or party it up with friends in one of the many couch play or online party modes.
games.aboutText:
From the team who brought you the Overwhelmingly Positive rated Platypus Reclayed, Knuckle Creek is the ultimate clay-animated single player and party brawler for up to 8 players, offering chaotic couch play and online party modes. The solo campaign includes 48+ handcrafted levels and 100s of cosmetics to unlock, while multiplayer offers a multitude of configurable ways to play.

If you like slapstick brawling with friends from your sofa then this is the game for you. If you like them but nobody’s around tonight, this is still the game for you!

Grab a fish, rocket launcher, or even a chicken, and battle your opponents. Matches last minutes, the rules can change every round, and even knocked out players can be agents of chaos. Welcome to Knuckle Creek, home of the world famous Knuckle Sandwich.

KEY FEATURES

- 48+ levels Single Player campaign with Steam Friend leaderboard support

- Couch play and online party mode for up to 8 friends

- Character customisation with hundreds of cosmetics, voices, and more

- Full multiplayer game customisation

games.name: BOMBANANA!
games.shortDescription: Chaotic bomb disposal fun with friends & monkeys! Work together as a 3-player co-op team of blind, deaf, and mute monkeys. Each player has only part of the needed information. Communicate, solve puzzles, and race against the clock. Can you defuse the bombs before they explode?
games.aboutText:
BOMBANANA! is a chaotic, explosively funny co-op multiplayer game for three, where each player has only part of the information - blind monkey, deaf monkey and mute monkey must work together to defuse a bomb, or everyone goes BOOM! Will your friendship survive the ultimate test?

MEET YOUR SQUAD!

🙈 Blind Monkey: You can’t see the bomb, but you can touch the bomb! 👍 Sadly, you can’t see colors or read screens. You’ll need to rely on your teammates for the rest.

🙊 Mute Monkey: You are the only one who can read the bomb disposal manual. If only you could tell the others what you know.

🙉 Deaf Monkey: You can see the bomb and you can see your friends as they frantically gesture at you. Sadly, you can’t hear a thing, but at this point, would you even want to?

As you gamble with your friends' lives, you must rely on each other and your monkeys' unique abilities. Communication is key, and there’s no one right way to defuse the bomb. We don’t impose any methods: wave, shout, throw bananas. Working out how you communicate is your job.

WARNING!

Players can and should expect peak amounts of misunderstanding, unjust accusations, and desperate body language, placing your friendships in jeopardy. Just because you keep talking, that doesn't mean nobody explodes. Even if you manage to survive the bomb, there's no guarantee your friendship will. Some might call this game "friendslop". We disagree. If anything, it's a new genre: anti-friendslop, or perhaps an argument simulator. 🤔

We’ll let you be the judge!

FEATURES!

- 3-Player Co-op - No more, no less. Exactly three monkeys required

- 3 Game Modes -

- Campaign - 30 handcrafted levels with increasing difficulty

- Endless - Procedurally generated, wave-based levels that keep getting harder

- Custom - Players create their own challenge by adjusting bomb difficulty, the timer, module types, environmental hazards, and how many mistakes are allowed

- Asymmetric Roles - Every player sees, hears, and acts differently

- Fun interactions - Point, wave, gesture or flail wildly. Your options are only limited by your imagination and each player's Emote wheel

- Slapping - Obviously an essential feature

- New Environments: We all know the trusty minivan, but what about a plane? What other environments can you defuse bombs in?

- Environmental Hazards: Navigate events like power outages, obstructions and loud interruptions

- Voice Chat - Some of you can talk, some of you can’t. You’ll figure it out

- Puzzle Modules - Each bomb has different modules and different rules, all of which are guaranteed to induce different kinds of panic

- Level System - Defuse the bomb to unlock new levels. The better you get, the harder they are

- Color Blind Mode - Just because the monkey is blind, doesn’t mean he can’t defuse a bomb! Colors used across objects and the UI have been adapted to support two different types of color blindness.

games.name: While 1
games.shortDescription: Don't touch the walls. While 1 is a minimalist mouse-only action game centered around this simple concept. Create a loop around the level while avoiding obstacles synchronized to the music.
games.aboutText:
Don't touch the walls. While 1 is a minimalist mouse-only action game centered around this simple concept. Create a loop around the level while avoiding obstacles synchronized to the music.

- One rule: don't touch the walls.

- Create a loop around the level. If you touch any of the walls, you must start over.

- Inspired by games in the Flash-era, While 1 recreates the satisfaction of this genre of gameplay as a complete experience.

- Designed to be played entirely with a mouse, the game tests your precision and coordination.

- Some levels will require quick movements and careful timing to overcome.

- Particles are collectibles that appear throughout some levels.

- All particles must be collected before finishing the loop.

- If you hit a wall, the level can be restarted instantly by just returning to the start point, making attempts feel riskless.

- Each song will have 2 levels sets: Normal & Expert.

- Enjoy the music in Normal mode for a more casual experience, or take on the Expert levels for an even greater challenge.

games.name: SuperReap
games.shortDescription: Super Reap is a cozy active incremental harvesting game where you swing your scythe through wildly overgrown crops, sell resources for coins, unlock talents, skill cards, gear, and new harvesting methods, and transform a rundown farm into an efficient reaping paradise.
games.aboutText:
Super Reap is a wildly satisfying, hands-on incremental harvesting game. Cut through fields of overgrown plants, enjoy the satisfying impact of every swing, and transform a battered old scythe into an unstoppable harvesting machine.

Featuring:

- 🌾 Satisfying harvesting across fields of diverse crops

- 🌳 A massive skill tree that takes your harvesting power to new heights

- 🎴 Exciting talent card draws and build-defining combinations

- 🐔 Restore a neglected farmyard, plant crops, and reap the rewards

- 🦊 Befriend charming animals and unlock new tools, weapons, and items

- 🎨 Warm and nostalgic pixel art

Wildly satisfying, stress-relieving crop harvesting

Pick One of Three and Shape Your Build

Choose one of three talent cards with every draw. Powerful talents can dramatically increase your harvesting abilities, while different combinations allow you to create a build of your own.

A Skill Tree That Literally Grows

Increase the number of crops in each field, unlock new crop varieties, improve your tools, and discover new weapons, items, and friends as the skill tree continues to grow.

Every Crop Remains Valuable

Different crops form an interconnected resource system, so even the most basic plants remain useful throughout the game. Trade your harvest for coins, then spend them on new weapons, equipment, and useful items.

A Peaceful Farm That Keeps Producing

Restore your farmyard and plant crops of your own. The farm continues producing resources while you take a break, giving you plenty to harvest when you return.

games.name: Cielle is Not Happy
games.shortDescription: Cielle is Not Happy is a psychological horror RPG in which you play as a girl named Cielle, who encounters erratic events throughout her journey, leading her to uncover cryptic secrets about herself and the world around her.
games.aboutText:
Tales of Judgement

A sick girl lives in a world beyond meaning, seeing things no one else can. To encounter Judge Nothing, she must converse with its people, decipher its mysteries, and do the work of the Archons, while monsters from the House of Eyes begin to emerge.

Control your emotions. Face your trauma, depression, and stress. Fall in love. And uncover the truth about yourself and the world you live in.

A World of Deceit

Live in a world consumed by corruption, political deception, and economic manipulation and carve your way through the corruption to reach your ultimate goal.

The Hungry Eyes

Chain of Eyes allows you to land heavy attacks with a moderate chance. Logic is used to analyze enemies, thoughts, and weaknesses, while Concentrate increases the power of your attacks and abilities. Fight them, and watch your eyes carefully, for they are desperately needed.

The Lives We Carry

Talk to each character and learn about their lives. Then, delve into your own mind and life, confronting your inner struggles and hardships.

A Story, Written by Dana Khedri or The Great Pineapple (Tegep)

Dana Khedri (The Great Pineapple) is the writer of this game's story.

It's Always Legacy First.

games.name: Idle Pixel Battle
games.shortDescription: Build your hero party in a fantasy idle auto battler packed with loot and progression. Collect powerful artifacts, unlock more than 200 upgrades, automate your runs, and take on new challenges.
games.aboutText:
Idle Pixel Battle is a fantasy idle auto battler focused on loot, upgrades, and constant progression. Build your party, watch your heroes fight automatically, and shape their strength through equipment, abilities, and lasting upgrades.

Experiment with heroes including the Knight, Archer, and Mage, each with their own stats, weapons, and abilities. Fight through 5 fantasy biomes, including grasslands, dungeons, and volcanic plains. Face over 40 enemy types with their own abilities and mechanics, and take on challenging bosses.

Collect gold and procedurally generated weapons with different rarity tiers, use potions in critical moments, and discover more than 40 artifacts that can change how your party performs. Try different combinations to strengthen your team throughout each run.

Between battles, discover treasure chests filled with loot, meet a goblin merchant, try your luck at the slot machine, or recover at a healing fountain. Visit the blacksmith to modify and improve your hero abilities for the current run.

Progress does not end when a run is over. Earn rewards and invest them in a large meta progression tree with more than 200 unlocks and upgrades that carry over between runs. Unlock new heroes, additional systems, stronger rewards, faster game speeds, and Auto-Run features for increasingly automated gameplay.

Defeat the boss of the final biome to unlock Ascend mode and start a new progression cycle. Ascending resets much of your progression while retaining selected unlocks, introduces cumulative challenge modifiers, and increases your rewards. Adapt your party and builds as each Ascension adds another challenge.

Features

- Explore 5 fantasy biomes and defeat challenging bosses

- Recruit heroes with unique weapons, stats, and abilities

- Fight over 40 enemy types with their own abilities and mechanics

- Collect procedurally generated weapons, potions, and more than 40 artifacts

- Discover treasure chests, healing fountains, slot machines, a goblin merchant, and a blacksmith

- Modify and improve hero abilities with blacksmith upgrades during a run

- Invest rewards in more than 200 meta progression unlocks and upgrades

- Unlock faster game speeds and Auto-Run features

- Take on Ascend mode with cumulative challenges and increased rewards

games.name: My Own Hero Party
games.shortDescription: My Own Hero Party is an incremental idle game. Build your own band of heroes, venture deep into dungeons and gather mountains of gold! Invest your earnings in a permanent talent tree, grow stronger with every expedition and fight your way to the boss.
games.aboutText:
Start with a single Warrior and gradually recruit new companions to build your own adventuring party. The farther you venture into the dungeons, the richer the loot!

- Advance through distinctive dungeons teeming with all kinds of monsters.

- Use abilities manually at key moments during automatic combat to turn the tide.

- Defeat powerful enemies and gather heaps of gold and loot.

- Find powerful weapons along the way and fully equip your adventuring party.

After every expedition, invest your earnings in a sprawling permanent talent tree. Improve your stats and abilities, and enjoy the thrill of watching your numbers soar!

- Recruit heroes of new classes and keep expanding your party.

- Improve your whole party's base stats and unlock distinctive advanced talent branches.

- Unlock and strengthen each hero's signature abilities.

A successful expedition calls for the right weapons. Equip your party with the game's weapon system and create your own combat builds!

- Keep refining your weapons to improve their quality and base stats.

- Discover weapons tailored to each hero's talent branches and bring your build's synergies to life.

- Add special affixes to your weapons to strengthen the specializations you choose.

games.name: Me and You
games.shortDescription: Me and You is a co-op puzzle game inspired by the acclaimed “Baba Is You”. Create, change and break the rules of each level to solve it together.
games.aboutText:
Connect the word

Push scraps of paper, rocks, and walls to form the rules of the level. Characters transform, walls crumble, and keys appear out of nowhere

Together we'll get through anything

Every level is designed to be solved co-op. Only teamwork and constant communication will get you to the end.

Unexpected solutions

Turn your friend into a door, a rock, or a wall — who knows what it'll take to crack the next puzzle.

games.name: Arcane Abyss
games.shortDescription: A pixel-art, turn-based roguelite deckbuilder where your cards are swords, axes and spears, and you throw them. Thrown weapons stay on the board: hit one with another to trigger Resonance, a combo attack that chains to nearby weapons. Synthesis moves abilities between weapons.
games.aboutText:
Weapons are meant to be thrown.

Arcane Abyss is a pixel-art, turn-based roguelite deckbuilder where you fight by throwing weapons.

Swords, axes, spears—throw them straight from your hand of cards to attack monsters.

Transfer abilities through weapon synthesis, then combine them with Skill Cards to find your own way to fight.

Make weapons collide to trigger Resonance and get even more out of the abilities you've added.

Delve into the Abyss in search of rare weapons!

Resonance: throw a weapon into a weapon

Thrown weapons remain on the board. Hit one with another weapon to trigger Resonance , drawing out both weapons' abilities. Strike groups of monsters with wide-area attacks and special attacks.

When a Resonance attack catches other weapons in its path, it triggers further Resonance. Even simply scattering weapons around the board can lead to an unexpectedly powerful attack.

Keep an eye on weapon abilities that activate repeatedly through Resonance, too. As Resonance triggers again and again, synergies make those abilities more and more powerful.

It's the perfect chance to test the weapons you've enhanced through synthesis alongside your skills. Take advantage of terrain altered by elemental effects and aim to wipe out every monster.

Synthesis: move abilities to your favorite weapon

There's more to a new weapon than simply using it as it is. Use it as synthesis material to transfer its abilities to another weapon.

For example, add an ability that draws a card when you deal damage to a weapon you use often. Now you can replenish your hand with your next weapon while attacking enemies.

Will you choose raw attack power, or an ability that fits your current build? Even a weapon you'd normally overlook might hold the missing piece of the combination you've been looking for.

Skill Cards: passive perks that work on their own

Skill Cards grant passive abilities that take effect automatically once acquired. There's no need to activate them manually in battle.

MP Efficiency makes weapons with high MP costs easier to use. HP Drain restores HP based on the damage you deal. Sword Mastery enables sword attacks to land critical hits—and that's just the beginning.

Do you want more attacks, a reliable source of healing, or one devastating blow?

Combine weapon abilities and skills to shape your fighting style. With synthesis and Skill Cards, the possibilities for growing stronger are endless.

Every run, a new build

Choose four abilities through runes before setting out, and your adventure begins.

Choose your route through a branching map and work toward defeating the boss. Alongside weapons dropped by monsters, the armory lets you pick one weapon from three options. Put your build together through synthesis and skills.

Pursue the combination you had in mind, or change course to suit the weapons you find—the choice is yours. An ability you ignored last time might become the centerpiece of your build this time around.

Story: the day her home became a dungeon

One day, apprentice mage Elly comes home to find that her house has turned into a dungeon. She knows only one combat spell: channeling magic into a weapon and throwing it. Her fight against the monsters leads her down into the Abyss. The story unfolds in illustrated, picture-book-style scenes, and the Black Cat Shop awaits you at the hub.

- Available in 10 languages
- Single-player
- Free demo: play all of Areas 1 and 2
- Full release: November 2026

Gameplay Videos and Livestreaming

Let's Plays, video uploads, and livestreams of Arcane Abyss are welcome. Monetization is also permitted, and you do not need to contact us in advance.

games.name: Tidy Wizard: A Place For Every Plate
games.shortDescription: A relaxing organizing simulator set in a massive wizarding dining hall. Collect over 2,000 hand-crafted plates, wash them in an enchanted water sphere, and sort them onto shelves by family crest, color, and material. Unlock new spells to help organize the chaos at your pace!
games.aboutText:
In the grand dining hall of a high wizards' castle, an uncontrolled spell has scattered more than 2,000 prized plates belonging to highly regarded wizard families, coating them in a chaotic magical jelly. The glamorous life of advanced spellcasting will have to wait. Today, as an apprentice wizard, you are on cleanup duty!

FROM MAGICAL CHAOS TO WIZARDING ORDER

Turn the mess into a gleaming masterpiece through a deeply satisfying workflow:

- Gather: Search the floor and use magic to gently levitate the scattered, jelly-covered plates directly to your hands.

- Wash: Toss the dirty plates into a massive, levitating magical sphere of water that scrubs away the arcane goo.

- Shelve: Observe Search the hall to find the correct dressers. Match the plates based on their material, color, and mystical family symbol, then place them in perfect sequence on their designated shelves.

UNLOCK ARCANE EFFICIENCY

Every complete shelf earns points to unlock new utility spells. These magical upgrades turn your cleanup into an effortlessly satisfying flow:

- Increased Capacity: Upgrade your magic to lift and carry towering stacks of plates at a single time.

- Plate Attraction: Magically draw matching sets from across the room directly into your hands.

- Auto-Sorting: Watch the plates automatically organize themselves in your hands as you carry them.

- Auto-Placement: Effortlessly send plates flying across the room to place themselves onto the correct shelf automatically.

- And more!

KEY FEATURES

- Relaxing First-Person Organizing: Experience the pure satisfaction of turning chaos into perfect order at your own pace.

- A Massive Sorting Puzzle: Discover, wash, and meticulously organize an expansive collection of plates belonging to the realm's most prestigious wizarding families.

- Rich Visual Variety: Sort through beautiful, hand-drawn sets forged from prestigious materials and marked by mystical family crests, offering an engaging organizational challenge.

- Evolving Magic: Unlock helpful new spells as you progress to make every action feel seamless and rewarding.

games.name: Fish Them All!
games.shortDescription: Aim for 100 million fish! Catch fish, earn money, and unlock skills as your hauls grow and your fishing speeds up. Recruit divers, drones, and UFOs in this short pixel-art incremental fishing game, and reel in the very last fish in 4–5 hours.
games.aboutText:
100 million fish in the sea. Catch them all.

Catch fish, earn money, learn skills, and catch even more. Fish Them All! is an incremental fishing game where your hauls get bigger and your fishing gets faster with every upgrade.

Your goal: 100 million fish in total . It sounds impossible at first, but every catch and every upgrade brings it steadily within reach.

Catch fish → Spend your earnings on skills → Catch even more!

Move your boat left and right, drop your hook where you want, and reel in groups of fish swimming below. Head out again and again on fishing runs lasting about 60 seconds each.

Upgrade your movement speed, the number of fish you can reel in at once, and the size of your hook to bring home a bigger haul next time. Every new skill makes you want the next one. Keep upgrading and take your fishing to a whole new scale.

Divers, drones, and even UFOs.

Learn skills to unlock helpers that gather fish for you. Divers, drones, and UFOs join in to help with your catch.

Chain combos and clear whole schools of fish with explosions. With your helpers at your side, keep reeling in the fish that fill the sea.

4–5 hours, all the way to the last fish.

Teleporting sea urchins, squid with sudden bursts of speed, and enormous sharks. A pixel-art sea full of unusual fish awaits. Collect treasures from the seabed as you work toward the very last fish.

Expect around 4–5 hours of play. Enjoy the satisfaction of stacking upgrades and watching your catches grow dramatically in a short adventure that carries you all the way to the ending.

games.name: Sudoku Mansion
games.shortDescription: A story-driven Sudoku adventure by puzzle setter Nurator, featured on Cracking the Cryptic. Explore a mysterious mansion of handcrafted Sudoku variants, master increasingly intricate puzzles, and uncover the secret hidden beyond the grid.
games.aboutText:
Sudoku Mansion is a story-driven puzzle adventure where you explore a mysterious mansion and solve increasingly challenging Sudoku puzzles.

From the Puzzle Creator Nurator

Sudoku Mansion is created by Nurator , a puzzle setter known for his Sudoku variants.

Nurator's puzzles have been featured multiple times on Cracking the Cryptic, one of the world's best-known Sudoku and logic puzzle channels. Check out the Youtube Link on the right side for an example.

If you've encountered Nurator's puzzles before, you'll find that same love of unusual logic and elegant mechanics throughout the mansion.

Enter Sudoku Mansion

The invitation arrives without warning.

No name, no seal.

Only rushed references to missing servants, unstable rooms and a strange invention.

Two sentences have been underlined twice:

"I have found a way to reach beyond the grid. I no longer know whether that is our salvation or our ruin."

Step inside a mysterious mansion where every room is a handcrafted Sudoku variant. Uncover forgotten inventions as you unravel a mystery hidden deep inside the mansion.

Every Room Teaches Something New

Sudoku Mansion is built around one simple idea:

Every room introduces exactly one new concept.

What begins with familiar Sudoku principles gradually evolves into increasingly sophisticated puzzles. New mechanics are introduced one at a time, allowing every discovery to feel earned while constantly expanding the possibilities.

Every puzzle has been handcrafted. There are no randomly generated levels.

Built for Comfortable Play

Logic should be the challenge, not the interface.

Sudoku Mansion includes a variety of accessibility options to help you focus on solving puzzles your way. Adjust text sizes for comfortable reading, choose alternative color themes, enable colorblind-friendly visuals and customize the appearance of puzzle elements to suit your preferences.

The game is fully playable with only a mouse or only a keyboard and you can freely rebind all hotkeys in the game.

Whether you're settling in for a quick puzzle or an evening of exploration, the mansion is designed to be comfortable to play in.

Knowledge Changes the Mansion

As you explore, you'll unlock powerful puzzle classes that completely change how you interpret familiar rooms.

A puzzle once solved as a German Whisperer may later reveal an entirely different solution as a Region Sum Ambassador . The layout remains unchanged. But the rules and the logic transform completely.

And those are only two of the disciplines waiting to be discovered.

Each new class unlocks another perspective, rewarding players who revisit earlier rooms with fresh eyes.

Secrets Hide Behind Every Door

The mansion rewards curiosity.

Closed Vaults.

Traps you better be very careful around.

Some puzzles exist only for those willing to question what they've already learned.

The greatest mysteries are never placed on the main path.

A Mystery Beyond the Grid

The mansions servants have vanished.

Piece together what actually happened as you uncover the truth behind Sudoku Mansion.

Features

- Over 50 handcrafted logic puzzles

- Explore a mysterious interconnected mansion

- Unlock multiple puzzle classes that transform familiar challenges into entirely new experiences

- Discover secret rooms and hidden vaults

- Solve unforgettable boss encounters that test your mastery

- Atmospheric soundtrack

The invitation is waiting.

games.name: just volleyball
games.shortDescription: just volleyball is an online and offline volleyball game with unique yet intuitive controls and deep player expression. take on others in anything from 1v1s & 2v2s to full team-based 6v6 matches. there's no right way to play, it's just volleyball!
games.aboutText:
just volleyball is an arcade-style action volleyball game that aims to bring a freeform, addicting, and simple volleyball experience to PC, with full online & offline play. with a cursor-based aiming system and fully manual movement, the game may seem simple to pick up, but has a steep and rewarding learning curve.

features:

- 1v1s, 2v2s, 3v3s, 4v4s, 5v5s... and 6v6! play whichever format of volleyball you enjoy the most!

- offline & online play: practice by yourself with bots, or head online!

- character customization: personalize your player with a simple yet dynamic avatar creation system.

- replay mode: review your highlights & capture cinematic moments!

games.name: Dub Night Live
games.shortDescription: Grab a mic and redub the internet. Dub Night Live mutes the cast of a short clip and hands the roles to you and up to 8 friends. Everyone records at once, nobody hears anyone, then the whole party watches the finished cut together. Build your own clips with the in-app editor.
games.aboutText:
The show starts when the original voices stop

Dub Night Live takes a short clip, strips the cast out of it, and puts a microphone in front of you. You get the picture, you get the music, you get the line you have to hit. Whatever comes out of your mouth becomes the new official version.

No typing. No text to speech. Your actual voice, your actual bad accent, on a real cue.

Party night, up to 8 players

Invite your friends, hand out the roles, roll tape. Everybody performs their own characters at the same time and nobody hears anybody else while it is happening, so the first time you hear the whole thing is the first time everyone hears it.

Wrap your lines and you drop into the green room with the people who already finished, where you can talk trash while the stragglers sweat through take four. When the last person is done, the lights go down, the curtains open, and the party watches the finished cut together with little speaker portraits over the frame so you know exactly who to blame.

The casting desk

Before a word is recorded, the host casts the clip. Drag a player onto a character and the part is theirs. One player can take several characters, so two people can cover a four-hander, and anyone left uncast watches as a spectator.

Running a lineup? The casting carries over to the next episode, with KEEP LAST CASTING, AUTO-CAST and SHUFFLE waiting for you, plus a countdown so nobody has to say "ready" out loud.

Then you vote. Best performance takes the night.

Or take the booth alone

Solo runs line by line. Listen to the original, hit record, play it back, do it again if you can do better. Star the take you want, then sit through your own premiere like a real actor. Line up a few clips into a lineup and the next one starts on its own, so the show never stops for a menu.

The Cutting Room

Every clip in the game is made by players, and the tools ship inside the game.

Drop in a video, pull the voices out of the soundtrack so the music and the explosions survive, mark your lines on the timeline, cast your characters, grab their portraits straight off a frame, and send the whole thing to the Workshop.

You can test play your own clip in the real stage before you publish it, which is usually where you discover a line is two seconds too short.

Channel surfing

The Clip Browser is the front page of everything the community uploads. Sort by what is hot today, what is hot this week, or what has survived all of it. Filter by length, cast size, language or age rating, subscribe with one click, and it lands in your library ready to perform.

In the box

- Mic dubbing with per line takes, retakes and a best take pick

- Online parties for up to 8 with invite codes, voice chat, spectators and host migration

- A cinema style premiere of the finished cut, plus best performance voting

- Versus mode: two players take the same character and the premiere plays both cuts back to back so the party can pick a winner

- Foley lines, for when the job is not a voice but a door slam

- A full clip editor with vocal separation, timeline editing, portrait grabbing and one click Workshop publishing

- Steam Workshop clips and lineups, sorting, filters, favourites and voting

- A mic check wizard that measures your own recording delay so your takes land on the beat

Bring a microphone. Bring friends. Take the dub.

games.name: Can 'Em All
games.shortDescription: A juicy first-person incremental game about turning cute creatures into cans. Kill them, collect their bodies, can them, and sell them. Make money, upgrade your weapons and machines, and produce more and more.
games.aboutText:
Oh look, the truck is here.

A truck delivers a fresh batch of adorable creatures straight to your factory.

Unfortunately for them, they're also your main source of income.

First, you need them dead.

Grab your weapons and clear out the factory.

Now turn them into something useful.

Grab the bodies and throw them into the crusher.

Get those cans into the tube.

Your freshly processed cans still need to be sold.

Reinvest in the business.

Get stronger weapons. Upgrade your vacuum. Unlock machines. Build conveyors. Increase production. Bring in more creatures. Automate the factory.

games.name: Chief? About That File...
games.shortDescription: Step into an atmospheric 1990s police archive. Inspect, classify, and organize 3,360 unique criminal dossiers, crack safes, and uncover crime syndicates in this immersive first-person archival detective simulator.
games.aboutText:
WELCOME TO THE ARCHIVE, DETECTIVE

The year is 1995. Behind the heavy reinforced doors of the central precinct lies decades of unsolved crimes, forgotten evidence, and chaotic stacks of confidential files.

As the precinct's new archival investigator, your duty is to restore absolute order to its records—and uncover the secrets hidden between the lines.

KEY FEATURES

- Process 3,360 Unique Criminal Dossiers: Inspect detailed police files, identify each crime category, assess its severity, determine its public notoriety level, and place every case in its designated location.

- Experience a 1990s Police Archive: Explore a fully interactive 3D precinct filled with CRT terminals, fluorescent-lit archive aisles, metal filing cabinets, and satisfying retro soundscapes.

- Crack Safes & Discover Hidden Compartments: Decode combination locks, find forgotten keys, and unlock classified evidence compartments tucked deep within the archive.

- Uncover Crime Syndicates & Group Crimes: Piece together cases involving organized groups, match gang members to their ringleaders using visual markers and color-coded clues, and discover hidden details in special dossiers.

- Play at Your Own Pace: Enjoy a satisfying organizing experience without stressful time limits, combat, or failure states.

BRING ORDER TO THE CHAOS

Grab your keys, power on the archive terminal, and begin sorting through the precinct's forgotten cases.

Every file has a place. Some files have a story.

games.name: Worst Class Ever
games.shortDescription: 1 Teacher vs 7 Students. Hide. Prank. Survive. Up to 8-player asymmetric party chaos! Mischievous students blend into dozens of NPC classmates, secretly snacking, texting, and causing trouble, while the teacher must spot these wannabe delinquents and restore complete order to the classroom.
games.aboutText:
Worst Class Ever is an asymmetric party game set in a chaotic classroom, supporting up to 8 players! One player takes on the role of the strict teacher, while the other seven play as mischievous students. The troublemakers must blend in among dozens of NPC classmates and secretly pull off pranks like gobbling snacks, passing notes, and playing on their phones... all without getting caught! The teacher, armed with sharp eyes and a no-nonsense attitude, has to spot every last wannabe delinquent hiding in the crowd and restore perfect order to the classroom.

What if everyday school life turned into pure classroom chaos? Play as a mischievous student, gobbling snacks in secret and pulling pranks right under the teacher's watchful nose. Or take on the role of the strict teacher, activate sharp-eyed detection mode, and hunt down every last troublemaker hiding in the crowd. Every match is a ridiculous, high-energy showdown between teacher and students.

Step into the shoes of a natural-born troublemaker. Blend in, evade the teacher's attention, and go wild the second they turn their back. Your mission? Prank until there's no tomorrow and create pure classroom chaos. Be bold and do your worst... but above all, don't get caught. That constant tension mixed with the pure satisfaction of a successful prank? Nothing hits quite like it.

"You're the worst class I've ever taught!" Step into the role of the strict teacher. Use your sharp observation skills to catch every tiny slip: forced movements, panicked glances, or anything that feels off. Nothing escapes your eagle eyes. Identify the mischief makers, shut down their pranks, and restore absolute order. There's nothing quite like the feeling of singling the little troublemakers out.

Bright daytime classrooms, late-night study halls, computer labs packed with screens… Multiple maps rotate in, each with its own unique hideouts, exclusive prank tasks, and interactive mechanics. Every classroom brings fresh hiding strategies and brand-new ways to cause trouble. Different settings mean constantly changing matches so that no two games ever feel the same.

Smoke bombs, tranquilizer guns, drones… A whole arsenal of wild and creative items that take the pranks and counterplay to the next level! Mischievous students can unlock all kinds of chaotic tools to quietly set traps, create mayhem, and mess with the teacher's vision... anything to evade detection. Teachers get their own exclusive items to quickly lock onto students in hiding, see through disguises, and uncover every trick. Mix and match freely for flexible, ever-changing gameplay, or switch on random combinations for nonstop hilarious moments that'll have you in stitches!

games.name: Just Weeding
games.shortDescription: Pull 100,000 weeds! Zone out solo or chill and chat with up to 6 players in this endless weeding sim. Feed your goat to earn cash and unlock better weeding gear!
games.aboutText:
Just pull weeds. Clear all 100,000 weeds growing across the vast area.

🌱 Weeding

Just mindlessly pull the weeds in front of you. Forget the hustle and bustle of daily life and lose yourself in the act of weeding.

💰 Sell

Turn the weeds you collect into cash.

🛠️ Buy

Buy tools to boost your efficiency.

🤝 With Friends

Pull weeds with your friends, exactly however you like.

games.name: Winds of Viridia
games.shortDescription: Explore the valley of the towering Grantree, battle grand beasts, and find out what’s driving the creatures in these forgotten lands mad. Discover secrets, make new friends, and find powerful lost relics. Take on fearsome bosses, and uncover the truth of the wild frenzy.
games.aboutText:
Explore the Wild Unknown

Explore the valley of the towering Grantree, battle grand beasts, and find out what’s driving the creatures in these forgotten lands mad. Discover secrets, make new friends, and find powerful lost relics. Face down fearsome bosses, and uncover the truth of the wild frenzy.

Features

- Explore a wild, handcrafted world - Discover mountain glades, hidden grottos and vast ancient ruins as you adventure toward the mysterious Grantree.

- Move fast and free - Roll, slide, flip and grapple through the seamless world in style. Learn about strange plants that can help you jump higher, launch further and explore deeper.

- Fight frenzied beasts - Face dozens of unique creatures affected by the frenzy in fast, agile combat.

- Meet new friends - Befriend a companion Mothbug to assist in exploration and combat. Help the residents of Sanctuary and join them for a meal, and find bolder explorers deeper into the wilds.

- Challenge grand bosses - Battle gigantic beasts, living statues, and great guardians of the past.

- Equip powerful totems - Find lost relics and treasures to use as totems. Combine them to customize your playstyle.

- Hear the call of the wild - Experience a sweeping orchestral score from legendary composers Kevin Penkin and Christopher Larkin.

games.name: Zombies Aren't Real
games.shortDescription: Zombies Aren't Real is a horde-defense, strategy game where you deploy military forces in an attempt to quell a quick-spreading zombie infection and save as many civilians as you can!
games.aboutText:
Zombies Aren't Real is a horde-defense, strategy game where you attempt to control a quick-spreading zombie infection in real-world cities by commanding military forces.

You're given a bird's eye view of a city and time to prepare for the outbreak. With limited resources, carefully choose how you will respond to the infection and establish a plan to save as many civilians as possible.

Once you're ready the chaos begins. The zombies will fan out and begin to infect the population. You are able to adapt your plan on the fly. If the zombies break through your perimeter you can call in air support such as bombers or gatling gun helicopters to attempt to stop the spread before it gets out of control.

If you're able to eliminate all the zombies you win and your score is determined by how many civilians you saved.

Features

- Play in real-world cities

- Deploy specialized ground forces against the spreading horde, such as snipers, turrets, mortar squads and garrisons

- Call in air strikes when things get out of hand, but be careful to aim them well to minimize civilian casualties

- Place safe zones, gates, and more to protect the civilian population

- Steam Workshop support for custom maps

- Play with one other friend in Online Co-op Multiplayer

Multiplayer (2-player online)

Invite a friend to survive the horde with you! In co-op, players split their resources, plan defenses side by side, and call in battle abilities in real time to quell the horde. Each player owns their own budget and buildings, but victory depends on working together.

Is "Zombies Aren't Real" for you?

"Zombies Aren't Real" is highly strategic and winning will push you to think cleverly and experiment with different combinations of units, buildings and upgrades. It is not an incremental game. Losing is fun! We encourage you to retry often, restarting a scenario once defeat is inevitable to adjust your strategy. The fun is in figuring out how to best defend the city!

Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, Overture Maps Foundation, TomTom, Microsoft (Open Database License, Esri Community Maps contributors, Google Open Buildings, work derived from BTN 2024 ign.es (CC BY 4.0, postal codes: GeoNames (CC BY 4.0).

games.name: Deleted Wiki: Clean Up the Lost Files
games.shortDescription: A cozy incremental sorting game. A vandal deleted all 10,324 items from a 2007 fan wiki, and you're the new Moderator. Drag each item into its category, sub-folder and row, earn userscripts that automate the work, and watch the broken pages come back.
games.aboutText:
Deleted Wiki: Clean Up the Lost Files is a cozy incremental sorting game. A vandal has wiped every item page from a 2007 fan wiki, and you're the new Moderator putting all 10,324 of them back, one drag at a time.

At 3:12 AM on 14 March 2007, a user called Nullbane emptied the Item Vault of The unOfficial Embercraft Wiki: two years of fan work cataloguing every item in the 2004 MMO Plains of Embercraft: Online . All 10,324 items, deleted in one pass.

Nothing is actually gone. Every item is still in the deletion log, waiting for someone patient enough to put them back.

That someone is you. Congratulations on the promotion! You are the wiki's new Moderator.

Drag items out of the Trash onto the seven Category folders: Weapons, Armor, Consumables, Materials, Skills & Status, Interface and Curios. Work out where each one belongs yourself, until scripts start showing you exactly where everything goes.

On each Category page, drag the unsorted pile into the right Sub-Category. Swords onto Swords, Debuffs onto Debuffs. Every item you sort earns Sorting Points .

Open a Sub-Category and drop each item onto its exact row. Fill a whole row to earn a Completion Point , which buys the strongest scripts on the wiki.

Wren runs the wiki and has no intention of sorting any of this himself. He writes userscripts instead. Spend your points on them to multiselect whole stacks, pull scattered copies together, and eventually hand the heavy lifting to SortBot and AutoRestore.

Keep an eye on your talk page: news from The Embercraft Herald , updates from Wren, guild drama you weren't invited to, extremely legitimate offers from extremely legitimate companies… and maybe some people you weren't expecting to hear from.

- 10,324 items to restore across 7 categories

- 12 userscripts to earn, from Multiselect to AutoRestore

- 3 challenge modes, and one secret mode

- 10 music tracks and 3 save profiles

10,324 items are waiting in the log, Moderator .

games.name: OUTLIER
games.shortDescription: OUTLIER is an online hide-and-seek game for up to 16 players, set in an uncharted zone of the Backrooms where strange symptoms have begun to appear. Blend into a crowd of identical hazmat suits and secretly let out the unbearable urge. The Overseer is watching. Can you act normal to the end?
games.aboutText:
An online hide-and-seek game for up to 16 players. Crews sent into an unmapped zone of the Backrooms have begun reporting symptoms. Blend into the crowd, relieve your symptoms in secret, and don't let the Overseer notice.

HIDE IN THE CROWD

Act Natural. Drop into a level full of crew members in identical hazmat suits. Walk like them, stop like them, sit when they sit. One wrong move and you stand out.

YOUR SYMPTOMS WON'T WAIT

Relieve It in Secret! Dance. Moonwalk. Fart. Breakdance. Stagger around drunk. Beatbox. And it only gets weirder. The urge keeps building. Relieve it behind the Overseer's back, or it bursts out in front of everyone.

THE OVERSEER IS WATCHING

Eyes Everywhere. Overseers patrol with guns, looking for anyone who acts a little off. Get caught and you hit the floor. They can order a roll call at any time. Don't forget to salute!

PICK YOUR RULES

• Normal : Relieve your symptoms in secret and survive until time runs out. The Overseers are hunting for anyone showing symptoms, and they won't stop until every last one of you is caught.

• Infection : Get caught and you stand right back up as an Overseer. The hunt snowballs, and your friends become the problem.

• Free-for-all : No Overseers, no guns. The level is full of real crew members and players pretending to be crew. Suspect everyone and kick anyone who looks off! But get it wrong, and everyone around you just watched you do the one thing real crew members never do: a dropkick. Last one standing wins.

Three levels are open: Level 0, the Backrooms. Level 5, a mall. Level 6, a park.

FEATURES

- 2–16 players online

- Up to 160 crew members in the crowd

- Normal, Infection and Free-for-all modes

- In-game voice chat

- Streamer mode with copyright-free music and a hidden server code

- 14 languages

STREAMING & VIDEOS

Gameplay videos and streams are welcome, and you're free to monetize them. Solo or with an agency, no need to ask first. Just two small requests:

• Put "OUTLIER" in your video title.

• Link this Steam page in your description. (Optional)

games.name: Golden Trivia Show
games.shortDescription: Enter a quiz show solo or with friends. Divide your gold bars among the possible answers; those placed on a wrong answer will fall into a piranha pool. Will you make it to the end?
games.aboutText:
Golden Trivia Show is a quiz game presented as a TV show that you can play solo or cooperatively with your friends online (up to 4 players). You start with a pile of gold bars and need to avoid losing them. Each question has 4 possible answers, and you can choose to divide your gold bars among them. Only the gold bars placed on the correct answer will remain with you; the rest will fall into a pool filled with piranhas. If you manage to make it to the end and win some gold, you can spend it on cool new suits and cosmetics.

· Enter a TV-style quiz show

· 1–4 players (online co-op)

· Special rounds with chaotic modifiers

· 1,000+ questions with both text and images

· Not sure which is the correct answer? Divide your gold bars among them

· Win gold and customize your character

games.name: Psst!
games.shortDescription: Sit down with friends, give a few hints, and try not to give your secret away. In this party game, close guesses earn you points, but an exact answer knocks you out. Play as cats across five word-game modes, online with friends or solo with bots.
games.aboutText:
Can you give a hint without giving it away?

Everyone at the table has a secret word. You want the others to get close to yours, because close guesses earn you points. But if someone guesses it exactly, you’re out of the round.

So you give them a hint. Something helpful, but hopefully not too helpful. As they guess, the game tells you how close they are: Cold, Warm, Hot, or Burning.

When it’s your turn to guess, you get to be the person asking awkward questions and trying to figure out what on earth your friend meant.

Maybe that was one hint too many

They’re getting warmer. You could leave them to work it out, or offer another clue and try to earn a few more points.

Those points aren’t yours to keep just yet. You have to get through their guesses without losing your secret. And sometimes, halfway through a perfectly reasonable clue, you realise you’ve just told them the answer.

There’s more to play

There are five modes to choose from, depending on what your table is in the mood for.

- Secret Words: Give hints, guess other players’ words, and try to keep your own a secret.

- Secret Sentences: The same idea, with a whole ridiculous sentence to piece together.

- Bridge: Come up with a word that connects two other words.

- Hot Potato Chain: Take turns adding to a word chain before the timer runs out.

- Impostor: Listen to everyone’s clues and work out who doesn’t belong.

Get a few friends around the table

Play online with 2 to 4 players, or play solo with bots. You can say your clues and guesses out loud, or type them if you prefer.

Pick the lantern-lit room or the outdoor table in the mountains, get comfortable, and see how well you actually understand each other. You’ll all be cats, which should make the arguments a little harder to take seriously.

Thanks for being here

Thank you for taking a look at One Hint Too Far. If you’ve added it to your wishlist, thank you for the support. It means a lot.

Hope you and your friends have a lovely time with it, share a few laughs, and find yourselves staying for another round. See you at the table!
